feed.title: Track Awesome List Updates Daily
feed.subtitle: We track over 500 awesome list updates, and you can also subscribe to daily or weekly updates via RSS or News Letter.

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 17, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Game Remakes

Action

  • Lantern Engine (⭐1.8k) - Bloodborne recomp to Windows and Linux.
  • Parasite Eve 2 HD Remaster (⭐278) - Parasite aeve 2 recomp to Windows.
  • Edge of Time Recomp (⭐494) - Spider Man: Edge of Time (Xbox 360) recomp to desktop.
  • TRX (⭐1k) - Open-source reimplementation of Tomb Raider I, Tomb Raider II, and Tomb Raider III, along with additional enhancements and bugfixes, for desktop.
  • Zelda Wind Waker HD Recomp (⭐1.4k) - Zelda: The Wind Waker HD recomp to desktop and Android.
    • ZeldaWWHDRecompAndroid (⭐95) - Enhanced Android port.
  • X-Men Mutant Academy 2 PC (⭐23) - X-Men Mutant Academy 2 recomp to Windows.
  • Ultimate MK3 PC (⭐73) - Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3 (iOS) decomp to Windows and Linux.

2. Awesome Computational Biology

Drug Response & Perturbation

  • scCT-DB — Cancer treatment single-cell database with 266 paired pre/post-treatment datasets, 6.19M cells, 1,142 samples, 27 cancer types, and 102 drugs.
  • scICB — Pan-cancer ICB therapy single-cell database spanning 338 patients, 807 samples, 3.69M cells, and 13 cancer types, including 247 matched pre/post-treatment patients.
  • CellResDB — Cancer therapy response single-cell database containing 4.7M cells from 1,391 patient samples, 72 datasets, and 24 cancer types.
  • Gondal et al. 2025 ICB scRNA-seq collection — Integrated ICB-treated cancer single-cell collection from eight studies and 223 patients, with 90,270 cancer cells and 265,671 other cells.

Genetic Perturbation & Perturb-seq

  • scPerturbBench (TianGzlab / PerturbArena) (⭐11) — Benchmark of single-cell genetic perturbation prediction covering unseen perturbations, combinations, cell-state transfer, and 24 evaluation metrics.
  • scPerturBench (BM2 Lab) (⭐110) — Benchmark comparing 27 single-cell perturbation-response prediction methods across 29 genetic and chemical perturbation datasets.

General Biological ML & Knowledge Graph Benchmarks

  • CellBench (CellVoyager) (⭐273) — Benchmark for evaluating LLMs and data-analysis agents on reproducible single-cell research tasks.

Preprocessing Tools

  • SpatialData — Interoperable data structures and tooling for spatial omics, microscopy images, coordinates, segmentation shapes, and annotations.

Bioinformatics & Omics Agents

  • CellVoyager (⭐273) — Jupyter-based scientific agent that plans, executes, and evaluates single-cell transcriptomics analyses, accompanied by CellBench.

Single-cell Foundation Models / Transcriptomics Foundation Models

  • Cell2Sentence / C2S-Scale (⭐896) — Single-cell language-model family representing gene-expression profiles as cell sentences for cellular interpretation, generation, and question answering.

Multi-Modal Foundation Models / Protein Structure Prediction and Design

  • TxGemma — Open Gemma-based therapeutic-development model family (2B, 9B, and 27B) for property prediction and interactive scientific reasoning.
  • NVIDIA Nemotron for Science — Scientific-agent development stack based on Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, with post-training recipes and chemistry reasoning benchmark LitmusBench v0.2.

3. Awesome Appimage

AppImage developer tools / Deployment tools for compiled applications

  • AppImage Packaging (⭐1) - Skills for Claude and other coding agents (Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, ...) that package Linux applications as self-contained AppImages, build and publish them from GitHub Actions, and verify and troubleshoot them on other distributions.

4. Awesome Streaming

Table of Contents / Applications and Tools

  • stream-fraud (⭐1) [Python] - Teaching demo of simulated transaction scoring, sliding-window features, and PSI/KS drift replay; not production stream processing infrastructure.

5. Android Security Awesome

Tools / Static Analysis Tools

  • LLMObfuscDetection (⭐23) - An open-source framework for detecting and classifying Android code obfuscation techniques using Large Language Models.

Tools / Dynamic Analysis Tools

  • TeleGapper (⭐19) - An open-source black-box dynamic analysis framework for analyzing Telegram Mini Apps on Android, capturing network traffic, and checking data-flow disclosures against privacy policies.

6. Awesome Datascience

Datasets / Book Deals (Affiliated)

  • Verified Supplement Evidence - Evidence-graded dietary-supplement dataset covering dosing, bioavailability by form, drug-nutrient interactions, NHANES deficiency prevalence, FDA FAERS adverse-event signals, and cost-per-effective-dose, with every clinical claim citing a PubMed PMID. CC BY 4.0, DOI 10.57967/hf/9356.

7. Awesome Deno

Modules / CLI utils

  • clinfer (⭐10) - Automatically generate CLIs from JS objects, classes or ES modules.

Modules / Database

  • kvdock (⭐4) - Zero-dependency key-value and multi-tier caching engine with native Deno KV support and single-flight stampede protection.
  • nessie (⭐519) - Create, migrate and rollback migrations for PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite.

Modules / Frontend framework

  • fresh (⭐14k) - The next-gen web framework.

Modules / Image

  • aigifmaker (⭐0) - Turn text prompts into animated GIFs with the AI GIF Maker API.
  • ImageScript (⭐685) - Image processing in JavaScript, utilizing WebAssembly for performance.

Modules / Social Platform APIs

  • Circe (⭐1) - Inversion-of-control framework for discord.js bots with file-system routing, guards and Gateway or HTTP transport.

Modules / Utils

  • injecute (⭐5) - Type-safe dependency injection container with explicit wiring and no decorators.
  • json-schema-for-llms (⭐1) - Turn a JSON document too large for an LLM context window into a short JSON Schema with counts, ranges and example records.

Modules / Validation

  • is-kit (⭐193) - Build small, composable type guards with natural TypeScript narrowing and zero dependencies.

Modules / Web utils

  • linkpeek (⭐18) - Extract Open Graph, Twitter Card and JSON-LD link-preview metadata from a URL.

Tools / XML

  • bare-devcontainer/templates (⭐3) - Security-focused Deno dev container for JS/TS with hardened defaults and cached modules. The base image is available at bare-devcontainer/images (⭐3).
  • copilotz (⭐6) - TypeScript runtime for apps used by people, the app's own agents and AI assistants over MCP, with one set of Actions, access rules and audit record for every caller.

8. Awesome Go

Blockchain

  • seed-poet (⭐0) - BIP39 mnemonic generator that arranges 12 or 24-word seed phrases as rhyming couplets, with a JavaScript port that produces identical output.

Networking

  • go-socket.io (⭐2) - Socket.IO server and client with namespaces, rooms and acknowledgements, for socket.io-client 1.x and 2.x.

9. Awesome Zig

Language Essentials / File Format Processing

  • h0rv/jsonschema.zig (⭐2) - JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validation and schema generation from Zig types. AI-assisted.

Network & Web / Network

  • ANODs/blackwall (⭐1) - VPN client for macOS, Windows, Linux and Android with its own TCP/IP stack, TLS 1.3, REALITY, VLESS, Trojan, VMess and Shadowsocks, and a route per application. AI-generated.

Network & Web / Web Framework

  • h0rv/zchema (⭐4) - Typed JSON APIs with validation and OpenAPI 3.1 generation, built on std.http.Server. AI-assisted.

Data & Science / Large Language Model

  • h0rv/instructor.zig (⭐2) - Structured LLM output with validation and retries for OpenAI and Anthropic. AI-assisted.
  • h0rv/openai.zig (⭐1) - Generated SDK for the OpenAI API. AI-assisted.
  • h0rv/anthropic.zig (⭐0) - Generated SDK for the Anthropic API. AI-assisted.
  • h0rv/openresponses.zig (⭐0) - Generated SDK for the Open Responses API specification. AI-assisted.

Data & Science / Encryption

  • Defense-Exploration-Holdings/crypto-api-ng (⭐0) - Zero-dependency hashing library (MD/SHA/SHA-3/BLAKE/RIPEMD/Whirlpool/Streebog/SM3, HMAC, PBKDF2, HKDF) in Zig, shipped to npm as WebAssembly. AI-generated.

10. Awesome Mac

File Management / File Utilities

  • Berliner187/Golosok (⭐19) — Free Wispr Flow & Superwhisper alternative. Native macOS voice ☆19

System Tools / Menu Bar

  • hunterphillips/realign (⭐17) — macOS utility: save and quickly restore your window layout ☆17

System Tools / System Utilities

  • jedbrnth-eng/lucid-live-wallpaper (⭐16) — Free live 4K wallpapers for Mac: about 590 space and ☆16

11. Awesome Gemini Cli

Commands & Extensions

  • Revenue Skills (⭐0) - Gemini CLI extension with 11 Agent Skills for code that handles money: an audit of payment, credit and payout paths that reports each bug with file, line and a request proof or code trace, and skills that build webhook endpoints, ledgers, refunds, usage credits, subscriptions, payouts, referrals and sign-up abuse guards. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/moonetix/revenue-skills
  • AsItIs (⭐4) - Gemini CLI extension and CLI that lints GEMINI.md, AGENTS.md and SKILL.md. Shows which files Gemini CLI loads at startup and about how many tokens they cost, and flags instructions hidden in comments or invisible characters. Read-only, runs offline.

Development Tools & Utilities

  • Folkbench Switch - Open-source desktop app (Tauri/Rust) that saves API provider profiles and writes the selected endpoint and key into Gemini CLI's ~/.gemini/.env and settings.json, with a diff preview before writing. Also handles Claude Code and Codex.
  • Buddy Sandboxes - Isolated Ubuntu machines in the Buddy.Works cloud for running Gemini CLI away from your laptop. Install it in the sandbox with npm install -g @google/gemini-cli, connect over SSH, and the agent can install packages and run commands without touching your machine. The bdy sandbox CLI also copies files, exposes ports on public endpoints and takes snapshots.

Browser Extensions

  • Open in AI Agent for Gmail - Open-source Chrome, Edge and Firefox extension (GitHub (⭐1)) that right-clicks single or multiple Gmail threads directly into separate named gemini -i or Antigravity (agy) sessions in your working folder, plus unread inbox triage up to 25 threads.

MCP Servers

  • Agent Nexus (⭐1) - Continuous discovery registry and live health observability for 730+ remote MCP servers and APIs with tool schema validation and split-fleet detection. Free tier with 1,000 requests/day. Remote Streamable HTTP endpoint: https://agentnexus.app/mcp.
  • Taskhold - Hosted MCP server that gives Gemini CLI a task list you share: next task, steps, live progress and blocked questions you answer from a web board. 23 tools, remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth. Paid, $12/month, 7-day trial.
  • zaDojo (⭐2) - Hosted SEO and GEO MCP server: free Google Search Console, Google Analytics and site audits, plus pay-as-you-go SERP and keyword research, rank tracking and AI visibility tracking in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key. Add with gemini mcp add --transport http --scope user zadojo https://app.zadojo.com/mcp, then /mcp auth zadojo. Gemini CLI guide.
  • CallForMe - Hosted MCP server that lets Gemini CLI phone a business for you: it works the phone menu, waits on hold, asks your agent mid-call when the business needs something and returns answers plus a transcript. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth. Pay per call, $1 per answered call; demo line with no account.

12. Awesome Zsh Plugins

Plugins / superconsole - Windows-only

  • ai-cmd (kylesnowschwartz) (⭐108) - Converts natural language to shell commands with ghost text preview. Requires curl, jq and an Anthropic API key.
  • ai-cmd (shanemcd) (⭐8) - Generate shell commands from natural language using LLMs via Claude Code or Ollama.
  • auto-venv (⭐7) - Automatically activates the Python virtual environment in the current directory or its parent directories.
  • copylast (⭐0) - Reads the last command's output straight out of tmux's scrollback, so it's instant and you get exactly what you saw.
  • shellsense (ThePubDoc) (⭐1) - IDE-style autocomplete for your terminal. Type a command and a list of what can come next opens under the word you are typing: subcommands, options, git branches, npm scripts, files and folders, each with a short description. Pick one with the arrow keys or keep typing to narrow the list.
  • shellsense (venopyX) (⭐7) - AI-powered ZSH plugin designed to enhance your terminal experience with powerful features and AI-powered capabilities. Developed using Python, ShellSense offers a streamlined workflow for various tasks, making your terminal more efficient and user-friendly.

Themes / superconsole - Windows-only

  • hexagon (⭐5) - Minimalist ZSH theme based on geometry (⭐1k).

13. Awesome Mac

Terminal Apps / Databases

  • zest (⭐22) - Autocomplete popup for zsh with descriptions for 1,500 commands, in Terminal.app, iTerm2, Ghostty, VS Code and Cursor.
  • Escale (⭐8) - Native SSH client with tabs, an SFTP browser beside the terminal, tunnels, multi-execution and a built-in X11 server.

Reading and Writing Tools / Note-taking

  • EdgeEver - Open-source note-taking and knowledge workspace with self-hosting, multi-device sync, and MCP integration.

Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

  • AGASTHY (⭐3) - Open-source app that maps your repos, runtimes, packages and AI coding agents into one knowledge graph, with token usage, impact analysis and safe disk cleanup.

Design and Product / Other Tools

  • Linger - Local-first visual reference library for saving images, source links, and notes, with keyword search and collections.

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • Aris - Open-source AI agent in the MacBook notch that you talk or type to, which acts in your apps with the AI you already use and asks before anything that sends, writes or deletes.
  • Gesher (⭐2) - Open-source MCP servers and CLIs that let AI assistants read and edit Apple Notes, Reminders, Calendar, Contacts, Maps, Weather and Freeform.

Communication / Email Clients

  • Spool - Keyboard-driven email client written in Rust on gpui, the framework Zed is built with.

Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

  • BitSpring - Open-source bit-perfect music player with native DSD, per-track sample rates up to 768 kHz and AutoEQ headphone EQ.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • Bar27 (⭐19) - Menu bar manager for macOS 27 that hides icons per app and reveals them with a click, hover, or shortcut.
  • Music Router (⭐4) - Stops Music.app from auto-launching and routes media keys to the app you're actually using.

14. Magictools

Graphics / Spritesheet Tools

  • 🆓 GIF to Sprite Sheet - Browser tool that turns a GIF, animated WebP or video into a PNG sprite sheet, with JSON atlas, Godot .tres and Sparrow XML export. Also cuts sheets into frames and plays a sheet back as a GIF. Files stay on your device.

Graphics / Vector/Image Editor

  • 🎉 Pixelorama - Free & open source pixel art editor with animation support, made with Godot.

AI / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 3DLoom - Image or text to textured 3D game assets, exported as GLB, FBX, OBJ or USDZ, with a low-poly mode for props. 20 free credits on sign-up and no subscription; the GLB, OBJ and FBX converters are free and need no account.
  • 🆓 Markan - Steam market research for indie games: Google Sheets and Excel add-ins that pull Steam data and estimate sales, free pages for about 80,000 games and 420 tags, and a free MCP server so AI assistants can find similar games and estimate their sales. No account needed.

15. Awesome Playcanvas

3D Gaussian Splatting / YouTube Playables

  • KosmoWorld - Explore and share 3D scenes captured with Hesai's Kosmo.

16. Awesome Flame

App Releases / Action

  • Voideron - Android - A twin-stick black-hole dungeon: clear all 10 levels. Offline, no ads. By Teoktonos

App Releases / Arcade

  • PaddleX - Android - A paddle duel across 300 levels and ten ways to play: power-ups, building, a second ball, marble runs, foosball, table ice hockey and a shooting gallery, with a champion at the end of every world and two players on one device. By Grabow Commuter
  • Hungry Fish: Eat, Grow, Evolve - Android - A fish-eat-fish game: grow through 13 evolution stages across 11 ocean worlds and beat a giant boss in each. By NewAgeDevs

App Releases / Puzzle Games

  • Arrow Duel - Android - An arrow-escape puzzle where every level is a turn-based duel against a computer rival: clear your arrows first without opening the way for theirs. 100 levels, bosses, a League and a Daily Challenge. By jeshan-coder
  • Arrow Rush: Untangle Puzzle - Android, iOS - Tap the arrows off the board in the right order. Every level is generated to be solvable, with a boss board every tenth level. By NewAgeDevs
  • Cars to Rockets: Parking Jam - Android, iOS - A parking-jam puzzle with 1,600 solver-checked levels across eight worlds, from a city car park to the snowy peaks. By NewAgeDevs
  • Jelly Float: Merge & Evolve - Android, iOS - Launch jellyfish, let them float up and merge into bigger ones, with a daily challenge. By NewAgeDevs

App Releases / Roguelike

  • Grim Hand - Android, iOS - A turn-based dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where your cards come from your weapon and shield. By HedgeCat Studios

17. Awesome Iot

Software / Libraries and Tools

  • Tapo (⭐877) - Rust API, Python API, and MCP Server for TP-Link Tapo smart devices.

18. Free for Dev

Code Quality

  • proofline.sh - AI code review for GitHub pull requests, with infrastructure-aware checks when connected to a deployment environment. Free forever for open repos, and no subscription required if you BYOK on any private repo.

IDE and Code Editing

  • OnlineCompiler.io - Online compiler and code execution API for 46 languages. The editor is free with no sign-in, and the free API plan includes 100,000 runs a month.

19. Awesome Selfhosted

Software / File Transfer - Peer-to-peer Filesharing

  • CheezyPizza - Send files directly between browsers using WebRTC. No uploads, no cloud storage, and no middleman. Fast, secure, peer-to-peer file sharing. Forked from file.pizza. (Demo, Source Code (⭐187)) BSD-3-Clause Docker

Software / File Transfer - Single-click & Drag-n-drop Upload

  • PicoShare - Minimalist, easy-to-host service for sharing images and other files. (Clients) AGPL-3.0 Go/Docker

Software / Media Streaming - Multimedia Streaming

  • RelayTV - Turns a Linux box connected to a television into a local playback endpoint. Send links from a phone, browse Jellyfin or Emby libraries, play IPTV channels, and drive playback from Home Assistant or HTTP (alternative to Chromecast). (Source Code (⭐99), Clients (⭐1)) GPL-3.0 Docker

Software / Personal Dashboards

  • Homer (⭐12k) - Dead simple static homepage to expose your server services, with an easy yaml configuration and connectivity check. (Demo) Apache-2.0 Docker/K8S/Nodejs

Software / Search Engines

  • Hister - Personal web search engine with automatic indexing of visited websites. Supports offline local result previews, local files, multi-user handling and optional semantic search. (Demo, Source Code (⭐6.3k)) AGPL-3.0 Go/Docker

20. Awesome Rtc

Server Software / General Purpose

  • FreeSWITCH (⭐5.3k) - Open source communications server for voice, video, messaging and conferencing.
  • Asterisk - PBX framework supporting multiple protocols and platforms.

Server Software / SIP Servers

  • Kamailio - Open source SIP server for routing, registration, presence and large-scale deployments.
  • OpenSIPS - Open source SIP proxy and application server for VoIP platforms.
  • FreeSBC (⭐369) - Open source SIP/WebRTC edge proxy with an embedded RTP relay for FreeSWITCH and Asterisk.
  • P-KISS-SBC (⭐114) - Kamailio and rtpengine-based session border controller for connecting SIP trunks and PBXs.

Server Software / Media Servers

  • LiveKit (⭐22k) - Open source WebRTC server and SDK ecosystem for real-time audio, video and data.
  • rtpengine (⭐1k) - RTP and UDP based media traffic proxy, usable as a kernel module.
  • MediaMTX (⭐21k) - Media server and proxy bridging WebRTC, RTSP, RTMP and SRT streams, with recording and playback.
  • go2rtc (⭐15k) - Camera streaming gateway with WebRTC viewing, RTSP restreaming and two-way audio integrations.

Server Software / STUN/TURN

  • STUNner (⭐1.1k) - Kubernetes-native STUN/TURN gateway for WebRTC media.

Clients / STUN/TURN

  • Web SIP Phone (⭐8) - Chrome extension maintaining SIP/WebRTC audio for server-controlled call center agents.
  • baresip (⭐2.3k) - Modular SIP user agent with command-line controls, audio/video calls and pluggable media modules.

Operations / Monitoring

  • sip-exporter (⭐58) - Open-source eBPF sensor exporting Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards for host-observed IPv4/UDP SIP and correlated RTP/RTCP.
  • rtcStats (⭐47) - WebRTC API trace and getStats collection, storage and feature extraction tooling.
  • SIP3 Community Edition - Open source SIP/RTP capture, analysis and monitoring components with community deployment tooling.

Operations / Testing

  • SIPp (⭐1.2k) - Traffic generator and scenario-based test tool for the SIP protocol.

Operations / Web/API Interfaces

  • Kazoo (⭐992) - Legacy open source VoIP API platform built on FreeSWITCH and Kamailio, available in the public 4.3 branch.
  • AI Native Call Center (⭐659) - FreeSWITCH-based call center with speech-to-speech AI, agent queues and a web interface/API.

Operations / Billing

  • CGRateS (⭐528) - Open source rating, charging and billing engine for telecom and ISP services.

Developer Resources / Tutorials

  • WebRTC.org - Official WebRTC guides, APIs and project resources.
  • Getting Started With WebRTC - Official introduction to media capture and peer-to-peer connectivity APIs.
  • WebRTC for the Curious - Open book explaining WebRTC protocols, architecture and practical debugging.

Developer Resources / JavaScript Libraries

  • JsSIP - Open source JavaScript SIP library with WebRTC media support.
  • Peerix (⭐7) - TypeScript WebRTC library for peer-to-peer media and data with pluggable signalling drivers.
  • werift (⭐649) - TypeScript WebRTC implementation for Node.js with media, data channels and RTP/RTCP APIs.

Developer Resources / C/C++ Libraries

  • libre (⭐195) - Portable SIP, SDP, RTP, SRTP and ICE/STUN/TURN library with asynchronous I/O.
  • icey (⭐1.4k) - C++20 media toolkit combining WebRTC, FFmpeg, asynchronous networking and signalling.
  • GStreamer WebRTC - WebRTC elements for connecting native GStreamer media pipelines to browser peers.

Developer Resources / Rust Libraries

  • WebRTC.rs (⭐5.2k) - Asynchronous WebRTC implementation in Rust with SDP, RTP, RTCP and SRTP support.

Developer Resources / Dart Libraries

  • dart-sip-ua (⭐374) - Dart SIP user-agent stack with SIP over WebSocket and WebRTC media support.
  • Flutter WebRTC (⭐4.5k) - WebRTC bindings for Flutter applications on mobile, desktop and the web.

Developer Resources / Media over QUIC

  • moq-rs (⭐186) - Rust implementation of Media over QUIC Transport with a relay and sample publishers.
  • moq (⭐1.6k) - Rust and TypeScript libraries, relay and browser player implementing moq-lite.
  • moqtail (⭐114) - Rust and TypeScript Media over QUIC Transport libraries with a relay and example clients.
  • moxygen (⭐127) - C++ Media over QUIC Transport library with a relay, sample applications and interoperability tools.
  • libquicr (⭐21) - C++ Media over QUIC Transport library with publish, subscribe, capture and replay tools.
  • imquic (⭐82) - Experimental C library for QUIC and WebTransport with RTP over QUIC and Media over QUIC Transport support.

Blogs / Media over QUIC

  • WebRTC For Developers - Articles, examples and tools for WebRTC application developers.

Discussion / Media over QUIC

  • FreeSWITCH Community - Discord community for FreeSWITCH and SignalWire users and developers.
  • discuss-webrtc - Developer discussion group for WebRTC APIs, implementations and interoperability.

Events and Talks / Media over QUIC

  • ClueCon - Conference for communications and voice AI developers.
  • Kamailio World - Conference announcements and technical sessions covering Kamailio and open source RTC systems.
  • AstriCon - Conference for Asterisk and FreePBX developers and users.
  • CommCon - RTC and open-media community events with a technical talk archive.
  • OpenSIPS Summit - OpenSIPS community conferences with technical presentations and proceedings.
  • JanusCon - Conference proceedings and technical talks for Janus and WebRTC developers.
  • TADHack - Telecom application hackathons, demos and event announcements.

Related Lists / Media over QUIC

  • Awesome Asterisk (⭐13) - Asterisk tooling: ARI, AMI and AGI libraries, call audio streaming, voice AI and testing.
  • Awesome FreeSWITCH (⭐4) - FreeSWITCH tooling: Event Socket libraries, call audio streaming, distributions and monitoring.

21. Awesome Testing

Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

  • ShipShape (⭐0) - Open-source (MIT) Claude Code plugin that turns a plain-language goal into Playwright browser tests, runs each scenario twice to flag flaky results, and writes an offline HTML report with recorded video.

22. Collective Ai Tools

HealthCare

  • Telo - iPhone and Apple Watch health dashboard with optional read-only MCP access for authorized questions about synced sleep, activity, readiness scores, and health logs. #freemium #mcp

Music

  • AudioMIDI - Converts short melodies or solo-instrument audio into editable MIDI with browser note preview and export; no-signup Quick mode and three free Deep transcriptions per day. #free #music #midi

23. Awesome Rust

Applications / Audio and Music

  • openwave-studio/opendj (⭐221) - Fast, modern DJ and mixing app for macOS, Windows and Linux, with MIDI/HID controller support, stems, key lock, plugin hosting (CLAP/VST3/AU) and library import from rekordbox, VirtualDJ and djay Pro

Applications / Emulators

  • Gameboy
    • dquigles/terminal_gameboy (⭐82) [terminal_gameboy] - Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator that runs in the terminal, with ASCII and Unicode block rendering and sound
    • Gekkio/mooneye-gb (⭐972) - A Game Boy research project and emulator
    • joamag/boytacean (⭐683) - GameBoy Color emulator that runs on the Web using WebAssembly.
    • mohanson/gameboy (⭐1.4k) - Full featured Cross-platform GameBoy emulator. Forever boys!.
    • mvdnes/rboy (⭐667) - A Gameboy Emulator

Applications / Social networks

  • XMPP
    • lonewolf-im/lonewolf (⭐109) - A standalone XMPP server

Applications / Utilities

  • PaperPilot (⭐786) - Privacy-first, local document toolkit, WebAssembly engine, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server written in pure Rust.

Libraries / Home automation

  • mihai-dinculescu/tapo (⭐877) [tapo] - Client for TP-Link Tapo smart devices (plugs, lights, hubs, sensors and cameras), with Python bindings and an MCP server
entry.summary: 23 awesome list updated on Nov 17, 2026, including Awesome Game Remakes, Awesome Computational Biology, Awesome Appimage, Awesome Streaming, Android Security Awesome, Awesome Datascience, Awesome Deno, Awesome Go, Awesome Zig, Awesome Mac, Awesome Gemini Cli, Awesome Zsh Plugins, Awesome Mac, Magictools, Awesome Playcanvas, Awesome Flame, Awesome Iot, Free for Dev, Awesome Selfhosted, Awesome Rtc, Awesome Testing, Collective Ai Tools, Awesome Rust

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 16, 2026
entry.content:
1. Free for Dev

Email

  • addy.io - Open-source anonymous email forwarding, create unlimited email aliases for free

Tools for Teams and Collaboration

  • Notion - Notion is a note-taking and collaboration application with markdown support that integrates tasks, wikis, and databases. The company describes the app as an all-in-one workspace for note-taking, project management and task management. In addition to cross-platform apps, it can be accessed via most web browsers.
  • zoom - Secure Video and Web conferencing add-ons available. The free plan is limited to 40 minutes.

CDN and Protection

  • ovh - Free DDoS protection and SSL certificate

Managed Data Services

  • Raff - Managed PostgreSQL, MySQL and Valkey, 1 free database per account with no expiry, 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM and 2 GB storage (Valkey: 512 MB memory), 20 direct and 200 pooled connections on PostgreSQL, TLS on every database, pauses after 7 days without connections and resumes in about a minute. No egress fees.

IDE and Code Editing

  • Eclipse Che - Web-based and Kubernetes-Native IDE for Developer Teams with multi-language support. Open Source and community-driven. An online instance hosted by Red Hat is available at workspaces.openshift.com.

2. Public Apis

APIs Covered Under APILayer Suite!

  • Name: aamio

    Description: Ephemeral rendezvous for agents: expiring threads, receipts and an open board

    Auth: No

    Transport: HTTP

    Install: Glama

3. Awesome Pinned Gists

External Services

  • MapleStory-Pin-Box (⭐1) - Update a pinned gist to show your MapleStory (KMS) character's level, job, combat power, and server.

AI / Diagnostics

5. Awesome Research

Pomodoro / Enterprise Git Service

  • Yellow Tomato (Chrome,iOS): Pomodoro timer that blocks distracting sites and apps only during focus sessions, with a task list and focus stats [Free].

Writing / Social Sciences

  • research-kit (⭐0): Open command-line tools that check a paper before submission (references, numbers, anonymity, page limits), with a map of the best open projects for each stage of research.

Investigate Papers / HTML+CSS+JS

  • Lacuna: Search 2.3 million ML and AI papers, the researchers behind them, and the research directions they form; free, no account, with a read-only MCP server (⭐70) for AI assistants.

Open Science / HTML+CSS+JS

  • AutoResearch: Browser-based AI research system that connects literature exploration, research ideas, model implementation, GPU experiments and manuscript drafting. Private beta: apply on the site, wait for administrator approval, then set a password from the follow-up email and sign in; approved members receive 5,000 starter credits. Official pages say access is free during the beta, but this is a limited allowance, not unlimited use and not access without an account. Prices for future plans are not yet announced.

6. Awesome Algorithms

Cheat Sheet / YouTube Playlist

  • Rice university DS course in short

7. Awesome Theoretical Computer Science

Big Lists / Monograph

  • Error Correction Zoo - Catalog of classical and quantum error-correcting codes, organized by their relations, with references.

8. Awesome Blazor

Articles / Others

  • Promptless AI-First Blazor Apps - October 6, 2026 - Normally when we think about AI-based applications, we often think of chat-style apps. These apps consist mainly of a text box, some buttons to add context like images, and a button to start a conversation with an LLM model. However, we can talk about another type of AI-based applications, with a Promptless AI-First approach. Let’s see what it’s about. *Build Agentic UI with the new Blazor AI components - September 28, 2026 - Build Agentic UI with the new Blazor AI components for streamed content, tools, approvals, shared state, and generative experiences.

9. Awesome Open Source Games

Browser-Based / Arcade

  • XPilot TNG (⭐0) - Modernized SDL3 fork of the classic 90s multiplayer space combat game XPilot, featuring improved graphics, smartbots, and voice chat.

10. Awesome Talks

Polars plugins / Data Manipulation

12. Awesome Datascience

Datasets / Book Deals (Affiliated)

13. Awesome Go

Financial

Security

  • Quantum-Go (⭐1) - Post-quantum encrypted tunnels over TCP and UDP using a hybrid ML-KEM-1024 and X25519 handshake.

Web Frameworks

14. Awesome Mac

15. Awesome Gemini Cli

Commands & Extensions

Gemini CLI extension for the remote MCP server https://mcp.gitranks.com/mcp, with OAuth sign-in through GitHub and no API key. MIT. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/gitranks/contribute, then /mcp auth gitranks.

Development Tools & Utilities

  • tattlr (⭐0) - Local CLI that reads session logs from Gemini CLI and other coding agents, and can hook those agents to block risky tool calls before they run.

16. Awesome Zsh Plugins

Plugins / superconsole - Windows-only

  • git-sweep (⭐1) - Small ZSH plugin for cleaning up Git branches and worktrees, with protected branch patterns, dry-run previews, optional interactive selection, and explicit remote cleanup.

17. Magictools

Graphics / Spritesheet Tools

  • 💰 Gridwright - Pixel-art asset packs drawn on one grid, plus 31 browser tools for tilesets, maps, sprite sheets, effects and sound.

AI / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 Claude Game Studio - Claude Code plugin for making browser games: 10 tested genre starters, 123 models, 43 materials, 13 skies, and skills to design, build, playtest and fix. The kit is $29 a year; the pixel art maker, game idea generator and design document template on the site are free.

Collections / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 CSAF Sound Library - 13,315 royalty free game sound effects in 91 packs, WAV and OGG, with a free demo download. Every sound is synthesized in code with no samples or generative audio model; the code was written with AI tools.

18. Awesome Mac

Reading and Writing Tools / Others

  • SoloPDF - Local-first PDF reader and 20-tool offline document suite where highlights become plain Markdown notes, with on-device OCR, visual blink diff, and a 56-tool MCP server.

Design and Product / Screenshot Tools

  • AInnotator (⭐2) - Screenshot annotation tool that turns numbered marks, notes, and redactions into one self-explaining image to paste into Claude Code, Codex, or ChatGPT, including over SSH.

Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • Memozia (⭐0) - Open-source meeting recorder with on-device transcription, speaker labels, summaries, and editable action items.

Download Management Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • Multron Download Manager (⭐25) - Multi-connection download manager with yt-dlp and BitTorrent support.

Voice-to-Text / Audio Record and Process

  • Purr - Open-source on-device dictation that types into any app with Parakeet or Whisper, plus meeting notes with speaker labels and summaries.

Utilities / Clipboard Tools

  • Copia - Open-source clipboard history that keeps everything copied (text, rich text, links, colors, images, video, audio, files) and pastes several picked items at once in the order picked; a paste queue pastes copies one by one with ⌘V.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • Convrt (⭐5) - Offline menu bar file converter: hold Shift while dragging files and drop them on a wheel that only shows the formats and tools that fit them, with a command-line version.
  • SoundLadder (⭐1) - Menu bar app that picks the audio output from a ranked list and falls back to the next connected device automatically.

Utilities / File Organization Tools

  • neatly - AI file renamer that names downloads, screenshots and photos by their content, on-device with Apple Intelligence.

Utilities / Productivity

  • Scrollr (⭐2) - Open-source menu bar tool that reverses scroll direction for external mice only, so the trackpad keeps natural scrolling, with an on/off switch per mouse.

Utilities / Finder Tools

  • FileMint (⭐170) - Native Finder extension for creating files from the right-click menu with templates; free for personal and non-commercial use.

Utilities / Quality of Life Improvements

  • NotificationNanny - Moves and restyles notification banners and can replace the Notification Center panel with a customizable one.

19. Collective Ai Tools

App Builder

  • EveryApp - AI app builder that turns a plain-language description into your own private web app at its own address, shared with the people you invite. #freemium #nocode

Design

  • Cross-Stitch Studio - Turn photos into editable cross-stitch charts with DMC thread colors and optional AI photo preparation. #freemium #design

Developer Tools

  • No Stairs Please MCP - Remote MCP server for searching 2,200+ North American live-music venues, load-in stairs, drive-time routing, and booking contacts. #freemium #mcp
  • Sage (⭐1.2k) - Open-source agent harness with Desktop, Server and Python hosts, MCP tools, and task-feedback evaluation with user-selected version adoption; configured model providers may charge usage fees. #opensource #agents
  • Shazeus - Free English and Turkish directory of agent skills for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor with source repositories, pinned revisions, license links, and install commands. #free

E-Commerce

  • PlushSource MCP (⭐0) - MCP server that lets AI assistants search and compare the 55 custom plush manufacturers in the PlushSource directory (plushsource.com) by MOQ, lead time and OEM/ODM, with facts compiled from each manufacturer's website. #opensource #mcp #free

Psychology

  • Adoree - AI relationship assistant for couples where each partner talks privately, helping you both communicate without escalating. #freemium

Search Engine

  • search-console-mcp (⭐8) - Google Search Console for any MCP client - 30-second login, no Google Cloud project. Read-only. #opensource #mcp

Video

  • Twistavo - AI video studio to replace a person or character in an existing clip (Scene Recast) and run video and image models; monthly plans from $3.99. #paid

20. Awesome Rust

Development tools / Workflow Automation

  • mokevnin/heavy (⭐55) [heavy] - A machine-wide counting semaphore for heavy commands: tests, type checks and builds started by parallel coding agents and checkouts take turns instead of starving the machine

Development tools / Static analysis

  • mokevnin/easement (⭐57) [easement] - Architecture quality gate for polyglot codebases: declare components and their allowed dependencies, and fail the build when Go, TypeScript, Python, Rust, Java or other code drifts from them

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 15, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Ada

Questions and Answers

  • gitter-ada - Ada channel at Gitter.

Terminal User Interface / GPL (no linking exception)

  • ncurses-ada95 - Ada95 bindings for ncurses.

Logging / GPL (no linking exception)

  • prometheus-ada (⭐0) - Prometheus client library: counters, gauges, histograms with label escaping and a thread-safe exposition endpoint.
  • ratelimit-ada (⭐3) - Rate limiting primitives: token bucket and fixed window, zero dependencies.
  • backoff-ada (⭐0) - Retry backoff strategies: exponential with jitter, bounded caps.

Networking and Communication Middleware / GPL (no linking exception)

  • websocket-ada (⭐1) - WebSocket client library: RFC 6455 framing, ping/pong keepalive, automatic reconnect.
  • redis-ada (⭐0) - Redis client library: connection pooling, RESP protocol, pub/sub.

2. Awesome Quant

Trading & Backtesting

  • Kaspar-HFT (⭐43) - C++ Rust - Trading system and queue-exact order-book simulator on a C++20 actor framework; the same strategy runs in PCAP replay, paper trading and live, with CME MDP3 and iLink 3 handlers included.
  • TriDomainMoE - Python PyTorch MetaTrader 5 - Institutional multi-domain Mixture of Experts (MoE) trading architecture with Continuous Softmax CAW routing, zero-forgetting ReCAP continual adaptation, and sub-20ms MetaTrader 5 live execution. GitHub (⭐1)
  • QuantVibe (⭐3) - Python TypeScript - Qlib-based trading research platform with Alpha158 and LightGBM models, model-quality checks, SHA-256 signal checksums, a read-only MCP server, and MetaTrader 5 execution integration.
  • Backtest Integrity Guard (⭐0) - Python - Dependency-free CLI that audits OHLCV integrity, signal-to-execution causality, same-bar exit ambiguity, and frozen-input SHA256 manifests before backtest results are trusted.

Market Data & Data Sources

  • smv-eeff (⭐3) - Python Parquet Data - Normalized financial statements of 682 Peruvian companies supervised by the SMV, 2000-2026, with comparable concepts and standard ratios, validated against the regulator's own index.

Reproducing Works, Training & Books

  • QuantTrainer Stochastic Calculus Labs - Python Training Interviews - Step-by-step derivations in Portuguese of Itô's lemma, Girsanov's theorem and the Black-Scholes to heat equation reduction, with free browser simulators and Python scripts that verify each result numerically. GitHub (⭐1)

3. Awesome Webgl

Bug Reporting

  • Chrome Bug Report - Chrome related bugs
  • WebKit Bugzilla - Safari related bugs

GLSL Editors

  • GLSL Sandbox - Online live editor for fragment shaders.
  • ShaderExpo - Dependency free shader editor featuring inline error logs, auto completions, models and textures loading.
  • WebGL Playground - The editor lets you work on the JavaScript code and the GLSL vertex/fragment shaders (if you have any) at the same time in a convenient way. Everything is organized, formatted and highlighted properly, just as you would like.

References

  • Khronos Official Wiki - The official wiki for WebGL.
  • WebGL Errata - Known bugs in graphics drivers affect the conformance suite, and consequently, portability of code.
  • WebGL Extensions - List of extensions for WebGL
  • WebGL Spec Sheet - All the detailed information about WebGL.

Talks

  • List of Presentations - List presented by Khronos of various WebGL related presentations.

Tools/Debugging

  • WebGL Report - Way to view the details of what your browser supports for WebGL.
  • WebGL Support Stats - Interactive dashboard showing the support for WebGL features in different browsers and devices.

Tools/Debugging / Chrome Specific Tools/Debugger

  • Spector.js Extension - Explore and Troubleshoot your WebGL and WebGL2 scenes easily.

Tools/Debugging / Firefox Specific Tools/Debugger

  • Firefox Developer Tools - The official list of all of Firefox's debugger tools.

Tutorials / Firefox Specific Tools/Debugger

  • Directional Shadow Mapping - Concepts behind real time directional light shadow mapping.
  • Get Started Tutorial - Khronos' tutorial how to get up and running with WebGL.
  • Multitexturing using a Blendmap - How to use a blendmap to multitexture a terrain.
  • Particle Effects via Billboards - Create particle effects by applying a technique called billboarding.
  • WebGL Workshop - Interactive workshop to get you up and running with WebGL.

References / Firefox Specific Tools/Debugger

  • WebGL 2 Spec Sheet (Editor Draft) - All the detailed information about WebGL 2.
  • Immersive Web Community Group - Group whose goal is to help bring high-performance Virtual Reality and Augmented Reality to the open Web.

Engines and Frameworks / Firefox Specific Tools/Debugger

  • ClayGL - WebGL graphic Library for building scalable Web3D applications.

2D / Firefox Specific Tools/Debugger

  • PixiJS - powerful 2D Javascript renderer based on WebGL.

Low-level Rendering / Firefox Specific Tools/Debugger

  • Regl - Light declarative and stateless library, functional abstraction for WebGL.

Math / Firefox Specific Tools/Debugger

  • glMatrix - Javascript matrix and vector library for high performance WebGL apps.

Maps and Visualizations / Firefox Specific Tools/Debugger

  • Cesium - Open-source library for world-class 3D globes and maps.

Legacy / Unmaintained / Firefox Specific Tools/Debugger

  • React 360 (⭐8.7k) - Build VR websites and interactive 360 experiences with React (archived by Facebook).

Community / Firefox Specific Tools/Debugger

  • Twitter / X
  • Khronos Forum
  • Active Meetup Groups
    • San Francisco, CA
    • Mountain View, CA
    • London, United Kingdom
    • New York, NY

4. Discount for Student Dev

SaaS

  • Recordist [DISCOUNT] - Records and transcribes lectures and calls on your own devices, and recording, transcription and search stay free. Confirm a college or university email for 14 days of Pro and a student discount on Pro.

Lists and trackers

  • StudentStack [FREE] - A dated tracker of student discounts on AI and dev tools, free tiers, AI credits, hackathons and free AI tools. Each entry is checked against the company's own page. Closed offers stay on the list, crossed out. Includes a UK-eligibility page.

5. Awesome Naming

Tools, Applications, Libraries, Frameworks

  • ratatui - A framework for creating TUIs. Also a pun on the movie Ratatouille about a chef rat, which is itself a pun on the french vegetable dish Ratatouille.

6. Open Source Flutter Apps

Productivity

  • ManaWG - Self-hostable shared-flat app with expense splitting, a cleaning rota, shopping list, calendar, notice board and chat. (Source (⭐1))

Developer Tools

  • Kaeso - MIT-licensed, self-hosted AI gateway in Rust, with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, SSO, budgets and request logs. (Source (⭐6))

7. Public Apis

APIs Covered Under APILayer Suite!

  • Name: Bewary

    Description: Scam checks for links, domains, phone numbers, emails, wallets and IBANs before an agent acts

    Auth: OAuth

    Transport: HTTP

    Install: Glama · MCP Registry

Anti-Malware

  • API: Bewary

    Description: Scam checks for links, domains, phone numbers, emails, crypto wallets and IBANs

    Auth: apiKey

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: No

Calendar

  • API: Kalenderblick

    Description: Public holidays and school holidays for Germany, Austria and Switzerland as static JSON

    Auth: No

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: Yes

Cryptocurrency

  • API: Cosmos Pay

    Description: Stablecoin payment links, checkout and swaps on Stellar, Solana and Monad

    Auth: apiKey

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: No

Development

  • API: QR Kept

    Description: Free QR code API: one GET request returns an SVG, no key or account

    Auth: No

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: Yes

Entertainment

  • API: Green Screen Memes

    Description: Search 2,000+ green screen meme video clips, most with sound, new clips daily

    Auth: apiKey

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: No

Security

  • API: openshield

    Description: Image and text moderation, plus fraud scoring for sign-ups, logins and payments

    Auth: apiKey

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: No

Video

  • API: VidSmaller

    Description: Compress videos to an exact target file size, with estimates and async jobs

    Auth: apiKey

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: Yes

8. Awesome Neovim

Note Taking / Cursorline

  • xheisenbugx/org.nvim (⭐132) - Fully-featured reimplementation of Emacs' org-mode.

9. Awesome Go

Utilities

  • topic (⭐3) - Top-like terminal monitor for containers that shows CPU, memory, GPU and process usage against the container's cgroup limits.

10. Awesome Gemini Cli

Commands & Extensions

  • Telegram Bot UI (⭐11) - Agent Skill that runs in Gemini CLI (from ~/.agents/skills/ or ~/.gemini/skills/) and other agents. Makes Telegram bots look and feel like real products: messages, keyboards, buttons, navigation, streaming AI replies with Stop, HTML widgets and premium emoji; also audits an existing bot's interface. Ships an offline Bot API catalog and is updated with every new Bot API release. Install with python scripts/install.py --host gemini from a clone. MIT.
  • AI Agent Templates (⭐2) - Hundreds of MIT-licensed skills, subagents, custom commands, MCP setups and GEMINI.md rules in Gemini CLI's own file layout (500 templates in all, also for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Copilot), installable with npx workspacetemplates add <name> --tool gemini-cli.

11. Free for Dev

APIs, Data, and ML

  • CurrencyBeacon - Realtime currency data API for fintech apps. The free plan includes 5,000 calls per month.
  • CustomJS - HTML to PDF or PDF to PNG/Text & PDF merging/extraction/merging APIs. Free tier has 600 calls a month.

Tools for Teams and Collaboration

  • Stoat - An OpenSource alternative forDiscord, that respects your privacy. It also have most proprietary features from discord for free. Stoat is a all in one application that is secure and fast, while being 100% free. every features are free. They also have (official & unofficial) plugins support unlike most main-stream chatting applications.

Code Quality

  • SonarQube Cloud - Automated source code analysis for Java, JavaScript, C/C++, C#, VB.NET, PHP, Objective-C, Swift, Python, Groovy and even more languages, free for Open Source

CI and CD

  • Stategraph - GitOps-first Terraform automation with pull request-driven workflows, project isolation via self-hosted runners, and layered runs for ordered operations. Free for up to 3 users.

Authentication, Authorization, and User Management

  • Hexclave - Open-source authentication that doesn't suck. The most developer-friendly solution, getting you started in just five minutes. Self-hostable for free, or offers a managed SaaS version with 10k free Monthly Active Users.

Monitoring

  • Pingzen - Free uptime and API monitoring with up to 55 monitors, 1-minute check intervals, and instant alerts.

Education and Career Development

  • Cisco Networking Academy - Offers free certification-aligned courses in topics like cybersecurity, networking, and Python.

Email

  • Mailkube - Email infrastructure for developers, 4,000 emails/month free, unlimited domains included

Forms

  • Backforms - Multi-channel headless form backend offering 300 submissions per month, spam protection, and instant alerts via WhatsApp (BYOK), Telegram, Discord, and email on the free plan.

Web Hosting

  • readthedocs.com - Free documentation hosting with versioning, PDF generation, and more

DNS

  • nip.io - Free DNS service that when queried with a hostname with an embedded IP address returns that IP address.

IaaS

  • Out Plane - Cloud sandboxes for coding agents (Hangars) plus app hosting in Germany. Free: Hangars, cloud machines where agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor run, with no credit card required; the agent uses your own plan or API key. App hosting is paid, from $9/month with a 14-day free trial.

Managed Data Services

  • SeaTable - Flexible, Spreadsheet-like Database built by the Seafile team. unlimited tables, 2,000 lines, 1-month versioning, up to 25 team members.

Storage and Media Processing

  • We.Team - Encrypt, share, copy, and move all your cloud storage files from one place. The basic plan provides unlimited file transfer with 250 MB max. file size and allows five encrypted files

Design and UI

  • Canva - Create product mockups, 200 free mockups.

IDE and Code Editing

  • cocalc.ai - Collaborative calculation in the cloud. Browser access to full Ubuntu with built-in collaboration and lots of free software for mathematics, science, data science, preinstalled: Python, LaTeX, Jupyter Notebooks, SageMath, scikitlearn, etc.

Analytics, Events and Statistics

  • FiveTran - Reverse ETL & Operational Analytics Platform. Sync 10 fields from your data warehouse to 60+ SaaS like Salesforce, Zendesk, or Amplitude.
  • Row Zero - Blazingly fast, connected spreadsheet. Connect directly to data databases, S3, and APIs. Import, analyze, graph, and share millions of rows instantly. Three free (forever) workbooks.

12. Awesome Mac

Reading and Writing Tools / Markdown Tools

  • Downright - Native, open-source Markdown reader and editor for ordinary files, with Quick Look previews, Finder thumbnails, and live reload when another app or agent changes the file.

Reading and Writing Tools / Writing

  • Rewrite - Rewrite text, fix grammar, and edit Word, LaTeX and PDF files.

Reading and Writing Tools / Others

  • HistCite Mac (⭐2) - Open-source bibliometric analysis and citation network visualization for Web of Science exports.

Developer Tools / Frameworks For Hybrid Applications

  • MyPack - Turn websites into desktop apps for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

Terminal Apps / Databases

  • Cyberdog - SSH and SFTP client with a built-in terminal, a server health dashboard and FTP, S3 and WebDAV support.

Design and Product / Other Tools

  • Louppe - Photo and video viewer and sorter for browsing JPEG, RAW, and video folders, choosing keepers with the keyboard, and copying them without a library import.

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • Tendbar (⭐2) - Native menu bar app that shows which Claude Code sessions are done, waiting for you or failed, jumps back to the right terminal tab, and tracks usage limits for every account.
  • JoeBro - Native SwiftUI workspace for chat and document editing with local models via Ollama or any API, plus memory, MCP tools, and deep research.
  • kwant - Self-hosted team of AI bots in one Rust binary, with spaces, local models, handoffs and approvals.

Voice-to-Text / Audio Record and Process

  • Earshot (⭐16) - Menu bar app that transcribes the audio of any app you pick, fully on-device, with speaker names in Microsoft Teams.

Utilities / Productivity

  • Keylane (⭐3) - Source-available keyboard launcher for macOS 26+ with app and file search, clipboard history, and system actions.
  • Trace (⭐8) - Automatic time tracker that records apps, windows, files, and web pages, with all data kept on your Mac.

13. Awesome Testing

Software / Service Virtualization

  • atrezzo (⭐1) - Claude Code plugin that serves API mocks as deterministic projections of one seeded data set and checks the rendered DOM against a YAML scenario.

14. Collective Ai Tools

Audio & Speech

  • SFXMint - CC0 library of 10,300+ AI-generated or synthesized sound effects for games, apps and videos, with a JSON API and MCP server. #freemium #mcp

Avatars

  • FotoApta - Generates professional AI portraits from one selfie, with a free watermarked preview and an optional one-time HD pack. #freemium

Developer Tools

  • Atlas Cloud - AI API gateway with one API key for LLM, image, video and audio models, including an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint. #paid #api #llm
  • CloudGPU - Per-minute GPU rental and an OpenAI-compatible model API, plus an MCP server that quotes a job and starts it only after confirmation. #paid #mcp #api
  • Kling AI MCP - Connect AI agents to Kling image/video generation via the Global plugin MCP endpoint; OAuth and paid personal credits required. Setup guide. #paid #mcp
  • OpenHands (⭐93k) - Open-source platform for autonomous AI software development agents that can write code, fix bugs, and run shell commands. #free #opensource
  • Vectoree - Hosted backend for coding agents with one project key for models from xAI, OpenAI, Google, Anthropic and DeepSeek through an OpenAI-compatible gateway, plus auth, Postgres, object storage, a CLI and an agent skill, billed pay-as-you-go. #paid #api #llm

Finance

  • BeliefState - Gives AI assistants dated, source-linked investor theses, catalysts, risks and revisions through a research API and hosted MCP. Company coverage is free to check. #freemium #mcp #research

Image Classification

  • SightRadar Face Recognition API MCP - Official MCP server for the SightRadar face recognition API: index photos, find every photo of a person from one selfie, and compare or detect faces from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code. Add https://mcp.sightradar.com/mcp as an MCP server, or run it locally with npx. #paid #mcp #opensource

Image Editing

  • Nano Banana (nanobananana.com) - Independent third-party image creation tool for text-to-image generation, natural-language reference image editing, and multi-image blending, with a Chinese interface. #freemium
  • RemixThatPhoto - Edits a photo from a reference image or a written instruction for targeted changes. #freemium

Resume

  • Resume Claim Guard (⭐1) - Open-source agent skill that writes a job-tailored resume from confirmed facts only, then audits claims and previews interview follow-ups. #free #opensource

SEO

  • Verand - Writes articles from your own expertise, blocks non-compliant claims before they publish, and tracks your rankings and mentions in AI answers. #paid #seo

Social Media

  • Wavegrain - Curated slideshows and carousels for your brand on autopilot: writes TikTok slideshows and Instagram carousels in your brand's voice, then schedules and posts them; hosted MCP server for AI agents. #social-media #mcp

Summarizer

  • Glasp - Browser extension and web app that shows YouTube video transcripts with AI summaries and highlights web pages and PDFs. #freemium
  • YouTube Transcript: AI Summary & Chat - Chrome extension that shows a YouTube video as a timestamped transcript, with key points and chat about the video. Free AI credits available. #freemium #video

Video

  • ToHD - Free AI video upscaler that runs in the browser on your own GPU (WebGPU): turns 360p/480p clips into 720p or 1080p without uploading them, no signup, no watermark. #freemium #video

15. Awesome Rust

Applications

  • vey-proxy (⭐51) - Modular async Rust proxy daemon unifying HTTP/SOCKS forward proxying, HTTP/TLS reverse proxying, TPROXY/SNI transparent proxying, TCP/UDP/TLS stream proxying, dynamic egress routing, TLS/ICAP inspection, and hot reloads.

Development tools / Embedded

  • Internationalization
    • AlixANNERAUD/embedded_i18n (⭐1) [embedded-i18n] - Compile-time i18n for no_std firmware: translations from JSON, YAML, TOML, gettext PO/MO or Fluent files compiled into &'static str literals in flash, with plurals, fallbacks and no allocator.

Libraries / Parsing

  • AlixANNERAUD/nanoexpr (⭐2) [nanoexpr] - Fast no_std math expression parser and evaluator with zero heap allocation: variables, functions, f32/f64/integers or exact decimals, for microcontrollers, WebAssembly and C.

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 14, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Quant

Trading & Backtesting

  • TRA (bitra) (⭐47) - Python MCP - Autonomous trading system for crypto perpetuals, spot, tokenized stocks and prediction markets in which language models only propose and deterministic rules decide: code computes every figure, prices the full round trip before an order exists, sizes from the operator's risk at the stop, keeps exits at the exchange, and records each cycle with a per-file SHA-256 that can be re-verified.

Market Data & Data Sources

  • Gloom - TypeScript Bun - Open-source finance terminal for quotes, charts, news, filings and portfolios, as a terminal UI, desktop app and web app. GitHub (⭐2.7k)

2. Awesome Privacy

Notes and Tasks / Useful Tools

  • AFFiNE - Local-first knowledge base that keeps docs, a whiteboard and databases on your device, as an alternative to Notion and Miro. ⚠️ source-available ⚠️ telemetry opt-out ⚠️ website trackers

3. FOSS for Dev

File Management

  • Glim (⭐37) - MIT-licensed macOS file viewer for Markdown, source code, JSON and CSV, with read-only PDF/Office previews and basic UTF-8 text editing.

4. Awesome Neovim

Programming Languages Support / Diagnostics

  • anirbanchakraborty-dev/swara (⭐0) - LilyPond support with its own Tree-sitter grammar and LSP server.

Utility / Cursorline

  • leblocks/treetags.nvim (⭐1) - Fast, Tree-sitter-based code tags and symbol navigation.

5. Awesome Game Remakes

Adventure

  • HPEngine (⭐8) - Engine reimplementation of Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (PC, KnowWonder, 2001) that runs the game's own UnrealScript; native on Macs, Windows, Linux and Steam Deck. Requires the original game files.

6. Awesome Appimage

AppImage discovery / App catalogs

  • Get AppImage - Collection of all AppImages in one website. Great search functionality.

AppImage developer tools / Deployment tools for Windows applications

  • GameImage (⭐348) - Is a way to package up games with either Wine or an Emulator into a portable AppImage that could be useful for the Steam Deck.

7. Awesome Python

Projects / File Manipulation

  • Compression
    • compression.zstd - (Python standard library) Compress and decompress data in the Zstandard format.
    • gzip - (Python standard library) Read and write gzip-compressed files and data.
    • zstandard (⭐648) - Python bindings to the Zstandard (zstd) compression library.
    • brotli (⭐15k) - Python bindings for Google's Brotli compression library.
    • lz4 (⭐305) - Python bindings for the LZ4 fast compression library.
  • Archives
    • tarfile - (Python standard library) Read and write tar archives, including gzip, bz2, lzma, and zstd compressed ones.
    • zipfile - (Python standard library) Read and write ZIP archives.
    • py7zr (⭐560) - A pure-Python library for reading and writing 7-Zip archives.
    • pyzipper (⭐145) - Read and write AES-encrypted ZIP files (zipfile fork).
    • rarfile (⭐268) - A RAR archive reader with a zipfile-like API.

8. Awesome Go

Hardware

  • ctm (⭐0) - Control Time Machines Corp. PoE network clocks from the command line: status, timers, colors, and brightness over UDP.

Dependency Injection

  • vessel (⭐0) - Generics-based dependency injection container with constructor injection, value groups, scopes and service lifecycle management.

Translation

  • go-translator (⭐14) - Gettext PO catalogues with plural forms, contexts and html/template helpers.

Security

  • ITB (⭐11) - Experimental symmetric cipher construction with Lean 4 formal proofs of its design.

Template Engines

  • go-partial (⭐24) - Render full pages or targeted partials from one html/template tree, for htmx, Turbo and Unpoly.

Utilities

  • go-importmap (⭐17) - Generate import maps and stylesheet tags for Go templates from CDN packages, with optional vendoring.

9. Awesome Go

Utilities / File Handling

  • gen2brain/go-unarr (⭐309) — Decompression library bindings ☆312

10. Awesome Mac

Networking / Download Tools

  • conrader/plainsay (⭐14) — Native Mac dictation in a 12 MB download. Free Local mode with ☆23

System Tools / System Utilities

  • Kanevry/tethercam (⭐16) — Use your iPhone as a USB camera for Mac video calls and OBS. Two ☆18

11. Awesome Gemini Cli

Commands & Extensions

  • OsmO Phone Calls (⭐1) - Gemini CLI extension (GEMINI.md context + the remote MCP server https://api.getosmo.app/mcp) that has OsmO's voice AI phone businesses or helplines after you confirm, and returns the summary and transcript. OAuth sign-in with a phone number, no API key. 50 free credits for new users in the US, Canada, UK and Australia; paid after. With free credits, OsmO calls businesses and toll-free numbers; calling your contacts and scheduling calls need an OsmO app plan. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/Mountainheads-Private-limited/osmo-ai-plugins.

Development Tools & Utilities

  • ctx-receipt (⭐2) - Shows what Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Cursor pre-load into context before your first prompt: GEMINI.md and its imports, skills, and MCP servers, as token estimates. Includes a CI budget check and a GitHub Action.

12. Awesome Iot

Software / Miscellaneous

  • MatterCatalog - Free catalog of Matter smart home devices sold in the US: each model checked against the CSA certification ledger, with its network (Thread or Wi-Fi), the platforms it works with and a free JSON API.

13. Free for Dev

Email

  • Alias Email - Free 10 Bump email addresses, one custom domain
  • UserCheck - Prevent users to sign up with temporary email addresses, 120 requests/hour (~86,400 per month)

Forms

  • WaiverCat - Electronic Signature platform with a REST API. You can receive notifications with webhooks. Free plan watermarks signed documents but allow unlimited envelopes + signatures.

14. Awesome Mac

Reading and Writing Tools / Office

  • Keynote - Build stunning presentations.
  • Numbers - Create impressive spreadsheets.
  • Pages - Documents that stand apart.

Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

  • arowser (⭐0) - Agent-programmable borderless web windows for macOS, driven by a CLI designed for coding agents.

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • AppleAi (⭐143) - Access multiple AI assistants from your menu bar with one shortcut.
  • BaseHalf - Open-source desktop app that opens a folder as a canvas of notes, PDFs and media, with AI agents like Claude Code or Codex working on the same files beside it.

Communication / Collaboration and Team Tools

  • Textual (⭐1.9k) - Internet Relay Chat (IRC) client.
  • WhatsApp Desktop - Available in the Mac App Store, Whatsapp for Desktop.

Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

  • Roughcut (⭐0) - Turns a folder of talking-head footage into a rough cut in Final Cut Pro, with on-device Whisper transcription and cuts chosen by a local or cloud AI model.
  • YouTube Music (⭐34k) - Desktop player for YouTube Music with plugin support.

Browsers / Audio Record and Process

  • Ora (⭐2.2k) - Open-source browser with spaces, tab management, and a vertical sidebar.

Finance / Audio Record and Process

  • MRRDock (⭐8) - Menu bar app that adds up your MRR from Stripe, RevenueCat, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Dodo Payments and Gumroad into one total. Multi-currency, keys stay in the Keychain, no account.

Security Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • Mana Security (⭐28) - vulnerability management app for individuals.
  • Vigie (⭐0) - Open-source blue team tool that runs Sigma detection rules on the macOS unified log, Windows event logs and Linux auth.log, live or on collected files, and writes a report mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

Proxy and VPN Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • Vafa (⭐1) - Open-source VPN kill switch that freezes chosen apps and blocks their network until a VPN with an allowed exit country is up.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • Lafz Prompter - Teleprompter that sits under the MacBook notch, can hide from screen sharing, scrolls as you speak, and shows Urdu in Nastaliq.
  • Mask This (⭐23) - Menu bar app that masks sensitive information in the clipboard.
  • Sheer (⭐0) - Brings the macOS 26-style transparent menu bar to macOS 15, letting the wallpaper show through with a faint legibility gradient.

Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall

  • MacClean (⭐2) - Free local Mac disk cleaner that lets you review WeChat media, System Data, and Xcode or AI caches before deleting.
  • MacSweep (⭐2) - Free, open-source Mac cleaner written in Rust (~7 MB) for junk cleanup, large files, app uninstalling with leftovers and orphaned launch agents, with tests ensuring browser profiles, Mail and app data are never deleted.
  • Purge (⭐1.5k) - Open-source cache cleaner that moves files to the Trash instead of deleting them, using a fixed allowlist and no telemetry.

Utilities / Productivity

  • Perplexity - Search and discovery with AI.
  • SwiftBiu - Text productivity tool with a customizable action bar and AI extensions.
  • Takeline (⭐1) - Fork of Textream that follows your voice in French and English entirely on the Mac, with retake detection and voice commands.

Utilities / System Related Tools

  • LD Manager - Open-source launchd manager that shows every LaunchAgent and LaunchDaemon, explains why a job isn't running, and edits plists losslessly with diffs and backups.

15. Awesome Testing

Software / AI & LLM Testing

  • agentest (⭐2) - Open-source CLI that runs 130 deterministic checks on recorded OpenTelemetry GenAI traces, A2A agent cards and MCP tool lists, offline and without an LLM judge, and exports JUnit or SARIF for CI.

16. Awesome Agriculture

Automation and Robotics

  • Feldfreund Dev Kit (⭐11) - Open source development platform for autonomous outdoor robotics and agricultural weeding.
  • Field Mission Planner (⭐5) - Open-source spraying route planner for ArduPilot drones (coverage routes around obstacles, MAVLink upload, offline).
  • ROS Agriculture - Open Source community focusing on using Robot Operating System to empower farmers with robotics tools.

Calculators

  • CoverCalc Pro Landscape Quantity Kit (⭐0) - MIT-licensed offline browser checker for landscape volumes and whole-bag counts.
  • Direct Beef Tools (⭐0) - Browser-only worksheet for comparing another-sale net value with direct-to-customer beef break-even and target prices.
  • flower-farm-math (⭐0) - Zero-dependency JavaScript library for flower farm and farmer-florist math: wedding stem counts, costs-up CSA bouquet pricing, and a bloom-to-sales weekly reconciliation of stems cut vs. promised by variety.
  • mycro-grow (⭐0) - JavaScript library and CLI for gourmet mushroom cultivation math: substrate hydration, spawn ratio, biological-efficiency yield, and batch economics.
  • yard-material-coverage-data (⭐1) - Open landscape material coverage, density, and bag conversion data with a reusable calculator component.

Crop Modeling, Phenotyping, and Pathology

  • Open Plant Pathology - A community that values open data and computational tools for advancing epidemiology and pathogen population biology and ecology.

Research and General Data

  • Furrow - Farmland prices in 37 countries on 6 continents from national statistics.
  • Robot Lawn Mower Specs - CC BY 4.0 dataset of robotic mower specifications with cited sources and CSV/JSON downloads.
  • SoybeanYield (⭐162) - A multimodal agricultural dataset for soybean yield forecasting, integrating yield performance, management practices, weather data, and soil parameters.

Regional Data / India

  • India Agri Export Price Index - Weekly reference prices for Indian agri exports (USD/kg from UN Comtrade, INR/quintal mandi prices from Agmarknet) with sources, an append-only history and CSV/JSON downloads.
  • India Land Data (⭐1) - Official land-record portals for 11 Indian states and Indian land area units (gunta, bigha, kanal and others) with state variations, as CC BY 4.0 JSON.
  • VarshaKrishi Field NDVI - One year of Sentinel-2 NDVI for a farm field near Katol, India, with field-level cloud and haze flags (CC BY 4.0, CSV/JSON).

Regional Data / United States

  • massachusetts-frost-dates-zones (⭐0) - CC BY 4.0 CSV datasets of Massachusetts frost dates from NOAA normals and USDA hardiness zones for towns and villages.
  • US Farmers Market Statistics - USDA-derived state-by-state farmers market counts and SNAP/EBT and organic-vendor statistics, with CC BY 4.0 CSV/JSON downloads.
  • USDA Market Prices - Daily USDA boxed beef, pork and fed cattle prices by cut and region, with history since 2020 and free CSV downloads, in English and Spanish.

Data Standardization, Interoperability and APIs / United States

  • Agro GPS MCP (⭐0) - MCP server exposing the official plant protection product registers of 30 European countries (authorisation status, active substances, authorised uses per crop) to AI assistants; free, no key.
  • ClearAg API Examples (⭐2) - A collection of code examples using the ClearAg APIs.
  • ISO-15143-3-API-OAuth2-CSharp-Example (⭐0) - C# example for the John Deere ISO 15143-3 machine data API.
  • Open Agri Common Semantic Model (OCSM) (⭐7) - Ontology reusing existing standards to support semantic interoperability across smart farming solutions.
  • Open-Agriculture - Free and open source ISOBUS (ISO 11783) tools, including the AgIsoStack++ library, a Virtual Terminal, a DDOP editor and a VT object pool designer.
  • OperationsCenterAPI-OAuth2-Java-Example (⭐3) - Java example for the John Deere Operations Center API.
  • OperationsCenterAPI-OAuth2-NodeJS-Example (⭐3) - Node.js example for the John Deere Operations Center API.
  • OperationsCenterAPI-OAuth2-Python-Example (⭐22) - Python example for the John Deere Operations Center API.
  • Tilth - Free daily UK fertiliser price index API for nine grades, CC BY 4.0 licensed.
  • Trefle (⭐589) - Open source botanical REST API for querying plant species, taxonomy, and growing information.

Farm Management Systems and Record Keeping / United States

  • GrowerHub (⭐7) - Greenhouse and small-farm management with Zigbee2MQTT monitoring, plant and watering journals, and lighting and irrigation automation.
  • HortusFox (⭐1.7k) - Self-hosted collaborative plant management system with plant records, care tasks, inventory, photos, and a calendar.
  • Plant-it (⭐1.4k) - Android gardening companion for logging plant care, keeping photos, and setting reminders.
  • Soil Mate (⭐29) - Helper app designed to assist the collection of soil data.
  • Tania (⭐825) - Free and open source farming management system for everyone built with Go and Vue.js.

GIS Platforms / United States

  • AI Segmentation by TerraLab (⭐45) - QGIS imagery segmentation plugin with local interactive processing and optional hosted processing with free-tier limits.

IoT, Hardware / United States

  • AgOpenGPS (⭐984) - Ag precision mapping and section control software.

Machine Learning and AI / United States

  • HealthyCropping (⭐4) - Android crop disease diagnosis application in development, using on-device computer vision for offline use.

Remote Sensing and Imagery / United States

  • Awesome Sentinel (⭐587) - A curated list of awesome tools, tutorials and APIs related to data from the Copernicus Sentinel Satellites.

17. Awesome Rust

Applications / Productivity

  • ChrisVip001/joyczl-agent (⭐112) - Local-first personal agent: Rust owns the agent loop, memory and tools, and stores one append-only ledger row per turn, so every memory is inspectable and the FTS5 index can be rebuilt from the ledger. TypeScript dashboard, Python SDK.
  • madebyzan/knovum (⭐34) - Local-first desktop 2D spatial AI knowledge workspace built with Tauri 2, Rust, and Vue 3, featuring infinite canvas, embedded LanceDB vector search, and on-device Whisper transcription.

Applications / Security tools

  • nestho/impacket-rs (⭐90) - Memory-safe pure-Rust implementation of enterprise network protocols (SMB, MSRPC, Kerberos, LDAP, NTLM) and Active Directory auditing tools.
  • offseq/threat-finder (⭐66) [threat-finder] - Runtime vulnerability scanner that finds CVEs in the services actually running on a host and ranks them by network exposure

Applications / Workflow Automation

  • julianosig/easi.run (⭐83) - Self-hosted Chrome for AI agents via MCP/REST, with live viewing and human takeover. AGPL-3.0-only.

Libraries / Data processing

  • sshaplygin/ytsaurus-rs (⭐5) [ytsaurus-yson] - Rust clients for YTsaurus: HTTP API v4 and RPC proxy (dynamic tables through one interface), YSON and Skiff codecs, and a runtime for MapReduce workers

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 13, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Bigdata

SQL-like processing

  • Timeplus Proton (⭐2.3k) - streaming SQL engine in a single C++ binary, powered by ClickHouse, for streaming ETL, windowed aggregations, joins and materialized views over Kafka and other sources.
  • Opteryx - hosted single-node SQL engine that queries Parquet and JSONL files where they live (GCS, S3, HTTP), with Iceberg and PostgreSQL sources.

Distributed Tracing Platform

  • Zipkin - Zipkin is a distributed tracing system. It helps gather timing data needed to troubleshoot latency problems in service architectures. Features include both the collection and lookup of this data.

Interesting Readings

  • WebSocket fan-out with Redis pub/sub - Practical guide to sharing one upstream data stream across services, with subscription budgets, last-value caching and reconnect handling.

2. Free Programming Books (Japanese)

JavaScript / Svelte

  • Svelte Tutorial - Svelte.dev

Julia / Vue.js

  • Julia Language Programming - 広井誠

3. Awesome Machine Learning

Python / General-Purpose Machine Learning

  • eigenkit (⭐25) - Quantum machine learning in Python: hybrid quantum neural networks as PyTorch modules and quantum kernel models (QSVC/QSVR) with a scikit-learn API, run on PennyLane, Qiskit, CUDA-Q and other simulators or on IBM, IQM and Amazon Braket QPUs.

4. Static Analysis

Multiple languages / Other

  • TencentCodeAnalysis ⚠️ — Tencent Cloud Code Analysis (TCA for short, code-named CodeDog inside the company early) is a comprehensive platform for code analysis and issue tracking. TCA consist of three components, server, web and client. It integrates of a number of self-developed tools, and also supports dynamic integration of code analysis tools in various programming languages.

5. Awesome V

Web

  • swelte (⭐4) - "V in Svelte" - SvelteKit equivalent using V as backend and isomorphic code.
  • viltrum (⭐49) - Web framework with its own HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, WebSocket and TLS 1.3 engine, zero allocations per request.

6. Awesome Billing

Basics

  • Billing systems are a nightmare for engineers - There is a shadow army of billing software engineers behind the biggest companies of the world. Here they share their nightmare stories.
  • How to recruit software engineers in this domain? “The trick is to make the accounting/billing/payment department the antechamber of data engineering.” — me, 2021-08-03

Pricing / Usage-based Pricing

  • “Billing is not complex on purpose: it's the price to pay for elasticity.” — me, 2020-01-06. Or why you're likely to get an endless stream of complaining users if choosing utility pricing scheme: while accurate to the (milli-)cent, this model is frustrating for customers not ready to invest time grasping the underlying concepts.
  • Billing pipeline: a critical time sensitive system - Design notes on Scaleway's billing pipeline, built to “track nano-euros at the milli-seconds time granularity”. My takeaways: get the current time from one central method, randomize the order of the tests, and do not deploy in the first days of the month, when the accounting reports are produced.

Calculator / Market Research

  • Cloudorado - 💸 A comparison matrix which use ECU (Amazon's vCPU) as a CPU power measure unit. Operated by Cloudorado as a commercial cloud-comparison product.

Payments / Electronic invoices

  • Whop - Platform to accept payments, manage subscriptions and sell software, services or digital products worldwide, at competitive fees. Partner link: the sponsor of this list earns a commission from Whop, at no extra cost to you.
  • How ACH works: A developer perspective, part 1, part 2, part 3, part 4, part 5.

Payments / Online Payments

  • UPI 101: The Basics - “In this article, we will learn about India's Unified Payments Interface. A four-year-old payment scheme that has been accounting for 40-45% of digital payments across India.”
  • The untold story of Stripe - In which we learn that “once turnover hit a certain level, Paypal automatically put the business on a 21 to 60 day rolling reserve, meaning that up to 30 per cent of a company's revenue could be locked up for up to two months.”

Fraud / Statistics

  • JPMorgan Chase v. Javice - Like Benford's law, applied to Excel: “JPMC first noticed irregularities with the list when a JPMC employee observed that the list contained exactly 1,048,576 rows, the maximum permitted by Microsoft Excel.” A count that stops at the limit of a tool is a sign of truncated or made-up data. Here, the executives of a startup sold for $175 million had bought that list of customers from a marketing firm.

Business Intelligence / Metrics

  • Thinking about growth and profit - Discuss the relationship between investments, profit and growth, and how it influence decisions on pricing, free trials and plan structure.

History / Cloud providers

  • Payroll consolidation, circa 1965 - A program from the punched card era: a plugboard buried under a tangle of patch wires.

Humour / Cloud providers

  • “Every time someone violates the arrow of time, the billing department throw a kitty in a black hole.” — me, 2016-09-01

7. Awesome Design Systems

  • : ByteDance Arco Design

    Components: 👍

    Voice & Tone:

    Designers Kit: 👍

    Source code *: 🐙 (⭐5.8k)

  • : Coinbase Design System

    Components: 👍

    Voice & Tone:

    Designers Kit:

    Source code *: 🐙 (⭐510)

  • : DHIS2 UI

    Components: 👍

    Voice & Tone: 👍

    Designers Kit: 👍

    Source code *: 🐙 (⭐54)

  • : Grafana UI

    Components: 👍

    Voice & Tone:

    Designers Kit:

9. Awesome Analytics
