17. Awesome Gemini Cli

Commands & Extensions

  • Wavegrain (⭐1) - Curated slideshows and carousels for your brand on autopilot, from Gemini CLI: plan posts for a brand, make TikTok slideshows and Instagram carousels, change slide text, put posts on the Wavegrain Calendar and export them; Wavegrain schedules and posts them for you. Remote MCP server with OAuth sign-in; requires a Wavegrain account. Remote endpoint: https://wavegrain.com/api/mcp. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/wavegrain/wavegrain-mcp, then /mcp auth wavegrain.

MCP Servers

  • ScanMalware (⭐2) - Keyless remote MCP server and Gemini CLI extension for investigating phishing and malicious URLs. Gemini CLI can submit a link to be run in isolated analysis environments and checked against YARA, antivirus and IDS rules, threat feeds and AI (suspicious pages get an AI verdict with a scam type such as credential phishing), then pivot across the public scan archive by domain, IP, ASN, JARM, favicon hash or script hash. A bundled skill walks from one phishing URL to the rest of its campaign. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/scanmalware/scanmalware-plugin

18. Magictools

Graphics / Animation

AI / Voxel Editors

APIs, Data, and ML

Email

  • Groundmail - Transactional email API and SMTP relay. 3,000 emails/month free (100/day), three domains, three agent mailboxes, inbound email included.

20. Awesome Mac

Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

Design and Product / Screenshot Tools

  • WellSnap - Open-source screenshot tool for macOS and Windows with arrows, numbered callouts, and a blur that never uses the hidden pixels.

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • SummonOS - Menu bar app and CLI that gives coding agents live Mac context over MCP and snapshots supported settings changes so they can be undone.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • Usagebar - Free native macOS menu bar app that shows Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code, z.ai and DeepSeek usage limits, plus when they reset.
  • Daily Wallpaper - Menu bar app that sets the Bing photo of the day as your desktop and lock screen wallpaper.

Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

  • LazyTune (⭐2) - Lightweight menu bar per-app audio mixer and universal media key controller for web browsers and desktop players.

Utilities / Productivity

  • MagicInput - Share one keyboard and mouse between a Mac and a Windows PC by moving the pointer past the screen edge, with clipboard sync and file transfer.

21. Awesome Rust

Applications / System tools

  • DuskXi/SpaceKnife (⭐57) - Cross-platform disk usage analyzer with live treemap and flame graph views, NTFS MFT quick scan, scan load limits and snapshot comparison, built with Tauri
  • Ray-lea/Argus (⭐1.4k) - A native Windows task manager built with GPUI Kit, with real-time CPU, memory, disk, network and GPU monitoring, process and service management, file-lock inspection, and resource usage history.

Applications / Text editors

  • thejacedev/Noteriv (⭐112) - A Markdown note-taking app with wiki-links, a graph view, plugins and Git sync, built with Tauri 2.

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 12, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Transit

Proprietary (non-standard) vendor APIs / Rust

  • InfraNode - Keyless REST (and MCP) API for 84+ German cities. Includes public-transport stops and live departures with real-time delays (DELFI/GTFS, HVV, VGN), alongside weather, air quality, traffic and roadworks. No API key.

2. Awesome Dataviz

JavaScript tools / Charting libraries

  • Britecharts (⭐3.7k) - Accessible D3-based charts for JavaScript and React, with keyboard navigation, dark mode and TypeScript support.

JavaScript tools / Financial charts

  • Lightweight Charts React Components (⭐140) - Declarative React components for financial charts built on TradingView Lightweight Charts.

JavaScript tools / Misc

  • AVA (⭐1.6k) - TypeScript visual analytics framework for AI agents, with file and database queries, reusable business definitions and interactive charts.

Other tools / Text visualization

  • evident-charts (⭐62) - Agent skill that makes explanatory charts and checks them for misleading axes, overlapping labels, and color problems.
  • RustGIS (⭐2.6k) - Fast, free and open-source GIS for mapping, analyzing and sharing geospatial data, native and in the browser.

3. Awesome Ai in Finance

Agents

  • FastTrade AI (⭐1) - Signal-only LLM market research workspace with deterministic risk checks, a budgeted batch API, and reproducible checksummed backtests. Never places orders.
  • oracle3 (⭐569) - Prediction-market trading engine and MCP server for Kalshi, Polymarket, and Solana, with fee-aware no-arbitrage checks across related contracts and live or paper execution.
  • DXAP - Agentic trading harness on Hyperliquid by DX Research Group: write a strategy in plain language, an AI agent trades your own account inside limits a policy engine enforces, and every decision is logged.
  • seduma-trade-agent-demo (⭐0) - Practice-only loop that runs LLM trading-agent decisions through confirm-gated simulated fills.
  • LLM_trader (⭐141) - An LLM trading agent that reads a chart rendered from every closed candle, retrieves its own closed trades as memory, and publishes every prompt, decision and loss; paper trading with a ledger the repo can reproduce.
  • AlphaFinch (⭐2) - AlphaEvolve-style agent that invents and evolves trading strategies as code, then grades them on sealed holdouts and a pre-registered multi-market exam; no brokerage connection.
  • multi-agent-investment (⭐0) - Multi-agent equity research with three reasoning modes and deterministic signal fusion; decisions are reproducible from a pure-function core, with an offline demo that needs no API keys.
  • FriesTrader (⭐307) - Claude Code template for automated live orders through Robinhood Agentic Trading MCP, with rule-based position sizing and trade limits. Requires an eligible Robinhood Agentic Trading account.

Skills

  • Krexa (⭐119) - Agent skill and remote MCP server for turning a trading idea, post or video into fixed rules, backtesting and paper-trading them free, and requesting a user-approved live trading agent on Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, OKX, Bybit, MEXC, Hyperliquid, Polymarket and Solana DEXs.
  • SmartMoney-Cub (⭐26) - Read-only trading journal and review harness for agents: freezes point-in-time evidence packs, replays them deterministically, and grades rule candidates on a frozen 240-case finance benchmark. MIT.

Market Data

  • itulo/eu-nordic-open-data-mcp (⭐0) - Open-source MCP server for official EU open data: ECB FX rates, policy rates and HICP inflation, EU consolidated sanctions screening, VIES VAT validation, and GLEIF LEI ownership chains. No API key for these tools; same tools also available as pay-per-use Apify actors.

Research & Analysis

  • firecrawl/firecrawl-mcp-server (⭐7.8k) - Official Firecrawl MCP server for finance research agents: web search, scrape, and crawl, plus Alexandria providers for SEC EDGAR filings and FRED macro series. Alexandria requires an API key.
  • Kernel-Hunter/kandle (⭐9) - Open-source browser charting app with an MCP server: agents read the chart, draw levels, add indicators and alerts, and run strategy backtests on crypto, stocks and forex.
  • signal8ai/signal8-mcp (⭐1) - Official Signal8 MCP server: small-cap dilution (warrants, ATMs, shelf registrations, convertibles, cash runway) with each figure cited to its SEC filing, plus insider and congressional trades, halts and reverse splits. Requires a Signal8 Pro API key.
  • Beltran12138/evidence-deflator (⭐0) - Open-source MCP server and Python library that checks how much of an LLM trading backtest falls before the model's training cutoff and how many clean months a claimed Sharpe needs after selection; publishes an evidence-adjusted leaderboard of public AI trading competitions.
  • financial-reports/financial-reports-mcp-server (⭐2) - Official FinancialFilings MCP server: annual and interim reports, ad-hoc disclosures and ESEF/XBRL filings from securities regulators in about 60 markets, with XBRL financials and company identifiers. Free with a registered account (OAuth).
  • kburrus64-max/prop-firm-rules (⭐1) - Prop-firm risk rules MCP server (FTMO, Topstep, Apex and more): sourced daily-loss and max-drawdown limits plus a drawdown-room check for trading agents. Stdio or free hosted endpoint, no API key.

Papers

  • Operating-Layer Controls for Onchain Language-Model Agents Under Real Capital, 2026 - 21-day deployment of 3,505 user-funded LLM agents trading real ETH on Base, measuring how controls outside the model change agent behavior.
  • What LLM Trading Agents Actually Do in Production: A Six-Month, Population-Scale Record from Two Fleets, 2026 - Six months of production behavior from two LLM trading fleets, DX Terminal Pro and DXAP, with paper artifacts and aggregate data on GitHub (⭐51).

Courses & Books & Blogs

  • Agents Finance - Free bilingual (EN/ES) directory of real AI-agent use cases in accounting, FP&A, treasury and ERPs, with sources, evidence level and copyable prompts.
  • EcoFinLearn - Free in-browser Python, pandas, scikit-learn and SQL lessons for finance and economics students, including return prediction with scikit-learn; runs on Pyodide and SQLite with no signup.

Time Series Data

  • PredixLab Signals (⭐0) - Python research pipeline for daily US equity signals (S&P 500 / Nasdaq-100): LightGBM with purged walk-forward validation, next-session backtests with per-side costs, and leakage tests. Daily data only; not live quotes.

Portfolio Management

  • CAST (⭐3) - Cross-asset Kalman filtering with model predictive control for limiting portfolio drawdown (ICDM 2026).

Data Sources / Traditional Markets

  • autorekt (⭐5) - CLI and agent skill that give AI agents market data from free public sources: cross-asset prices, dollar liquidity, swap spreads, positioning, options gamma, China money markets and prediction-market odds, with the age of every value.
  • US Bank Data (⭐1) - Open Python package for selected FDIC institution financial snapshots and multi-bank quarterly panels with explicit units and archived source evidence.

Data Sources / Crypto Currencies

  • TokenSonar - Institutional adoption scores (0-100) for cryptocurrencies built from spot-ETF assets, institutional partners, news and on-chain real-world-asset value; free JSON download with published methodology, updated twice daily.

Data Sources / Prediction Markets

  • Resolved Markets - Historical Polymarket order book snapshots, trades and resolutions via REST, WebSocket and a hosted MCP server, plus Hyperliquid perp books. Free tier covers crypto markets.

Research Tools / Prediction Markets

  • tracemodel (⭐8) - Python library for financial models that AI agents fill from filings: every number has a source, formulas are traced, and checks catch totals that do not tie.
  • StockTipsArena - AI-extracted Indian equity (NSE) analyst recommendation tracker, SEBI registry directory, and stock screener auditing 27,000+ public calls against exchange OHLCV candles, with an open CC BY 4.0 benchmark dataset (GitHub (⭐0)) and MCP server (GitHub (⭐0)). Free tier available.
  • FinTwin (⭐4) - Open source digital twin of 390+ public companies' finances built from SEC XBRL filings, with Monte Carlo stress tests, conformal forecast intervals and an out-of-sample backtest on 5,000+ SEC filers. Live dashboard and paper included.
  • wallstreetype-research (⭐2) - Agent-agnostic equity-research pipeline that turns sell-side report methodology into runnable code: a dual-market data layer (US / A-share), institutional chart families, six layout templates, and Markdown-to-Word/PDF report production.

Traditional Market / Prediction Markets

  • lumibot (⭐2.2k) - Python framework for backtesting and live trading with the same strategy code, with a built-in AI agent runtime and 12 broker integrations across stocks, options, futures, forex, crypto and prediction markets.

GYM Environment / Plugins

  • tradefloor (⭐0) - Simulated stock markets with a limit order book per company and an economy underneath, for testing RL policies and LLM trading agents, with a Gymnasium environment and adapters for the OpenAI Agents SDK, PydanticAI and LangGraph.

4. Awesome Gatling

Tools / Plugins

  • gatling-dummy-sampler (⭐8) - Gatling implementation of Dummy Sampler, a plugin for simulating realistic actions without making actual requests.
  • gatling-playwright-plugin (⭐3) - A simple Gatling plugin for UI performance testing using Playwright.

5. Awesome Vlc

VLC native plugins

  • vlc-waveform (⭐0) - Full-file audio waveform visualization with click-to-seek for VLC on Windows.

6. Awesome V

Database clients

  • vsql (⭐358) - Single-file SQL database written in pure V, following the SQL standard, with a CLI, a PostgreSQL-compatible server and an ORM.

7. Open Source Flutter Apps

Productivity

  • ParrotFlow - Scriptable local dictation that uses the text on your screen to fix names, and your rules to format numbers, dates, and links. (Source (⭐18))

Tools

  • LayoutKeeper - macOS menu bar app that saves window layouts per external monitor and restores positions, sizes, and Spaces on reconnect. (Source (⭐34))

Developer Tools

  • RunWisp - crond and supervisord in one binary, with a web dashboard and a TUI. (Source (⭐85))

Communication

  • Pomelu - Open-source Android and iOS app to chat with your self-hosted Hermes Agent bots. (Source (⭐9))

Business

  • Relaticle - Open-source CRM with a built-in AI assistant and an MCP server, self-hosted with Docker or on Relaticle Cloud. (Source (⭐1.8k))

8. Awesome Neovim

Plugin Manager

  • jtprogru/pack-ui.nvim (⭐40) - A simple UI on top of vim.pack for managing plugins.

AI / Diagnostics

  • kova1max/float-claude.nvim (⭐2) - Ask Claude Code about the current file or selection from a popup, using the claude CLI subscription instead of an API key.

9. Awesome Blazor

Games

  • TabletopCardEngine demo (⭐1) - Texas Hold'em played and replayed in Blazor WebAssembly, with a live view of the database rows each action writes. Demo.

Component bundles

  • Radzen.Blazor (⭐4.4k) - Free and open-source (MIT, including commercial use) library of 155+ native Blazor components: DataGrid, Scheduler, Gantt, PivotDataGrid, Spreadsheet with XLSX import/export, 30+ chart types, HtmlEditor and more, with Material, Standard, Default, Humanistic and Software themes in light and dark. (Demos).

Routing & Navigation / Modal, Toast & Notifications

  • Routeables (⭐0) - Route-based MVVM navigation for Blazor (Server, WebAssembly and MAUI Hybrid): view models declare routes ([Routeable("/dogs/{name}")]) and navigate through a single IRouter, with typed route methods, regions and navigation guards. The same view models also run on MAUI, Avalonia, Uno and WPF. NuGet.

Routing & Navigation / Others

  • WebFilez (⭐0) - Open source file manager for web written in Blazor. Demos available for Blazor, MVC and React.

Articles / Others

  • Announcing .NET 11 - November 10, 2026 - .NET 11 is here with C# 15, faster developer tools, runtime and library improvements, and new capabilities for web, mobile, desktop, and AI apps.
  • Get Ready for .NET Conf 2026! - November 3, 2026 - Join Microsoft November 10-13 for this free, four-day virtual conference and the official launch of .NET 11. We’ll kick things off with two days of sessions from Microsoft product teams, followed by two days of community-led talks from developers around the world.

10. Awesome Open Source Games

Browser-Based / Boardgame

  • Daily Word Hunt (⭐1) - Free browser daily word search (find-the-word). New puzzle every day, themed series, print packs.
  • Chessmata (⭐20) - Open-source multiplayer chess platform for humans and AI agents, with real-time WebSocket gameplay, Elo-based matchmaking, 3D browser board (Three.js), MCP server, and UCI-compatible CLI. Built with Go and React.

Browser-Based / Arcade

  • Trick or Take (⭐0) - Multiplayer Halloween party web game built with vanilla Canvas 2D, Agora RTC voice chat, and Cloudflare Workers edge.
  • Wave Rider Nusantara (⭐6) - Arcade game inspired by Indonesian culture, featuring the legendary character Gatot Kaca and traditional Batik patterns. Built with React and JavaScript.

Browser-Based / Sandbox

  • Cubyz (⭐3.8k) - Open voxel simulation game in active development with building, crafting and survival mechanics. Licensed under GPL3.

Browser-Based / Geography

  • World Chase (⭐0) - Competitive weekly geography game. Decode cryptic riddles to find real-world locations on a map. Global leaderboard, VS duels, 25 new challenges every week.
  • Kids World Chase (⭐0) - Weekly geography adventure for children aged 8-13. Solve riddles, explore real locations via Google Street View.

11. Awesome Go

Messaging

  • bus (⭐1) - Kafka event bus framework with protobuf-typed producer and consumer groups, retries, batch handlers and automatic offset commits.

Sets

  • readyset (⭐0) - Generic sets, including sets of records identified by a key, with an opt-in thread-safe variant.

DevOps Tools / Libraries for creating HTTP middlewares

  • pattyGraph (⭐5) - Real-time NGINX log analyzer with an interactive TUI and JSONL output.

12. Awesome Ruby

Admin Interface

  • Avo - Admin panel framework for Ruby on Rails. Build admins, internal tools, dashboards and back offices in plain Ruby inside your own app; an optional paid MCP add-on lets AI agents work on the same records within your Pundit policies.

CMS

  • Avo - Admin framework for Ruby on Rails. Build admin panels, internal tools and CMS back offices by configuring resources in Ruby, inside your own app.

13. Awesome Mac

Audio & Video / Players

  • szeremeta1/Vespertine (⭐20) — Free, open-source, surround bit-perfect music player for Mac ☆26

14. Awesome Gemini Cli

Commands & Extensions

  • bulkhead (⭐34) - Gemini CLI extension for machines that run many agent sessions at once (several Gemini CLI, Claude Code or Codex sessions in separate worktrees of one app). A BeforeTool hook on run_shell_command blocks name-based kills of another session's processes, port collisions, git commands that would switch, stash or delete another session's worktree, whole-disk scans and long foreground sleeps, and holds heavy commands back when RAM runs low; each block tells the agent the safe command instead. No dependencies, MIT. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/dooly6276/claude-bulkhead.
  • Bravos (⭐2) - Gemini CLI extension (14 skills, the GuardLink MCP server and a GEMINI.md context file) for continuous threat modeling as code that proves the threats: built on GuardLink, it drives Gemini through the threat model, code graph, SAST and authorized pentests (cert-x-gen, against targets you own, loopback by default) that show which exposures are exploitable, then gates PRs and keeps a retest per fix. Runs locally; your code is not sent to Bugb (the licence check contacts account.bugb.io). Commercial; needs the bravos CLI (npm install -g @bugb-technologies/bravos, Node 20+) and a Bugb account. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/Bugb-Technologies/bravos-plugins.

Development Tools & Utilities

  • Align CLI (⭐11) - Local CLI and MCP server that gives Gemini CLI your team's decisions from Jira, Confluence, Linear, Notion, Slack, Teams, Zoom, GitHub, GitLab, git history and repo docs, and checks its changes against them (Gemini's hook reports after the edit lands). Also works with Claude Code, Codex and others. Free, runs locally, MIT.

MCP Servers

  • KissMyPost (⭐2) - Reddit audience data for Gemini CLI over a remote MCP server: subreddit finder, best time to post, brand mentions.
  • CloudGPU MCP (⭐1) - MIT-licensed local (stdio) MCP server that lets Gemini CLI rent a GPU by the minute on CloudGPU, run a job, download the results and shut the machine down; the same key also works with an OpenAI-compatible API for open models. Needs a CloudGPU account with prepaid balance.
  • GuardLink (⭐21) - Continuous threat modeling as code for Gemini CLI: security annotations in source comments are the threat model, parsed deterministically and validated in CI, so it updates as the code changes. guardlink init --agent gemini adds its instructions to .gemini/GEMINI.md, and the MCP server lets Gemini read the threats, exposures and data flows behind a file, check its annotations, find untrusted-entry-to-sink paths with no control, and turn open exposures into cert-x-gen test templates so they can be proven. Local stdio. MIT. Install: npm install -g guardlink, then gemini mcp add guardlink guardlink mcp.
  • memgit - Versioned memory that Gemini CLI shares with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex: every change is a checkpoint with diff and rollback, and the store syncs end-to-end encrypted between machines. Install: pip install memgit or npx -y memgit-mcp.
  • AgentMart (⭐3) - Hosted MCP server and Gemini CLI extension: a shop of ready parts for coding agents, such as a webhook inbox, memory shared across sessions, schedules that fire after the session ends, uptime watch and a task queue. Searching the catalog is free and needs no sign-in; purchases are paid from a prepaid balance you top up, and the agent asks you before each one. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/mustafaakmese/agentmart-plugins, then /mcp auth agentmart.
  • ScrapingBee - Hosted MCP server for the ScrapingBee web scraping API: Gemini CLI can fetch any page as HTML, text or a screenshot with JavaScript rendering and proxy rotation, extract fields described in plain English, and get JSON results from Google, Amazon, Walmart, YouTube, ChatGPT and Gemini. 18 tools; the server is closed source. Remote Streamable HTTP with a ScrapingBee API key; free trial of 1,000 credits, no card. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http scrapingbee https://mcp.scrapingbee.com/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCRAPINGBEE_API_KEY".

15. Magictools

Graphics / Spritesheet Tools

  • 💰 Border Kit for Tiled - Python CLI to extrude PNG tilesets and update external TSX files while preserving tile IDs, animations and collision objects.

Graphics / Vector/Image Editor

  • 💸 klad - Drawing and animation app for 2D game art that people and coding agents edit together: every stroke and fill stays editable data, pixel layers, tilesets with Godot TileSet export, Aseprite in and out, sprite sheet and GIF export, and MIT agent skills that teach any agent to paint and judge drawing and pixel art. Free for personal use and small companies. Source (⭐161)

AI / Voxel Editors

  • 💰 Buildaloo - AI game maker for kids 5–12: a kid says a game idea out loud and plays the game in the browser. Parent account, no ads, no stranger chat.

Blogs and Portals / Voxel Editors

  • Gamealia - Free HTML5 web games portal in 32 languages; developers publish their web games (HTML5, Unity WebGL, Godot) with no exclusivity and an ad revenue share (ads are not live yet).

16. Free for Dev

APIs, Data, and ML

  • Rizamo - Social media publishing API: schedule and publish to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Threads, YouTube and more over REST, webhooks or an MCP server for AI agents, with comment inbox and analytics. Free forever for 2 connected accounts, unlimited posts, every feature included, no credit card.

Analytics, Events and Statistics

  • Spreelytics - Privacy first website and product analytics SaaS that can trace your revenue sources. Free plan: 1 million events per month, unlimited projects and team members with most of the needed features like dashboard, goal, funnel, ai crawler, revenue, and much more.

17. Awesome Mac

Reading and Writing Tools / Note-taking

  • Noteriv - Open-source Markdown note-taking app with wiki-links, graph view, plugins, Git/WebDAV sync and a built-in MCP server for AI assistants.

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • o8 - Open-source desktop app that reviews coding agents' work, sends it back until it passes, and merges it.
  • MoMo Agent (⭐15) - Open-source, self-hosted 24/7 personal agent for Apple Watch, iPhone, and Mac with on-device CoreML ASR, embedded Tailscale, and an Obsidian-style Markdown memory vault.
  • Quarters - Open-source workspace for running terminal coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Aider across many projects at once, with one-click project switching, dev-server launching and remote access from your phone.

Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • VoiceStudio - Real-time broadcast voice rack in Swift and CoreAudio with subtle pitch depth, sub-harmonic warmth, 6-band EQ, de-esser, and compressor for Discord, Zoom, Teams, and OBS.

Proxy and VPN Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • LockPlus (⭐15) - WireGuard and OpenVPN client with a kill switch that macOS itself enforces.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • TocaPad (⭐1) - Slide your trackpad's edges to change volume and brightness, and double-tap a corner to run a shortcut.

Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall

  • DiskPilot - Free, open-source storage analyzer for developers that explains each folder (Docker, node_modules, Xcode DerivedData, AI tool caches), marks what is safe to delete and moves everything to the Trash first.

Utilities / General Tools

  • Yado - Native Mac app for managing an iPhone: clear duplicate photos, large videos and unused apps, arrange the Home Screen, move files and keep backups on the Mac.

Utilities / Productivity

  • LinkUnbound - Open-source browser picker that asks which browser or browser profile should open each link, with rules by site or by the app the link came from.

Utilities / Finder Tools

  • PC Mode (⭐2) - Free app that brings Windows habits to your Mac: delete from Finder with the Delete key, cut and move files with ⌘X and ⌘V, and switch individual windows with ⌘Tab.

18. Awesome Rust

Applications

  • alexsergivan/kwant (⭐519) - Self-hosted team of AI bots in one binary, with spaces, handoffs, approvals and routines

Applications / Video

  • yuxino/mimi (⭐851) - Live bilingual subtitle overlay for videos and streams, built with Rust and Tauri.

19. Awesome Osint

Email Search / Email Check / GitHub

  • SpoofCheck - Free email spoofing test: checks a domain's SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS and MX records and grades how easily it can be impersonated (A to F).
entry.summary: 19 awesome list updated on Nov 12, 2026, including Awesome Transit, Awesome Dataviz, Awesome Ai in Finance, Awesome Gatling, Awesome Vlc, Awesome V, Open Source Flutter Apps, Awesome Neovim, Awesome Blazor, Awesome Open Source Games, Awesome Go, Awesome Ruby, Awesome Mac, Awesome Gemini Cli, Magictools, Free for Dev, Awesome Mac, Awesome Rust, Awesome Osint

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 11, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Integration

Projects / AI Gateway

  • agentgateway (⭐6.1k) (⭐6k) - An open-source data plane for agentic AI connectivity, providing security, observability, and governance for agent-to-tool (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication.
  • Bifrost (⭐9.4k) (⭐9.2k) - A high-performance AI gateway written in Go that unifies more than 20 model providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible API, with failover, load balancing, semantic caching, and governance.
  • LiteLLM (⭐63k) (⭐62k) - An LLM gateway that exposes 100+ model providers through a unified OpenAI-compatible API, with spend tracking, fallbacks, and rate limiting.
  • MCPJungle (⭐1.6k) (⭐1.6k) - A self-hosted MCP gateway and registry that centralises multiple MCP servers behind one endpoint for AI agents.

Projects / API Design

  • OpenAPI Diff (⭐1.1k) (⭐1.1k) - Compare OpenAPI specs with version control and visualize the differences in HTML or Markdown format.
  • Zally (⭐948) (⭐947) - Ensure the quality of your OpenAPI specs with this linter tool that provides extensive analysis and feedback.

Projects / API Documentation

  • DapperDox (⭐417) (⭐416) - Generates elegant, interactive API documentation from OpenAPI/Swagger specs with easy customization and automated updates.
  • Redoc (⭐26k) (⭐26k) - Delivers clean, modern documentation with advanced theming, multi-language support, and seamless integration.
  • Slate (⭐35k) (⭐36k) - Converts markdown into stylish, static API documentation with intuitive navigation and clear code examples.
  • Zudoku (⭐621) (⭐620) - A customizable framework built on OpenAPI, focused on delivering exceptional developer experiences through quality documentation.

Projects / API Gateway

  • Higress (⭐9.7k) (⭐9.7k) - A next-generation cloud-native gateway based on Envoy and Istio, offering high performance, easy-to-use, and rich plugin extensibility.

Projects / API Management

  • Gravitee.io API Management (⭐470) (⭐469) - A lightweight, open-source platform offering flexible API governance, robust security, and straightforward configuration.

Projects / API Testing

  • API clients
    • Bruno (⭐48k) (⭐48k) - A fast, offline API client designed for git-friendly workflows and seamless testing.
    • curl (⭐43k) (⭐43k) - A versatile command-line tool for data transfer across multiple protocols, essential for quick API testing.
    • curlie (⭐3.7k) (⭐3.7k) - A modern, user-friendly frontend to curl that combines simplicity with powerful performance.
    • gRPC UI (⭐5.9k) (⭐5.9k) - An interactive web-based tool for gRPC APIs, providing a browser-based interface for testing and exploring gRPC services with dynamic form generation.
    • grpcurl (⭐12k) (⭐13k) - A command-line tool for interacting with gRPC servers, enabling inspection and invocation of RPC methods with support for server reflection and protocol buffer files.
    • Hoppscotch (⭐80k) (⭐81k) - A lightweight, web-based API development tool offering real-time testing with an intuitive interface.
    • HTTPie (⭐38k) (⭐39k) - An intuitive CLI HTTP client that simplifies crafting API requests and inspecting responses.
    • HttpMaster - Free and lightweight desktop tool for HTTP testing and debugging.
    • Insomnia (⭐40k) (⭐40k) - A cross-platform client that streamlines API debugging and testing for both REST and GraphQL services.
    • posting (⭐12k) (⭐13k) - A modern, terminal-based API client designed for efficient and seamless API interactions.
    • Postman - The industry-standard tool for API development and testing, featuring automation, mock servers, and collaborative documentation.
    • Requestly (⭐6.7k) (⭐6.8k) - Lightweight Git-Friendly API Client Built for Modern Developers.
    • resty (⭐2.6k) (⭐2.6k) - A tiny command-line REST client implemented as shell functions around curl, handy for quick API exploration from the terminal.
    • SoapUI (⭐1.7k) (⭐1.7k) - A comprehensive open-source solution for testing both SOAP and REST web services with extensive automation features.
    • Wombat (⭐1.4k) (⭐1.4k) - A cross-platform desktop gRPC client with automatic proto parsing, TLS support, and intuitive UI for testing unary, streaming, and bidirectional gRPC requests.
    • xh (⭐8.1k) (⭐8.2k) - A fast, friendly CLI HTTP client that reimplements HTTPie's design with improved performance, HTTP/2 support, and built-in curl translation.
    • Yaade (⭐1.9k) (⭐2k) - A self-hosted, collaborative API development environment designed for team sharing with multi-user support, persistent storage, and support for REST, WebSockets, and Markdown documentation.
    • Yaak (⭐19k) (⭐19k) - A fast, privacy-first desktop API client for REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, Server-Sent Events, and gRPC with offline-first design, built with Tauri and React.
  • Testing tools and frameworks
    • Apache JMeter (⭐9.6k) (⭐9.6k) - A feature-rich tool for load testing and performance analysis across diverse web applications and services.
    • Artillery (⭐9.1k) (⭐9.1k) - A complete load testing platform supporting HTTP, WebSocket, Socket.io, gRPC, and more, with cloud-native serverless scaling on AWS Lambda and Fargate.
    • Gatling (⭐6.9k) (⭐7k) - A powerful load testing framework with a developer-friendly DSL that delivers detailed performance metrics.
    • Hurl (⭐19k) (⭐19k) - A command-line tool for running HTTP requests with plain text syntax, excellent for both API testing and CI/CD integration with support for chaining, capturing values, and comprehensive assertions.
    • Keploy (⭐19k) (⭐19k) - A developer-centric API and integration testing tool that auto-generates tests and data-mocks from real traffic using eBPF, supporting any language without code changes.
    • ghz (⭐3.3k) (⭐3.4k) - A simple gRPC benchmarking and load testing tool with support for various load schedules, concurrency control, and detailed performance metrics.
    • Grafana k6 (⭐32k) (⭐32k) - Open-source, JS-scriptable load-testing tool for CI/CD.
    • Karate (⭐9k) (⭐9k) - A unified testing framework that merges API automation, mocking, and performance testing with simple, expressive syntax.
    • Pyresttest (⭐1.1k) (⭐1.2k) - A Python-based testing tool offering easy YAML/JSON-driven REST API testing and microbenchmarking.
    • REST Assured (⭐7.1k) (⭐7.1k) - A Java DSL that simplifies REST API testing with intuitive syntax and seamless integration into CI pipelines.
    • RESTler (⭐2.9k) (⭐3k) - A stateful REST API fuzzing tool that automatically discovers security and reliability bugs by intelligently inferring producer-consumer dependencies from OpenAPI specifications.
    • Schemathesis (⭐3.7k) (⭐3.7k) - A Python library for property-based testing of API schemas, ensuring reliability through robust edge-case detection.
    • Taurus (⭐2.1k) (⭐2.1k) - An open-source automation framework that simplifies continuous testing with intuitive configuration and integration support.

Projects / B2B Integration

  • OpenAS2 (⭐244) (⭐244) - Java-based open-source implementation of the AS2 protocol for secure, signed, and encrypted document exchange over HTTP.

Projects / Business Rules Engine

  • OpenL Tablets (⭐211) (⭐211) - Flexible open-source decision management system that simplifies defining and executing business rules and decision tables.

Projects / Data Integration

  • Apache NiFi (⭐6.3k) (⭐6.3k) - Automated data integration tool with a visual interface that seamlessly extracts, transforms, and delivers data across systems.
  • Conduit (⭐617) (⭐617) - Lightweight data integration tool written in Go that streams data between systems using built-in or standalone connectors, with Kafka Connect compatibility.
  • Estuary Flow (⭐988) (⭐987) - Versatile, scalable platform that provides both real-time and batch data integration for ETL and ELT pipelines.
  • Sling (⭐926) (⭐920) - Fast ELT command-line tool and Go library for moving data between databases, files, and cloud storage across a wide set of connectors.

Projects / Data Mapping Solution

  • AtlasMap (⭐215) (⭐214) - Interactive web-based tool that simplifies mapping across Java, XML, CSV, and JSON data sources with an intuitive interface.
  • Kaoto (⭐132) (⭐132) - Visual data mapper for Apache Camel with a drag-and-drop interface supporting XML, JSON, CSV, and XSLT transformations. Successor to AtlasMap.

Projects / Enterprise Service Bus

  • WSO2 Integrator: MI (⭐290) (⭐290) - The configuration-driven integration runtime of the WSO2 Integrator platform, supporting enterprise integration patterns in centralised and containerised deployments.

Projects / Integration Frameworks

  • Apache Camel (⭐6.4k) (⭐6.4k) - Integration framework with 300+ connectors for databases, messaging, APIs, cloud services, and enterprise systems. Supports both Spring Boot and Quarkus runtimes, and includes AI agent interoperability via the A2A and MCP protocols.

Projects / Integration Platform as a Service

  • Camel K (⭐937) (⭐937) - Lightweight Kubernetes-native integration platform built on Apache Camel that runs integration routes directly on Kubernetes and OpenShift as cloud-native serverless services.

Projects / Message Broker

  • NATS (⭐21k) (⭐21k) - Lightweight, high-performance messaging system ideal for microservices and cloud-native architectures.

Projects / Schema Registry

  • Apicurio Registry (⭐953) (⭐950) - Open-source registry for API designs and schemas, supporting Avro, Protobuf, JSON Schema, OpenAPI, and AsyncAPI artifacts with configurable compatibility rules.
  • Karapace (⭐640) (⭐640) - Open-source, drop-in replacement for Confluent Schema Registry and the Kafka REST API.

Projects / Self-Service Integration

  • n8n (⭐210k) (⭐210k) - Open-source workflow automation tool with 400+ connectors, giving you full control over your data and integrations.

Projects / Stream Processing

  • ksqlDB (⭐315) (⭐316) - Database purpose-built for stream processing applications on Kafka, queried with SQL.
  • RisingWave (⭐9.4k) (⭐9.4k) - Postgres-compatible streaming database for incremental, real-time materialized views over event streams.

Projects / Workflow Engine

  • LittleHorse (⭐402) (⭐401) - High-throughput, low-latency microservice orchestration engine built on Kafka Streams, with SDKs in multiple languages.

Resources / API Specification

  • Arazzo Specification (⭐491) (⭐489) - A standard, programming language-agnostic representation for describing sequences of API calls (workflows) and their dependencies.
  • Standard Webhooks (⭐1.8k) (⭐1.8k) - Open source tools and guidelines for sending webhooks easily, securely, and reliably.

Resources / Data Formats

  • YAML (⭐510) (⭐509) - A human-friendly and easy-to-read data serialization format that is widely used for configuration files and data exchange. It supports rich data types and is compatible with most programming languages.

2. Awesome Cpp

Concurrency

  • cuda4cpu (⭐7) - Run CUDA and HIP programs on the CPU, unmodified, with GCC or Clang. [Apache2]

3. Awesome Langchain

Tools / Low-code

  • RocketRide (⭐20k): Open-source AI meta-harness with a C++ runtime and a visual canvas for building agents and RAG pipelines, with LangChain agent and text-splitter nodes

Tools / Services

  • LangChain Agent Skills (⭐106): Agent skills that teach AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to build, test and deploy LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith and Deep Agents projects

4. Awesome Cakephp

Plugins / Miscellaneous

  • Interact plugin (⭐3) - Interactive pages using native CakePHP templates and Alpine.js.

5. Awesome Healthcare

Contents / Imaging

  • Dicoogle (⭐536) - Dicoogle is an extensible, platform-independent and open-source PACS

6. Awesome Keycloak

Tools

  • kcac: Effective Access Export for Access Reviews (⭐0)

7. Awesome Raspberry Pi

Tools

  • Gearotons M17 (⭐18) - Integrated servomotor with the motor, driver, motion controller and encoder in one NEMA 17 body, driven from a Pi with a Python library, several motors on one RS-485 bus.

Projects

  • led-ticker (⭐2) - Raspberry Pi toolkit for driving large RGB LED matrix signs via a TOML config, with scrolling news, weather, crypto, sports and calendar feeds, animated transitions, and a plugin system.
  • Murmur (⭐18) - Turns your phone into a BLE-connected shell and AI agent for a headless Raspberry Pi, no network required on the Pi and bring your own LLM key.
  • RelayTV (⭐99) - Turns a Raspberry Pi connected to a TV over HDMI into a local media endpoint with V4L2/HEVC hardware decoding, HDMI-CEC control, a mobile remote for Plex, Jellyfin, Emby and IPTV, and Home Assistant integration. Supports Raspberry Pi 4 and 5.
  • RV565 (⭐3) - Video format and player for SPI displays: 24 FPS on a 320x240 ST7789 from a Raspberry Pi Pico 2, with the second core decoding.

8. Awesome Transit

GTFS Realtime Utilities / Rust

  • GTFS Zone RT Visualizer - Static web application to analyze GTFS Realtime feeds. No login needed, fast, and transparent to the specification. Open-source (AGPL-3.0) on GitHub (⭐1).

Agency Tools / General GIS Applications for making transit visualizations

9. Awesome Mqtt

Platforms

Tools

Makers

  • erdi-lrf-raspberry-pi-python (⭐0) - Raspberry Pi Python tool that reads a UART laser rangefinder / distance sensor module and publishes the distance to an MQTT broker.

10. Awesome Webgl

Tools/Debugging

  • WebGL GLSL Editor - GLSL language support extension for Visual Studio Code.

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: Yes

Vehicle

  • API: FuelEconomy

    Description: US EPA fuel economy data by year, make and model

    Auth: No

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: Unknown

Video

  • API: Transcript Dock

    Description: Transcripts of YouTube, TikTok and Instagram videos, with timing and SRT or VTT exports

    Auth: apiKey

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: No

12. Awesome Research

Plotting and Charting Online / Enterprise Git Service

  • Scientific Figure: AI tool that draws scientific illustrations, graphical abstracts, data plots, and conference posters from a text prompt, sketch, or PDF; exports SVG and PPTX at journal column widths.

Datasets / Social Sciences

  • twtData X Trends Archive (Lookup): X (Twitter) trending topics by country and city, with a page for each past day; the largest countries are recorded hourly.

Writing / Social Sciences

  • Articlo: Prepares existing Word manuscripts for a target journal with an editable document, change summary, and author checklist. Free readiness check; paid manuscript preparation.

Notebooks for Researchers / Social Sciences

  • Glasp: Web and YouTube highlighter with AI summaries and notes, plus Kindle highlights import. Browser extensions, iOS and Android apps, and an MCP server; export to Notion, Obsidian and Zotero.

Editors / Markdown

  • markon (Cloud, Local PWA): Minimal distraction-free live Markdown editor.

Editors / LaTeX

  • Manulyx(Cloud): Online LaTeX editor for writing and revising papers with co-authors: real-time co-editing, track changes, publisher templates, submission stages, response-to-reviewers letters and marked manuscripts. Free plan available.
  • Oleafly - Open-source desktop editor for LaTeX, Typst and Markdown with a built-in LaTeX engine, live PDF preview and Zotero citations. Runs offline on macOS, Windows and Linux.

Code Editors / HTML+CSS+JS

  • neovim(Free,Cross-platform,Plugins): Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability.

Investigate Papers / HTML+CSS+JS

  • JournalCompass: Free bilingual journal finder: CAS zones, impact factors, review times, APC/OA status and an AI journal matcher.

Bibliography / HTML+CSS+JS

  • citeguard (⭐1): Checks a .bib/.ris bibliography (or a single DOI) for cited papers that have been retracted, corrected, or flagged with an expression of concern, via Crossref and the Retraction Watch records it carries. Python library/CLI, MCP server, and GitHub Action; no API key. pip install citeguard-cli
  • Reference Verifier (⭐0): Checks that every reference in a .bib file or LaTeX paper exists in Crossref, OpenAlex, DBLP, arXiv or PubMed, and flags invented papers and wrong DOIs. Open source (MIT).

Tips for Researchers / HTML+CSS+JS

  • ProfScout: Finds professors most likely to reply to research cold emails, ranked by reply-fit. Freemium.

More / HTML+CSS+JS

  • ToolStack: a free toolbox of 122 browser-based utilities (text, JSON, image, PDF, unit conversion, color) that run entirely client-side, with no signup and no file uploads.

13. Awesome Go

File Handling

  • go-cabinet (⭐4) - Read, write and extract Microsoft Cabinet (.cab) files, with MSZIP and LZX compression and io/fs support.

Mock

  • auth0-mock (⭐8) - Mock Auth0 server for tests and local development, with signed JWTs, OIDC login flows and the Management API.

Video

  • subgo (⭐0) - Library and CLI for working with subtitles (.srt, .ass, .webvtt, etc.).

14. Awesome Mac

Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

  • apoorvdarshan/coincide (⭐16) — Native macOS (AppKit) app for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok ☆19

System Tools / Menu Bar

  • improvim/hexa (⭐17) — macOS Menu Bar Programmer's Calculator ☆17

15. Awesome Gemini Cli

Commands & Extensions

  • ClipUGC (⭐4) - Gemini CLI extension that makes UGC style vertical videos for your app with AI influencers who keep the same face: describe an AI influencer, add a screen recording of your app, and get a ready-to-post video with a hook line for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. Bundles the hosted ClipUGC MCP server (OAuth sign-in, no API key), four Agent Skills and a GEMINI.md context file; needs a ClipUGC account, with free credits to try. Local stdio alternative: npx -y clipugc mcp with CLIPUGC_API_KEY (paid plans). MIT. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/clipugc/ClipUGC-CLI.
  • Kraft Lite (⭐13) - Gemini CLI extension (also a Claude Code plugin) that walks a Kraft chain from spec to pull request inside one session: steps run in order from the chain file, it stops at each gate for a person's answer, and it caps its fix loops. No server; install from a clone with gemini extensions install <clone>/plugins/kraft-lite. Apache-2.0.

16. Magictools

Graphics / Texture Tools

  • 🆓 Normal Map Bench - Generate tangent-space normal maps for game textures from height images in the browser, with a live lighting preview and OpenGL or DirectX PNG export.

Graphics / Vector/Image Editor

  • 🆓 PixelArtHive Sprite Upscaler - Resize sprites for 2D games at whole-number scales without blur. Runs in the browser without uploading the sprite.

AI / Voxel Editors

  • 🎉 AI Art Engine (⭐268) - Node-based AI game asset studio for generating and refining sprites, Spine 2D/DragonBones/Live2D rigs, 3D models, PBR materials, shaders and SFX, with MCP agent control and Unity/Godot/Cocos export.

17. Awesome Iot

Software / Libraries and Tools

  • usb-rea (⭐14) - Reverse Engineer any USB gadget: capture, diff, infer, and generate open drivers with evidence.

18. Free for Dev

Messaging and Streaming

  • GravEx Chat - Free chat sdk that works for any client, like web, Android, iOS or whatever. Create API key and hand it over to your own Agent(Claude, Codex...) with llms.txt, then you get your messenger to your service. It's that simple.

Web Hosting

  • Reliant - Host, monitor, and deploy your services with production best practices. Tracing, continuous profiling, metrics, and logs fully baked in and correlated with each release allow you to identify and auto rollback on demand. One free static site per organization, 1 GiB of storage, 10 GiB of traffic a month, CDN with HTTPS, custom domains, no card needed, deployed with the open-source forge CLI.

Analytics, Events and Statistics

  • RudderStack - Event streaming to 200+ destinations and data warehouse, plus reverse ETL. Comes with MCP server and CLI for AI agents. Free forever for 250k events/month.

19. Awesome Mac

Design and Product / Screenshot Tools

  • Lumela (⭐13) - Cross-platform screenshot tool that blurs emails, card numbers, IPs and API keys with on-device OCR, then beautifies the shot.

Design and Product / Screen Recording

  • Back to Bug (⭐0) - Menu bar replay recorder that saves recent screen activity as video for bug reports.

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • Airbag (⭐3) - Open-source menu bar app that snapshots a project before each shell command an AI coding agent runs that can change files, so deleted files and a wiped .env can be restored in one click.
  • TurboFieldfare (⭐7.2k) - Native ChatGPT-like Mac app running Google’s Gemma AI (26B-A4B MoE) privately on your device, even on low-end 8 GB M-series Macs.

Browsers / Audio Record and Process

  • Brk (⭐2) - Native Swift and AppKit rebuild of Arc on Chromium, with a Raycast-style command bar and AI that runs on your own Claude Code or Codex plan and local models.

Security Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • AI Access Auditor - See and revoke what AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can access on your Mac.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • Menew - All-in-one menu bar app with a command palette, clipboard history, window snapping, screenshots, a system monitor, meeting minutes and Claude Code/Codex usage limits, using on-device AI.
  • twistel (⭐4) - Menu bar file converter: drag files, hold a key and drop them on a ring menu to convert images, audio, video and documents, compress, OCR, redact or sign PDFs, fully offline.

Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall

  • Cleaner - Open-source cleaner that shows every item before removal, keeps its rules in one public file, and holds what you remove in a 7-day quarantine you can restore from.

Utilities / General Tools

  • LocalSR - Open-source app for upscaling, denoising and restoring photos and videos with local AI models.
  • Pake - Turn any website into a lightweight desktop app with its own icon, window and Dock entry.

Utilities / Productivity

  • Browserdoor (⭐5) - Open-source link picker that asks which browser, browser profile, or Zen space should open each link.
  • Volant - Private, open-source launcher for apps, files, calculations, notes, clipboard history and coding agents.

Utilities / System Related Tools

  • Fan Curve (⭐0) - Open-source fan curve controller for Apple Silicon Macs that sets fan speed from CPU temperature.
  • Kombucha (⭐9) - Menu bar battery charge limiter that stops charging at a chosen level to extend battery lifespan.

Gaming Software / System Related Tools

  • Soju - Installs the official Windows Battle.net, Steam, Epic, GOG, EA app, Rockstar and Ubisoft Connect clients on Apple Silicon through Wine and Apple's GPTK, with a native library of all your games.

20. Awesome Testing

Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

  • Momentic - End-to-end tests for web apps in Chromium and mobile apps on hosted iOS simulators and Android emulators, written as YAML that mixes preset steps with natural-language AI steps and run from a CLI locally or in CI. Includes Mo, an agent that explores a running app from a brief and reports findings with evidence.

21. Collective Ai Tools

3D

  • objekto.io - Turns a few words, a photo or a sketch into a multi-part, print-ready 3D model designed by AI, then has it 3D printed and delivered (France only for now). #freemium

Design

  • DESIGN:OS Studio - FREE desktop design studio where your own AI agent designs on .fig files and you refine on a GPU canvas. #free #design

Developer Tools

  • Continua - Experimental macOS 13+ companion designed to resume interrupted Codex Desktop coding tasks after supported usage resets, with local task history; unsigned/not notarized, manual updates, and genuine unattended recovery unverified. #free
  • HopBase - AI API gateway with one base URL for Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and Qwen text models plus image and video models such as Seedream, Seedance and Kling, compatible with OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini endpoints. #paid #api #llm
  • MailVeri MCP (⭐1) - Open-source MCP server that lets Claude, Cursor and other agents verify single emails and bulk lists via the MailVeri API (SMTP, catch-all, disposable and role detection). #freemium #opensource #mcp

Human Resources

  • CookLLM - AI job matcher that emails you new AI jobs from 1,300+ AI companies' career pages and hiring posts on X and LinkedIn, scored against your resume. #paid

Image Generator

  • AI Anime Generator - Create anime portraits and original characters from text or reference images, with 40 one-time signup credits. #freemium
  • ThumbnailSnap - Generates YouTube, Shorts and TikTok thumbnails with AI and keeps the title as an editable text layer; cropping your own photo and adding text is free. #freemium

Marketing

  • Revenue Scout - Sales Prospecting Assistant that finds public posts where people need what you sell and drafts replies for you to review and post. #freemium #lead-generation

Meeting

  • Meetini - Meeting and interview assistant for Apple Silicon Macs with local captions, transcripts, meeting notes, and metered AI assistance. #paid

Prompts

  • AgentCraft Nano Banana 2.1 Prompts - 90 Nano Banana 2.1 image prompts, each shown with its output, in a free library of 2,473 image and video prompts that also covers Seedance 2.5 and Kling 4.0. #free
  • Prompt Generator - Writes prompts in the syntax of the AI tool you pick (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, Nano Banana, Veo, Sora and more), with 10 free prompts a day and no sign-up. #freemium #writing

Real Estate

  • EmptyRoom AI - Furnish vacant listing photos in any style for agents and sellers, with unlimited free restages. #paid
  • MotionCasa - Creates listing videos from property photos with AI motion and reel templates; AI generation requires purchased credits. #paid

SEO

  • Akii: SEO & AI Search Optimizer - Audits sites, checks links, plans content, and adds JSON-LD with a free Claude Code plugin. #free #opensource #seo

Video

  • AI Rap Video - AI rap video generator: write or draft rap lyrics, pick a photo, original character or duo, and get a short lip-synced rap clip (8-15s); packs from $4.99. #paid
  • EasyRap - Creates short rap music videos from one or two photos using paid credits. #paid
  • Valmera - Edits uploaded footage through natural-language instructions in a browser studio or a connected AI assistant over MCP, with cuts, captions, reframing, preview review and MP4 export. #paid #video #mcp

22. Awesome Rust

Applications / Observability

  • uptimepage/uptimepage (⭐55) - Uptime monitoring with public status pages and automatic incidents, with a REST API and a Terraform provider.

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 10, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Graphql

Tools - API Clients & Workbenches / React

  • Gostman (⭐67) - Open source desktop and web API client with a schema browser, query validation, file uploads and subscriptions over WebSocket or server-sent events, plus REST, gRPC and more.

2. Awesome Qgis

Data Sources / Field and Mobile

  • Geoscience Data Portals (⭐2) - Connection files for the WMS and WFS services of government geological surveys, loaded through the Data Source Manager.

3. Awesome Jmeter

Tutorials

  • Performance Testing with JMeter - A step-by-step guide to designing and running load tests with Apache JMeter.

4. Awesome Data Engineering

Data Ingestion

  • adbcBridge (⭐2) - Driver for ADBC, Apache Arrow's database connectivity API, that sits on top of any ODBC driver, so databases with no native Arrow driver return columnar Arrow record batches and take bulk ingest.
  • Renart (⭐96) - Local-first IDE for authoring and running SQL and Python data pipelines stored in Git.
  • OLake (⭐1.6k) - Open-source replication of Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Kafka and S3 into Apache Iceberg, with CDC and table maintenance. Written in Go.
  • Firecrawl (⭐200k) - Open-source web data API that scrapes, crawls, maps, and searches the web and returns Markdown or structured JSON for data pipelines and LLM ingestion.

Serialization format

  • SequenceFile - A flat file consisting of binary key/value pairs. It is extensively used in MapReduce as input/output formats.

Stream Processing

  • Spring Cloud Dataflow - Streaming and tasks execution between Spring Boot apps.

Charts and Dashboards

  • SmoothieCharts (⭐2.3k) - A JavaScript Charting Library for Streaming Data.
  • Streamlit - An open-source Python framework for building interactive data apps and dashboards with minimal code. Connects to any data source and supports real-time updates, caching, and one-click deployment.
  • GeoSQL (⭐684) - Claude/Codex skill for cost-safe geospatial SQL on BigQuery and Snowflake.

Workflow

  • Cascading - Java based application development platform.
  • Dataform (⭐1k) - An open-source framework and web based IDE to manage datasets and their dependencies. SQLX extends your existing SQL warehouse dialect to add features that support dependency management, testing, documentation and more.
  • Ciaren (⭐37) - A local-first visual ETL and ML workflow builder with per-step previews, cron scheduling, and export to pandas or Polars code.

Datasets / Data Dumps

  • OpenChainBench - Live dataset of crypto infrastructure benchmarks (RPC latency, oracle deviation, bridge fees, L1 finality, perp DEX metrics). Open methodology, CC BY 4.0, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20800312. Source (⭐9).

Profiling / Data Profiler

  • dataprof (⭐33) - Data profiling and quality gates for CSV, JSON, Parquet, DataFrames and Arrow tables, with a Rust core and a Python API.
  • Dex (⭐116) - Agent-native warehouse profiling, join verification, and schema-drift detection with dbt transformation workflows.

Testing / Data Profiler

  • DataOps TestGen (⭐81) - Open-source data quality tool that profiles tables, generates validation tests from the profiling results, and monitors freshness, volume, and schema from a web UI.

Community / Conferences

  • Data Council - The first technical conference that bridges the gap between data scientists, data engineers and data analysts.

5. Awesome Design Systems

Design systems of some "known" companies

  • Firefox Acorn Design System - Launch recognizable, enjoyable Firefox products and features faster.
  • Google Material Design - Create intuitive and beautiful products with Material Design.

Design systems articles

  • Design systems and AI: Why MCP servers are the unlock

More resources

  • Design system checklist - Build better design systems. An open-source checklist to help you plan, build and grow your design system.
  • Design.system - Resources for the design systems community.

Design tools

  • Penpot - The first Open Source design and prototyping platform meant for cross-domain teams.

Accessibility (a11y)

  • The A11Y Project - A community-driven effort to make web accessibility easier. See resources section.

Design tokens

  • Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10 - First stable version of the Design Tokens Community Group specification, with format, color and resolver modules.

Plugins

  • Tokens Studio - Manage design tokens in Figma and keep them in sync with your code repository.

Tools

  • Style Dictionary (⭐4.9k) - A Style Dictionary uses design tokens to define styles once and use those styles on any platform or language.
  • Terrazzo - Generate code for web, mobile and native apps from design tokens JSON in the Design Tokens Community Group format.

Develop isolated components / Storybook addons

  • Accessibility - Test component compliance with web accessibility standards.
  • Actions - Get UI feedback when an action is performed on an interactive element.
  • Backgrounds - Switch backgrounds to view components in different settings.
  • Docs - Document component usage and properties in Markdown.
  • Links - Link stories together to build demos and prototypes with your UI components.
  • Source - View a story's source code to see how it works and paste into your app.
  • Viewport - Build responsive components by adjusting Storybook's viewport size and orientation.
  • Vitest - Run every story as a Vitest test, with interaction, accessibility and visual checks.

Component patterns / Storybook addons

  • ARIA Authoring Practices Guide patterns - Reference patterns from the W3C for building accessible components, with keyboard interaction and working examples.
  • Open UI - W3C Community Group that researches how design systems name and build components, and proposes new native HTML controls.
  • The Component Gallery - Up-to-date repository of interface components based on examples from real design systems.

Headless component libraries / Storybook addons

  • Ark UI - Unstyled, accessible components for your design system that work in React, Vue, Solid and Svelte.
  • Base UI - Unstyled components for building accessible design systems, from the creators of Radix, Floating UI and Material UI.
  • Radix Primitives - Open-source component library for building high-quality, accessible design systems and web apps.
  • React Aria - Accessible components and hooks with behavior, internationalization and no imposed styles, by Adobe.
  • shadcn/ui - Composable, accessible components you copy into your codebase and own, distributed through a registry.

Pattern libraries articles / Storybook addons

  • Design systems workflow in Storybook
  • How packaging makes it dead simple to share UI components

AI and design systems / Storybook addons

  • DESIGN.md (⭐29k) - Format specification for describing a visual identity and design system to coding agents.
  • Figma Code Connect (⭐1.6k) - Connects design system components in code with their counterparts in Figma, so developers and agents get real snippets.
  • Figma Console MCP (⭐3.3k) - MCP server that connects AI assistants to Figma for design system extraction, creation and debugging.
  • Figma MCP server - Official server that gives AI agents the design context of your Figma files to generate code, and lets them write back to the canvas.
  • Storybook MCP addon - Helps agents write and test stories for your UI components.

Unit & Regression test / Storybook addons

  • Chromatic - Visual testing for React, Angular and Vue. Chromatic ensures consistency in UI components, down to the pixel. Every commit is automatically tested for visual changes in the cloud.

Books / Storybook addons

  • Building Design Systems - Unify user experiences through a shared design language by Sarrah Vesselov and Taurie Davis.
  • Frontend Architecture for Design Systems - A modern blueprint for scalable and sustainable websites by Micah Godbolt.

Talks / Storybook addons

  • Design Processes & Systems in Craft - Design shouldn't be a siloed practice, but a collaborative effort rooted in process. How do we get there? In this session, we'll look at how we can reframe our design approach to be more human-centric and systems-minded by Courtney Bradford.

6. Awesome Ansible

Tools

  • ansible-vars (⭐4) - ansible-vault replacement that supports encrypting individual vault variables.

7. Awesome Readme

Examples

  • shivrajsinhzala/transit-timetables (⭐0) - Live production demo link. Clear problem statement, step-by-step pipeline commands, hosting architecture details, indexing strategy, and open data attribution.

8. Awesome Cli Apps in a Csv

Text processing

  • TeXicode (⭐66) - TeX to Unicode, a Unicode TeX renderer that renders TeX into Unicode by rendering the TeX.

Dotfile managers

  • dudu (⭐6) - Back up your whole dev setup in one command and restore it on a new machine in another: packages, runtimes, dotfiles and terminal, on macOS, Linux and Windows.

Connection managers

  • bayesian-ssh (⭐19) - SSH session manager for the terminal and the desktop: fuzzy, usage-ranked search, bastions, Kerberos, file transfer, and bssh Teams for end-to-end encrypted sharing.

AI / LLM integration

  • shell_sage (⭐407) - AI-powered command-line assistant that integrates seamlessly with your terminal workflow through tmux. It provides contextual help for shell operations, making it easier to navigate complex command-line tasks, debug scripts, and manage your system.

Weather

  • rustormy (⭐91) - Minimal and neofetch-like weather CLI with multiple data providers support, ASCI-icons, ANSI colors, localization and various output modes.

9. Awesome Testing

Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

  • e2e (⭐14k) - Open-source end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile apps, combining natural-language agent actions with locators and assertions.

Software / AI & LLM Testing

  • Bite (⭐3) - Open-source CLI that checks whether recent "fixed" commits are really guarded by tests: it takes each fix back out and runs the project's own tests to see if any fail. Free mode needs no API key.
  • judge-check (⭐0) - Checks whether an LLM judge can tell good output from bad by mixing planted decoys and known-good answers into its real inputs, then reporting how often the decoys pass. Zero dependencies, with an offline demo.

Software / Test Report Diagnostics

  • coverage (⭐4) - GitHub Action that compares LCOV and Go coverage reports against the base branch and posts per-file changes as a sticky PR comment.

Software / Static Analysis

  • test-inventory (⭐4) - Extract declared tests, states and skip reasons from JavaScript and TypeScript source without running the suite, and compare saved inventories between revisions.

10. Awesome Neovim

Workflow / Stats Tracking

  • gisketch/triforce.nvim (⭐317) - Gamified stat tracker with XP, levels, achievements, and activity heatmaps for your coding sessions with lualine integration.

11. Awesome Open Source Games

Browser-Based / RPG

  • Daoyou (万界道友) (⭐161) - Chinese-language text-based cultivation RPG with turn-based combat, sect progression and spirit beasts. Currently free; registration required.

12. Awesome Deno

Modules / Static site generator

  • zerho (⭐1) - High-performance documentation engine for Deno 2 and Edge runtimes with interactive playground, OpenAPI explorer, and native llms.txt support.

Modules / Web framework

  • orpc (⭐5.8k) - End-to-end typesafe APIs with RPC and OpenAPI support, without code generation.

Showcases / XML

  • Medusa Edge API Gateway (⭐1) - Resilient Edge API Gateway and caching proxy on Deno Deploy with circuit breaker, single-flight deduplication, and Deno KV.

Tools / XML

  • nemesis (⭐1) - Automated DevSecOps auditing, repository hygiene, auto-fix, and compliance CLI built with Deno 2.

13. Awesome Go

Networking / HTTP Clients

  • gophertools/requests (⭐1.7k) — HTTP requests for Gophers ☆1,672

14. Awesome Mac

File Management / File Utilities

  • andronasef/shark (⭐27) — Shark - File Manager: a free, open source Mac file manager with tabs ☆34

System Tools / Menu Bar

  • KJeon10/BannerHither (⭐16) — Notification banners on the display you're actually looking at ☆18

15. Awesome Gemini Cli

Development Tools & Utilities

  • AI Access Auditor (⭐5) - Desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) that lists what Gemini CLI and other coding agents are allowed to do (trusted folders, allowed tools, MCP servers, API keys left in logs) and revokes any of it with undo. Can add a Gemini CLI hook that asks before a tool runs. Local only, MIT.

16. Awesome Zsh Plugins

Plugins / superconsole - Windows-only

  • gui-detach (⭐0) - Returns the prompt in interactive ZSH when a GUI app is launched on Linux, and leaves CLI tools in the foreground.
  • worktrunk-herdr (⭐0) - glues Worktrunk (wt), AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Pi) and herdr together.

17. Magictools

Graphics / Assets/Placeholders

  • 🆓 pixelfx.io - Free animated pixel art effects for games, with browser previews, recoloring, and transparent PNG sprite sheet and animation JSON downloads; MIT-licensed library assets.

Graphics / Animation

  • 💸 VfxSmith - AI pixel art VFX generator for games with chat refinement, editable effect components, and sprite sheet, JSON, GIF, PNG sequence and Godot 4 exports; free library and editing, paid AI generation after initial credits.

Board Games / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 Game Piece Studio - Browser-based designer for board game cards, boards, tiles and tokens that binds layouts to spreadsheet data and exports print-ready PDF/PNG.

18. Free for Dev

Crash and Exception Handling

  • measure.sh - Mobile app monitoring with errors, performance tracking and session replays. 5 GB data per month free. No limits if self-hosted.

19. Awesome Mac

Utilities / Quality of Life Improvements

  • Dimmerly - Open-source menu bar app for per-display brightness, warmth, and contrast, with presets, schedules, and DDC/CI monitor control.

20. Awesome Rust

Applications / Graphics

  • TobiasGrothmann/plottery (⭐2) [plottery_lib] - Generative art engine for pen plotters, with a desktop editor to tweak parameters live.

Applications / MLOps

  • logicplanes/kaeso (⭐6) [kaeso-kpp] - Self-hosted AI gateway with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, SSO, budgets and request logs

Development tools / Workflow Automation

  • gvcgo/version-manager (⭐1.3k) - A cross-platform SDK version manager with project-level version pinning and session isolation.

Libraries / Geospatial

  • open-geocode-rs/open-geocode (⭐58) [open-geocode] - Fast, lightweight, self-hosted geocoding in pure Rust.

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 09, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Developer First

Authentication & Identity

  • Frontegg - Customer identity for B2B SaaS: authentication, SSO/SCIM, MFA, RBAC and a self-service admin portal for your customers.

2. Awesome Smart Tv

Other Lists / Official resources

  • awesome-webos (⭐228) - A curated list of resources for webOS.

Project / Markdown and LaTeX

  • tiagovla/projet.nvim (⭐2) - A minimalist tool for managing your projects, with just enough French to feel fancy.

Buffers / Markdown and LaTeX

  • tiagovla/scope.nvim (⭐544) - Scope buffers to individual tabs while keeping native buffer navigation commands.

Colorscheme / Markdown and LaTeX

  • tiagovla/tokyodark.nvim (⭐619) - [TS][LSP][Lua] A clean and customizable dark colorscheme.

RPG

Text & NLP / Text Analysis

  • BlackRabbitt/mspm (⭐29) — Multi-String Pattern Matching Algorithm Using TrieNode ☆30

6. Awesome Gemini Cli

Commands & Extensions

  • tech-to-motion (⭐1) - Agent Skill that runs in Gemini CLI and other agents (npx skills add georgesmomo/tech-to-motion). Turns a docker-compose, Kubernetes manifests, Terraform, a CI workflow or a postmortem into a motion-design explainer video with animated architecture diagrams and synthesised sound, rendered locally with Hyper
  • idea-to-motion (⭐0) - Agent Skill that runs in Gemini CLI and other agents (npx skills add georgesmomo/idea-to-motion). Turns any idea into a motion-design video (MP4) with procedural music, synthesised sound effects and an optional local voice-over with captions; asks up to 3 questions only when the brief is incomplete. 14 styles, rendered locally with HyperFrames, no API key.Frames.
  • Publora (⭐2) - Gemini CLI extension that schedules and publishes social media posts to LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, Mastodon and Telegram through the hosted Publora MCP server, with browser sign-in. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/publora-team/gemini-cli-publora.

MCP Servers

  • Shotboard (⭐2) - Local MCP server built into Shotboard, a closed-source Mac app for marketing content, plus a Gemini CLI extension manifest. Lets Gemini CLI search Meta and TikTok ads, extract scripts from links, and generate images, video and audio with 100 media models while the app is open. Connect with gemini mcp add --transport http -s user --trust shotboard http://127.0.0.1:4317/mcp.
  • Datacircle - Find the best GTM APIs. Our MCP server is open to anyone, with no key: add api.datacircle.dev/mcp to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor.

7. Magictools

Board Games / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 RandomGeneratr NPC Generator - Generate NPC cards with names, roles, motives, flaws, secrets, factions and story hooks for tabletop RPG preparation.

8. Awesome Osint

Domain and IP Research / GitHub

  • VPNDetection - Checks whether an IP is a VPN, proxy, Tor exit or hosting address. Free, no signup. Also a Chrome extension that looks up an IP you select on any page.

Image Analysis / GitHub

  • WhatsInMyFile - In-browser metadata and hidden content checker for photos, PDFs and Office files; nothing is uploaded.

9. Free for Dev

Messaging and Streaming

  • notifysphere.net - All-in-one Customer Engagement and Automation Tool ( push notifications, whatsapp messages, helpdesk, tracker link and events tracking) for SaaS. Free for up to 1,000 active users per month.

DNS

  • DNSvivo - Free managed DNS with automatic failover, weighted load balancing, and Dynamic DNS (DDNS). Includes 2 domains, 5 IP addresses monitored from 5 locations, and 3 DDNS records.

10. Awesome Mac

Terminal Apps / Databases

  • Cue - IDE-style autocomplete for commands, options, Git branches, and files in zsh on Apple Terminal and VS Code’s integrated terminal.

Design and Product / Screen Recording

  • Native Screen - Open-source screen recorder and editor with a multi-track timeline, auto-zoom, and on-device captions.

Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

  • Nimbus (⭐3) - Native SoundCloud client with gapless playback, a drag-and-drop queue, Chromecast and a full-screen vinyl player.

Voice-to-Text / Audio Record and Process

  • Lowspeak (⭐6) - Native, ultrafast AI dictation written in Rust: hold fn to talk into any app in 35 languages, free online with your own Groq key or offline with Whisper and Parakeet.

Utilities / Clipboard Tools

  • Cue - Clipboard that reads the focused field and pastes the part of your clip that fits, such as an email address or a phone number.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • Claude Accounts (⭐3) - Switches the Claude desktop app between your accounts with one click, without losing sessions.
  • Polka - Turns the MacBook notch into a control center for VPN connections, tab groups from any browser, now playing, calendar, an on-device translator and clipboard history.
  • LogoLight - Menu bar app that turns off, dims, or animates the illuminated Apple logo on the MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display.
  • NØTH (⭐1) - Turns the MacBook notch into live activities and a command center for music, files, clipboard, calendar, notes and tools.

Utilities / System Related Tools

  • FixStat (⭐8) - Menu bar monitor and diagnostics for Mac repair: per-model sensor names, battery cell data, SSD SMART including USB drives, panic history and guided hardware tests.

11. Awesome Testing

Software / Service Virtualization

  • Buggregator (⭐1.1k) - Local debugging server with a mock server (OpenAPI import), HTTP request capture and a fake SMTP server whose API waits for an email and extracts one-time codes.

Software / Test Automation Frameworks

  • blastradius (⭐13) - Test impact analysis for JVM projects (Maven, Gradle, JUnit 5) that runs only the tests affected by a change, using class dependencies recorded by a Java agent.

12. Awesome Rust

Applications / Database

  • ModernRelay/omnigraph (⭐1.9k) - Typed property graph database that stores graphs on object storage (S3-compatible or local disk) in the Lance format, with Git-style branches and merges, schemas enforced on every write, and graph traversal, vector search and full-text search in one query.

Applications / Productivity

  • glimpse-hq/Glimpse (⭐62) - Local voice dictation and meeting transcription for macOS and Windows, built with Tauri. Speech recognition and speaker labels run on your computer.

Libraries / GUI

  • IUP
    • Kiss-ui (⭐344) - A simple UI framework built on IUP
