entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 07, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Lowcode

AI

  • Layerwise - Desktop app for building, previewing, and publishing full-stack web apps with AI, with local source files and built-in database, authentication, and hosting.

2. Awesome Preact

Contents / Components

  • RevoGrid Kanban (⭐10) - Workflow boards, swimlanes, and card editing for the <revo-grid> custom element. Commercial with a 30-day trial.
  • RevoGrid Gantt (⭐10) - Project tasks, dependencies, and Gantt timelines for the <revo-grid> custom element. Commercial with a 30-day trial.
  • RevoGrid Pivot (⭐10) - Pivot tables and analytical reporting for the <revo-grid> custom element. Commercial with a 30-day trial.
  • RevoGrid Charts (⭐1) - Interactive charts with a DOM-container API and a custom-element adapter example. Commercial with a 30-day trial.
  • RevoGrid Scheduler (⭐10) - Calendar and resource scheduling for the <revo-grid> custom element. Commercial with a 30-day trial.
  • Revo UI (⭐9) - MIT-licensed Preact UI components for reports and dashboards, including form controls, pickers, and dialogs.

3. Awesome Acg

Uncategorized

  • OpenAmika (⭐468) - MekaHime's AI companion Amika, open source. Live2D avatar, real-time voice, long-term memory, OpenRouter or Ollama brain. [English/中文/日本語]

4. ALL About RSS

🔍 Feed Search Engines / 酷Q Plugin

  • Offline Web Search : searches a bundled offline catalogue of 56,000+ RSS and Atom feed URLs, with swappable SQLite indexes and no network queries

specifically from (a certain platform) / Bluesky

  • FxEmbed : generates RSS 2.0 and Atom feeds for Bluesky profiles, with media-only variants and a configurable item count

RSS2Podcast / Webpage Monitor Services with capability of monitoring RSS Feed 1264

  • rss-pod (⭐42): Self-hosted tool that turns RSS articles into multi-speaker conversational podcasts using LLMs and TTS, with scheduled generation and podcast RSS output.

Combine multiple feeds into one / Webpage Monitor Services with capability of monitoring RSS Feed 1264

  • rssrssrssrss 1521 : merge multiple RSS feeds into one without an account, with the feed list encoded into the permalink

5. Awesome Integration

Projects / Managed File Transfer

  • Titan MFT Server - Enterprise-level MFT server offering high availability, failover capabilities, and efficient large-scale file automation.

Projects / Messaging as a Service

  • Oracle Cloud Streaming - Serverless, real-time event streaming platform with Apache Kafka compatibility for efficient data processing.

Resources / Protocols

  • CoAP - A specialized application protocol designed for constrained devices in the Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystem. CoAP offers a lightweight, low-overhead communication mechanism to support resource-constrained devices.

6. Discount for Student Dev

SaaS

  • Remote Frontend Jobs [FREE] - Every remote junior and internship developer job from dozens of job boards in one place, with junior email alerts. Sign up with your school email and Pro is free for 2 months: jobs 24 hours early, daily picks with the reasons they match, and AI search. Also for backend and Java.

7. Android Security Awesome

Tools / App Vulnerability Scanners

  • FlutterGuard (⭐34) - Offline on-device scanner for released Flutter APKs: manifest policy, libraries, endpoints, exposed strings and dependency clues, with local reports.

Tools / Misc Tools

  • MobShield (⭐13) - Modular, open-source RASP library for Android with weighted, tunable threat scoring for root, hooking frameworks (Frida, Xposed), debuggers, emulators and app tampering. Detect-only by default; no telemetry.

8. Awesome Gemini Cli

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • Orchestrator - Open-source desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents as parallel workers, each in its own git worktree, with an orchestrator agent splitting the work and a board tracking every PR through CI and review.

Development Tools & Utilities

  • AI Meter (⭐4) - Native Windows 11 app that lists active Gemini CLI sessions, on Windows and in WSL, with their model and context in use, next to Google Antigravity quotas and other AI usage limits in a taskbar pill.
  • AI Usage Meter (VS Code) (⭐2) - VS Code extension that reads Gemini CLI session files in ~/.gemini/tmp and shows today's tokens and estimated cost in the status bar, with a dashboard split by project and model. Also covers Claude Code and Codex. Runs offline, no login or API key.

MCP Servers

  • Sequenzy (⭐3) - Hosted MCP server for Sequenzy, an email marketing platform for SaaS and ecommerce: manage subscribers, lists, tags and segments, build campaigns, sequences and templates, send transactional email, run A/B tests and read delivery stats from Gemini CLI. About 420 tools, each annotated read-only or destructive. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in (an API key also works); free plan with 2,500 emails/month. MIT. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/Sequenzy/mcp, then /mcp auth sequenzy. Local stdio alternative: npx -y @sequenzy/mcp with SEQUENZY_API_KEY.
  • Imagera (⭐2) - Remote MCP server and Gemini CLI extension for image, video, voice and music generation and editing (OAuth sign-in, no API key), with 37 skills and the credit cost stated before each run. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/alexadams6ix/imagera-skills
  • Vicem (⭐7) - Zero-dependency MCP server and CLI that harvests live coding sessions (Gemini CLI chats and GEMINI.md, plus Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 15+ agents), scores context salience (0–100%), skeletonizes code by 80–90% into a local SHA-256 ledger (.vicem/ledger.json) for lossless on-demand vicem_rehydrate, and writes a portable .vicem/BATON.md handoff. Runs locally with zero network calls. MIT. Add with gemini mcp add vicem npx -y vicem-cli mcp.
  • LinkJolt (⭐2) - Set up and run an affiliate program for your SaaS from Gemini CLI: plan a commission from published benchmarks, create campaigns, add and check tracking for Stripe, Paddle, Polar or Creem, invite affiliates, approve affiliates and sales, and see who you owe. 28 tools; it can't move money. Hosted Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in; needs a LinkJolt account (7-day free trial). MIT. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/Efesop/linkjolt-mcp-server, then /mcp auth linkjolt.
  • GSC PAP (⭐2) - Hosted, read-only MCP server and Gemini CLI extension for your own Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, PageSpeed Insights and Chrome UX Report data, plus live Google results. Sign in with Google on first use; it keeps a Search Console archive past Google's 16-month limit. Free. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/aliarifsoydas/gsc-pap-claude-plugin
  • gemini-pro-mcp (⭐4) - MCP server that brings a Google AI Pro subscription to Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and the Antigravity CLI: Gemini through the Antigravity CLI on the plan's limits (no API bill), Deep Research, Google Flow videos of any length, Gemini Notebooks (Audio Overviews), AI Mode and Jules, plus Nano Banana images and Omni Flash video through the Gemini API. gemini-pro-mcp setup registers it with Gemini CLI and the other clients in one command, and doctor checks what works. MIT. Install: uvx --from git+https://github.com/Muzaqil555/gemini-pro-mcp gemini-pro-mcp setup.

9. Free for Dev

Security and PKI

  • Topscan.me - SaaS vulnerability scanning platform. Free: a full infrastructure scan of one host every week, Discovery and Attack Surface for everything around it, one repository, one user, findings with a fix and a Security Score.

PaaS

  • Uppcoder - Full stack development environment hosted on own infrastructure with selectable framework, db engine behind https with ssh access, vscode + terminal in the editor. Free tier: always on, 2GB disk and 2GB ram. No card required.

Payment and Billing Integration

  • BillDog.io - In-app subscription paywalls, A/B testing, product analytics, and messaging with SDKs for iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Unity, and web. Free up to $3k/mo in tracked revenue and 1M monthly analytics events.

10. Awesome Selfhosted

Software / Task Management & To-do Lists

  • Kept Notes - A notes app built for quick capture: text notes, checklists, images, drawings, links, attachments, labels, colors, and reminders (alternative to Google Keep). (Source Code (⭐318)) AGPL-3.0/MIT Nodejs/Docker

11. Awesome Mac

Reading and Writing Tools / Note-taking

  • Knovum (⭐34) - Local-first 2D spatial AI knowledge space with embedded LanceDB vector search, infinite canvas, and on-device Whisper transcription.

12. Awesome Testing

Software / Security Testing

  • appfuzz (⭐2) - Fuzzes WebAssembly apps against a simulated backend and reports crashes, injection, n+1 queries and data leaks, with an exit code for CI.

Software / AI & LLM Testing

  • ScopeHaven (⭐1) - Runs an AI agent's tasks against a local copy of your app, as different users, and checks whether "done" matches what the app's records show. Node CLI and GitHub Action, Apache-2.0.

  • MAD Designer (⭐2) - open-source ad-hoc SQL query builder, banded report designer, and headless rendering engine for PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQL Server, and SQLite.

8. Awesome Cli Apps in a Csv

File format converters

  • carta (⭐59) - A universal document converter written in Rust. Read a markup format, render it back out in another. A fast, lightweight reimplementation of pandoc.

Programming

  • hdi (⭐5) - Summarise how to install / run / test a project, from its README.

Screen recorder

  • evp (⭐45) - A terminal recoder powered by libghostty and Rust which makes beautiful terminal recordings.

9. Awesome Cpp

Audio

  • libsamplerate (⭐750) - An audio sample rate conversion library. [BSD-2-Clause]

CLI

  • ansicolor-w32.c (⭐70) - ANSI escape sequence support for Windows console applications.

Compression

  • libzip (⭐1.1k) - A C library for reading, creating, and modifying zip archives.

Concurrency

  • libcuckoo (⭐1.8k) - A high-performance, concurrent hash table.

Debug

  • easy_profiler (⭐2.4k) - Lightweight profiler library for C++. [MIT]
  • Orbit (⭐4.3k) - C/C++ performance profiler. [BSD-2-Clause]

Logging

  • NanoLog (⭐3.4k) - An extremely performant nanosecond-scale logging system for C++.

Machine Learning

  • clDNN (⭐574) - Compute library for deep neural networks.

Math

  • ampl/mp (⭐255) - An open-source library for mathematical programming.
  • cvmlib (⭐8) - This C++ class library encapsulates concepts of vector and different matrices including square, band, symmetric and hermitian ones in Euclidean space of real and complex numbers. [Boost]
  • libbf - A C library for arbitrary-precision binary floating-point arithmetic.

PDF

  • wkhtmltopdf (⭐15k) - Convert HTML to PDF using Qt WebKit. [LGPL-3.0]

Physics

  • IAU SOFA (⭐3) - Standards of Fundamental Astronomy (SOFA) algorithms and procedures implementing standard models used in fundamental astronomy. [SOFA]

Robotics

  • Sophus (⭐2.5k) - C++ implementation of Lie groups using Eigen.

Serial Port

  • hidapi (⭐2.5k) - A simple library for communicating with USB and Bluetooth HID devices.

Virtual Machines

  • vmir (⭐701) - Virtual machine for a low-level intermediate representation. [MIT]

Miscellaneous

  • cpp-peglib (⭐1.1k) - A single-header PEG (Parsing Expression Grammars) library. [MIT]
  • metal (⭐333) - Header-only C++14 template metaprogramming library. [MIT]
  • pystring (⭐1.1k) - C++ functions matching the interface and behavior of Python string methods. [BSD-3-Clause]
  • The Algorithms - C (⭐23k) - Algorithms and data structures implemented in C for education. [MIT]
  • The Algorithms - C-Plus-Plus (⭐35k) - Algorithms and data structures implemented in C++ for education. [MIT]

10. Awesome Analytics

SEO

  • SenseGap - Analytics for the AI crawlers and agents that visit a website (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, ChatGPT-User and others): checks bots against their published IP ranges or forward-confirmed reverse DNS where available and marks the rest unverified, shows which pages AI reads and how many visitors AI sends. The bot list and verification rules are open source. (Demo, Source Code (⭐0)) © SaaS
  • MessGEO - AI search analytics that tracks how brands appear in ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews, with daily prompt tracking, share of voice and competitor comparison. © SaaS

Privacy focused analytics

  • Moxel - Cookieless web analytics for small sites and stores. Shows which form field or checkout step loses visitors, and what to change. © SaaS
  • Skald - Web analytics built from your server's access log; separates people from AI assistants, crawlers and scanners. No cookies or tracking script. (Source Code (⭐22)) © Elastic-2.0 Self-Hosted Python

Heatmap analytics

  • DASHUND - Behavioral analytics for Figma prototypes: real paths (Sankey), click heatmaps, sessions and A/B tests before any code, with no tasks for testers. No IP stored, EU-hosted. Free plan. © SaaS EU

Attribution tracking

  • Appy - Smart links and mobile SDKs for deep linking, install attribution, and in-app event and revenue tracking. SDK features require an Enterprise plan. © SaaS

Social media analytics

  • LurkAPI - Social media data API: public profiles, follower counts, posts and comments from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Reddit and 11 more platforms as JSON. © SaaS

Analytics dashboards

  • MAD Designer - Native macOS and iOS ad-hoc SQL query builder, banded report layout designer, and headless Linux reporting engine supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQL Server, and SQLite. (Source Code (⭐2)) MIT Objective-C
  • arcodash - SQL dashboards that check their own numbers: connect a database, build dashboards, and get alerts on freshness, row count and null-rate checks. Unlimited seats. © SaaS
  • Lookout - Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights for all your Vercel projects on one board, with alerts, read-only share links, a REST API and an MCP server. Free for up to 100 projects. © SaaS

11. Awesome Neovim

Programming Languages Support / Diagnostics

  • alessandropietrobelli/dotnet-counters.nvim (⭐4) - Live .NET runtime metrics (CPU, memory, GC, exceptions, HTTP latency) drawn as graphs in a side panel that opens with nvim-dap debug sessions.

Pre-made Configuration / Stats Tracking

  • LFSCamargo/nvim.setup (⭐1) - Portable config with a file tree, editor tabs, and independent AI CLI chats in one window.

12. Awesome Python

Sponsors

  • PyUiBuilder - Build your Python GUIs like Canva using drag and drop. Export clean, editable Python code.

13. Awesome Mac

Audio & Video / Editors

  • ixiehao/MP4Flow (⭐16) — Native FFmpeg front end for batch video-to-MP4 conversion, trimming, cropping, rotating, and merging. ☆16

System Tools / Menu Bar

  • MidZai/aman_disk (⭐16) — S.M.A.R.T. health, temperature and performance of your Mac's internal ☆18

14. Awesome Gemini Cli

Commands & Extensions

  • Chisle (⭐743) - Gemini CLI extension whose GEMINI.md makes answers shorter without dropping decisive facts: no filler or hedging, the smallest code that works (reuse, stdlib and installed dependencies before new code), and reading less (grep before opening files, sliced reads). Benchmarks with raw transcripts are in the repo. npx chisle mcp wrap also trims oversized MCP tool output in Gemini CLI. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/JayPokale/Chisle. MIT.
  • Hermoso (⭐5) - Gemini CLI extension for marketing: research competitors' ads in the Meta, Google and LinkedIn ad libraries, generate image, video and UGC avatar ads, post and schedule to your own social channels, and manage Meta Ads, Google Ads and TikTok Ads campaigns, through skills that drive the hermoso CLI. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/hermoso-ai/hermoso.

15. Free for Dev

Payment and Billing Integration

  • Canjean - Free exchange rate API for 150+ currencies in JSON, CSV and plain text, no API key or sign-up.

16. Awesome Mac

Reading and Writing Tools / Note-taking

  • Koru - Offline-first, open-source workspace for notes and docs with end-to-end encrypted device-to-device sync, built in Rust.

Terminal Apps / Databases

  • lmux (⭐26) - Lightweight terminal built on libghostty for running Claude Code and Codex sessions, with agent status in the sidebar.

Design and Product / Screen Recording

  • TinyRecorder - Lightweight screen recorder for screens, windows, apps, system audio and a connected iPhone or iPad; a maintained fork of QuickRecorder.

Design and Product / Other Tools

  • Graphis (⭐2) - Open-source app that generates images from text with the MOSS-Image model, locally on Apple silicon.

Download Management Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • Convoy - Open-source download manager with segmented downloads, browser integration, and HLS and DASH stream support.

Input Methods / Audio Record and Process

  • AllInOneIME - Input method that adds AI commands such as @improve, @translate and @question to every text field, with built-in pinyin input.

Browsers / Audio Record and Process

  • camber - Open-source Arc-style browser on Chromium (Electron) with spaces, pinned tabs, folders, a command bar and Arc import.
  • Roar - Open-source agentic browser that uses local or bring-your-own AI models to navigate, read and fill the web for you.

Education / Audio Record and Process

  • Buddy (⭐0) - Study helper in the notch that explains what is on your screen out loud while drawing on it.
  • Leafy - Look up any word on screen with ⌥A, including in PDFs and images, and save it to a searchable local library.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • NVBeacon - Open-source menu bar app for monitoring remote NVIDIA GPU servers over SSH.

Utilities / Window Management

  • Stage Manager - Replacement for Apple's Stage Manager written in Rust, with stages that survive restart and Ctrl-Option-1..9 switching.

17. Awesome Testing

Software / Test Automation Frameworks

  • Cerulion (⭐101) - Open-source robot runtime that records each run and re-executes supported native recordings against new code, exiting 1 with the name of the topic that changed, so a recorded robot run becomes a CI regression test.

18. Collective Ai Tools

Audio & Speech

  • Transcribe Video: To The Text - iPhone app that transcribes video and audio files, YouTube or Vimeo links and live voice recordings, with speaker labels, a one-tap summary and TXT/DOCX export. #freemium #transcription

Developer Tools

  • sqlite-graph-memory (⭐14) - MCP server and CLI that gives coding agents recall over a folder of markdown notes, following [[wikilinks]] as a graph in one SQLite file. #opensource #free #mcp
  • Teapot Router - Team API gateway for GPT and Claude Code: one shared token pool, per-request metering (model, tokens, cache hits, exact cost), a public price book with no login, and org-level key management. #paid
  • UberLLM - One OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API key for GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and uncensored text models plus image, video, music and speech models, billed at what each provider charged. #paid #api #llm

E-Commerce

  • Etsy Search & Shop Sales MCP (⭐3) - MCP server that gives AI assistants Etsy search results by keyword, marketplace and category plus daily sales counts and growth for any Etsy shop; runs on your own Apify token. #opensource #mcp
  • EverAlice AI - All-in-one AI studio for Etsy and digital-product sellers: turns one artwork or idea into listing copy and SEO tags for 25 marketplaces, studio mockups, print-ready files, listing videos, a launch marketing pack and a customer delivery ZIP, with bulk runs of up to 100 products. #freemium

Finance

  • DisconfirmAI - AI investment research and reading tool that looks for evidence against your thesis before you commit, with daily source reading, filings and earnings research, condition-based change alerts and a personal investment framework. #freemium #research

Image Classification

  • Nature GO - Android app that suggests the species of a bird, insect, mammal or plant from an 8-second video filmed in the app, shows the visible evidence, and can also name a gallery photo. #freemium

Marketing

  • Google Ads Transparency MCP (⭐0) - MCP server that gives AI assistants a competitor's Google ads from the Google Ads Transparency Center: new, running or stopped, with first and last shown dates; runs on your own Apify token. #opensource #mcp

Music

  • Spotify Play Count MCP (⭐0) - MCP server that gives AI assistants Spotify play counts for any track, album, artist or playlist, plus artist monthly listeners and followers; runs on your own Apify token. #opensource #mcp

Presentation

  • EditableImage - Turns a slide screenshot into an editable PowerPoint with real text boxes over a rebuilt background; also converts diagram pictures to draw.io and flat artwork to layered PSD. Paid credit packs with a one-time free trial of 10 credits for two conversions on signup; no ongoing free tier. #paid

Productivity

  • AUTOMATER.ai - Tray app that keeps track of every AI coding agent you run: a searchable library of past sessions, a flag when an agent is waiting on you, and usage across 9 providers. #freemium
  • Plainer - Workspace for notes and files with a planner view, timeboxing and an AI assistant whose changes you can undo. #freemium

Real Estate

  • RoomLab.app - AI virtual staging, decluttering, restyling and walkthrough videos from room photos #freemium

SEO

  • AgentSEO - SEO API and MCP tools for keyword research, SERP analysis, rank tracking, and AI search visibility. New accounts receive 100 one-time live credits, then ongoing use requires a paid plan. #paid #seo #mcp

Sales

  • AlphaOSINT LinkedIn Company Employees - Lists the people who work at a company on LinkedIn, with titles and profile links, as an MCP tool for prospecting. #mcp #paid

Summarizer

  • Watch YouTube Highlights - Chrome and Firefox extension for watching AI-selected passages from captioned YouTube videos, with timestamps, text summaries and current-video chat. #freemium #video

Video

  • airapvideo - Vocals + photo to 9:16 lip-sync rap video; packs from $8.88. #paid
  • Alors on Danse AI - Two photos to ~15s white-studio duo dance; packs from $8.88. #paid

  • ChatGTT - One photo to ~10-13s card-declined meme; packs from $8.88. #paid

  • Choosin Texas AI - One photo to ~15s emo rooftop cover; packs from $8.88. #paid
  • Chuttamalle Dance AI - Authorized portrait to ~15s generative dance clip; packs from $8.88. #paid
  • coralineai - One selfie to ~10s button-eyes doll reveal; packs from $8.88. #paid
  • Corpse Bride AI - One photo to ~10s ghost bride/groom cemetery dance; packs from $8.88. #paid
  • Devil Wears Prada AI - One photo to ~15s street glow-up video; packs from $8.88. #paid
  • Flying Roadster AI - One selfie to ~10-12s night ramp jet/flip short; packs from $8.88. #paid
  • Hotel Lobby AI - Two photos to ~15s hotel lobby booth duo; packs from $8.88. #paid
  • Hug In Heaven AI - Two photos to ~12-15s stairway reunion memorial short (18+); packs from $8.88. #paid

  • ShanShenBu AI - One photo to ~13-15s flash-step dance; packs from $8.88. #paid

19. Awesome Rust

Applications / Database

  • kividbio/kividb (⭐949) - Redis-compatible in-memory database with built-in full-text and vector search

Applications / Industrial automation

  • cerulion-inc/cerulion (⭐101) [cerulion_cli] - Robot runtime with zero-copy shared memory and a graph-aware scheduler. Records a run and re-executes supported native recordings against new code, with an exit code for CI.

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 05, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Docker

Where to Start / Wrappers

  • prepare.sh Docker Course - 💴 Learn Docker in nine hands-on chapters that each run in a live Linux VM in the browser, from a first container to multi-stage builds, registries, volumes, networking, and image CVE scanning.

Security Articles / Wrappers

  • Privileged Containers Exercise - Escape a privileged Docker container to the host in the browser, then fix it with a non-root user, dropped capabilities, and a read-only rootfs.

2. Awesome Cl

Agents

  • nodecode (⭐176) - a living agent organism in Lisp. It becomes yours and evolves over time. MIT.

Graph databases

  • Ariadne (⭐1) - A graph database in Common Lisp with full W3C SPARQL 1.1 and SHACL conformance, Gremlin-style traversal, RDF import/export, property graph support, inference rules, graph analytics, and Graphviz visualization.
    • Built with LLMs.

3. Tools

Tools collection

  • DevToolbox - 30 free developer tools: JSON formatter and diff, regex tester, JWT decoder, Base64, hashing, cron parser, YAML and CSV converters. Everything runs client-side, no sign-up.

4. Awesome Postgres

Contents / Backups

  • Portabase - Agent-based platform for logical PostgreSQL backups and restores with decentralized execution and centralized orchestration. (Source Code (⭐1.9k))
  • restoredrill (⭐114) - CLI that restores your PostgreSQL backup into a disposable Docker container and verifies it actually works, producing a JSON report built for SOC 2 / ISO 27001 evidence.

Contents / GUI

  • Mongrel - Cross-platform PostgreSQL GUI with typed SQL, EXPLAIN (TEXT/JSON/XML/YAML), roles and grants, pgvector workflows, backups, and migrations (Commercial Software).
  • SaturnSQL - Browser-based collaborative SQL editor for teams, with scheduled query delivery to Google Sheets and Slack (Commercial Software).
  • Sutido - Windows desktop client covering PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL Server, Aerospike and ClickHouse in one window, with autocomplete from the live schema, SSH tunneling and server-side query cancellation (Commercial Software).

Contents / Extensions

  • pgmnemo (⭐8) - Memory for AI coding agents as an extension: hybrid HNSW+BM25 recall, write-time provenance gates, and an outcome loop measured against a no-memory control (dataset published in-repo).

Contents / Utilities

  • pgrecon (⭐29) - Offline Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration assessment and schema conversion; parses PL/SQL with a real grammar, reports incompatibilities, estimates effort.
  • Syncle - Web interface for syncing rows between Postgres and MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB or Redis, by backfill, polling, or logical replication.

Contents / PaaS (PostgreSQL as a Service)

  • Neon - Serverless Postgres that separates storage and compute. Branching, scale-to-zero, read replicas with no extra storage, instant restore (PITR), managed authentication, and a PostgREST-compatible Data API.

Resources / Tutorials

  • PostgreSQL Terminal Simulator - Guided psql lessons in a simulated terminal in the browser: meta-commands, EXPLAIN, indexes and transactions. Free, no signup.

5. Awesome Preact

Contents / Example Apps

  • Couscous - Secret-word guessing game; the web game and its Telegram Mini App are one Preact client built with Vite.

6. ALL About RSS

Aggregators of Podcasts / Podcast Navigation / Crypto or Blockchain relevant

  • Podcast OPML collections 926

7. Awesome Developer First

Messaging

  • SuprSend - Notification infrastructure with workflows, templates and preferences for email, SMS, push, in-app and chat.

8. Awesome Streaming

Table of Contents / Data Integration and Pipelines

  • mq-bridge (⭐25) - Embeddable library and CLI for moving data between brokers, databases incl. CDC, object storage and HTTP, usable from Rust, Python and Node.js.

Table of Contents / Engines and Platforms

  • rekuiper (⭐8) - Single-binary streaming SQL engine for filtering, aggregating, and routing MQTT and industrial telemetry on edge gateways.

9. Awesome Zsh Plugins

ZSH Tools / superconsole - Windows-only

  • speedrunner (⭐3) - Speeds up the start of Python, Ruby, PHP and Node CLIs by forking them from a preloaded daemon. Its ZSH hook starts the daemon while you type the command name.

10. Awesome Cli Apps in a Csv

File and file system handling

  • pdfmt (⭐8) - A command-line multi tool for the PDF tasks you keep doing again and again.

Editors

  • edamame (⭐121) - A Terminal Markdown editor that stays rendered while you edit.

Terminal multiplexers and accessories

  • berthd (⭐2) - Persistent shell sessions. A small daemon that owns your PTYs, so shells outlive the terminal app.

Font management

  • sauva (⭐105) - Terminal Unicode explorer.

Organizers and calendars

  • chroncal (⭐236) - Terminal-first calendar, todo, and journal manager with iCalendar (RFC 5545) support and CalDAV sync - CLI+TUI, local SQLite storage.

Graphics

  • tardigrade (⭐42) - A creature of self-healing cells inside your terminal.

Utilities

  • tinhorn (⭐7) - A terminal dice roller: shake the dice, watch em' fly, hear it bounce.

Learning and didactic tools

  • openleetcode (⭐178) - Terminal interface to exercise on LeetCode tests.

Games

  • chess-analyzer-tui (⭐5) - A lightweight chess.com-style analyzer. Runs with any UCI engine. Read games from your favorite chess website, file, stdin or clipboard.

11. Awesome Mqtt

Tools

  • LibreDB Studio (⭐1.3k) - Open source web database IDE with a read-only MQTT 5.0 connection: browse a broker's live topic tree with retained messages and read topics, including Sparkplug B payloads.
  • MQTTProbe (⭐41) - Cross platform MQTT diagnostic client for IIoT with live topic browsing, payload decoding across multiple formats, charting, built in emulators, and advanced Sparkplug B integration.
  • TrailTransfer (⭐0) - MQTT-controlled rclone worker for edge file transfers with a local policy and a hash-chained, independently verifiable evidence journal.

12. Awesome Privacy

VPNs / Apps

  • Free VPNs: a 2017 study of 283 Android VPN apps found 75% used trackers and 38% contained malware. Source

Password Managers / Useful Tools

  • LastPass: the UK fined it £1.2 million in 2025 over a 2022 breach that leaked customers' encrypted vaults. Source

Encryption / Useful Tools

  • BitLocker: your recovery key is uploaded to Microsoft by default, and Microsoft has handed such keys to the FBI. Source

Photo Editing and Management / Deezer alternative clients

  • Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom: its 2024 terms say Adobe may access your cloud content through both automated and manual review. Source

Video Editing / Deezer alternative clients

  • Adobe Premiere Pro: its terms allow automated scanning of your Creative Cloud files and human review of flagged ones. Source

Ebooks / Plugins for Minecraft

  • Amazon Kindle: in 2009 Amazon remotely deleted copies of 1984 that people had bought from their Kindles. Source

Android Debloat Tools / Plugins for Minecraft

  • ADB AppControl: its terms let it send your PC's IP, hardware details and the apps you remove to a remote server. Source

Android Gallery / Plugins for Minecraft

  • Google Photos: scans your photos, and in 2022 its scan got a father investigated by police over photos taken for a doctor. Source

Home Assistants / Other OS

  • Siri: in 2025 Apple settled claims that Siri recorded private conversations without consent for $95 million. Source

Payments / Apps and services

  • Visa / Mastercard: your card purchases feed Mastercard audience segments, like affluent shoppers, sold on data marketplaces. Source

Legend / Apps and services

  • ⚠️ closed server: the server code isn't public.
  • ⚠️ account required: an account is needed to use it.

13. Discount for Student Dev

SaaS

  • Glasp [FREE] - Highlight and take notes on web pages, PDFs and YouTube videos. Free plan for verified university students.

14. Public Apis

APIs Covered Under APILayer Suite!

  • Name: Git (⭐92k)

    Description: Read, search, diff, and commit to local Git repositories

    Auth: No

    Transport: stdio

    Install: –

  • Name: iGaming Tools

    Description: Online slot specs, RTP variants, providers, regulators, news, jobs and search demand

    Auth: No

    Transport: HTTP

    Install: –

  • Name: InjectScan (⭐0)

    Description: Scores text, web pages and MCP tool definitions for prompt injection with deterministic rules

    Auth: No

    Transport: stdio, HTTP

    Install: Glama · MCP Registry

  • Name: LucyESL

    Description: English-teaching jobs in South Korea with pay, hours and housing as facts, plus salary statistics

    Auth: No

    Transport: HTTP

    Install: Anthropic · Glama · MCP Registry

  • Name: PourWire

    Description: New US liquor license filings: restaurants and bars about to open in 7 metros, plus metro stats

    Auth: No

    Transport: HTTP

    Install: Glama · MCP Registry

  • Name: Vitalityfit

    Description: Cheapest offers for health products from German online shops and pharmacies by name, PZN or EAN

    Auth: No

    Transport: HTTP

    Install: MCP Registry

Art & Design

  • API: Paint Color HQ

    Description: Closest real paint colors across 13 brands for any hex value, scored with CIEDE2000

    Auth: No

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: Yes

  • API: pic2svg

    Description: Trace raster images to SVG with a free daily allowance

    Auth: No

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: No

Blockchain

  • API: HEY Research Lab

    Description: Builder activity for Robinhood Chain tokens and projects: who is shipping, each ship with its source

    Auth: No

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: Yes

Business

  • API: Company Enrichment

    Description: Domain, URL or email to company name, industry, size, HQ, tickers and socials, 125k companies

    Auth: apiKey

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: No

  • API: Firmbase

    Description: Belgian company register (KBO/CBE), Official Gazette notices and VAT validation

    Auth: apiKey

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: Yes

  • API: Logoapi

    Description: Free SVG company logos by domain, plus search by name. No signup

    Auth: No

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: Yes

  • API: Seller Fee

    Description: Marketplace and payment fees for Gumroad, Etsy, Stripe and PayPal with net payout breakdowns

    Auth: No

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: Yes

Calendar

  • API: Mother's Day Calendar

    Description: Mother's Day dates, country rules, sources and confidence as static JSON and CSV

    Auth: No

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: Yes

Cloud Storage & File Sharing

  • API: Deed

    Description: Publish an HTML file or folder to a permanent public URL with one PUT, no account

    Auth: No

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: Yes

Cryptocurrency

  • API: AlphaGrowth

    Description: Crypto project metrics, community growth, funding rounds, investors, chains, fees and DAO treasuries

    Auth: No

    HTTPS: Yes

    CORS: No

  • API: Lucyd

    Description: Bitcoin Up/Down prediction markets on testnet: markets, trades, positions, order books

    Auth: No

    HTTPS: Yes

  • Ryware/Headroom (⭐19) — Free native macOS disk analyzer with a folder tree, treemap, file ☆21
  • kaphacius/just-tags (⭐21) — A macOS app for all your EMV tag needs ☆21
  • az-code-lab/ampere (⭐20) — Battery management for macos ☆21
  • tiagomoraes/browbro (⭐18) — BowBro is a macos application that let's the user select the ☆20
  • larshurrelb/quicktalk-app (⭐20) — A open source transcription App for Mac using Gemini 3.5 ☆21
  • defcc/kidox.app (⭐34) — A Modern Launchpad Replacement for Mac ☆34
  • znat/parrotflow (⭐18) — Scriptable local dictation that uses the text on your screen to fix ☆18
  • kamjin3086/AppUninstaller (⭐36) — A lightweight, native macOS app uninstaller with ☆36
  • cursorvoice/cursor-voice (⭐27) — Talk to your Mac - a native macOS voice assistant that sees ☆27
  • Slllava/gridfy (⭐37) — Grid Calculator for Mac OS ☆37
  • netsvetaev/Old-Launchpad (⭐35) — Good Old Launchpad for MacOS 26 Tahoe ☆35
  • MeowkingCP/QuotaDot (⭐16) — Native macOS quota companion for Codex and Claude ☆16
  • MindMacApp/MindMac (⭐24) — Issue Tracker for elegant client for MacOS ☆24
  • nickustinov/typester-macos (⭐17) — Dictate anywhere in macOS ☆17
  • kshah00/zipper (⭐16) — A simple, elegant and powerful archival tool for macOS ☆16

Terminal / Emulators

  • Ji4n1ng/OpenInTerminal (⭐7.1k) — Finder Toolbar app for macOS to open the current directory ☆7,053
  • yuuichieguchi/Calyx (⭐366) — A native macOS terminal app built on Ghostty for running and ☆366
  • amanfromsolan/enso (⭐38) — A friendly, native macOS terminal with workspaces, a command ☆41
  • AwalTerminal/Awal-terminal (⭐35) — LLM-native terminal emulator for macOS - AI components ☆36
  • vestaterm/Vesta (⭐24) — A native macOS terminal for running AI coding agents in parallel ☆24
  • snowztech/farol (⭐21) — A fast macOS terminal for working with coding agents, built on ☆20
  • OpenFabrica/aster (⭐17) — A native macOS terminal workspace. Tabs, splits, files, editor and ☆17

Window Management / Shell Utilities

  • kasper/phoenix (⭐4.5k) — A lightweight macOS window and app manager scriptable with JavaScript ☆4,543
  • moonbai-studio/tungsten-edge (⭐644) — A per-window taskbar for macOS - a Dock replacement that ☆661
  • mocki-toki/barik (⭐519) — macOS menu bar replacement, with yabai and AeroSpace support ☆520
  • Seb-GRAF/StableBar (⭐94) — A native, customizable menu bar for macOS, with themes, widgets ☆190
  • antonyshakirov/hop (⭐166) — Free, open-source menu bar toolkit for macOS. Eighteen tools in ☆174
  • nshi/dimsum (⭐34) — Minimalist active window highlighting mac app ☆34
  • mikusnuz/nudge (⭐25) — A free, open-source macOS window manager. Magnet-compatible keyboard ☆25

Browsers / Shell Utilities

  • driceroland/Search (⭐2.8k) — A small, fast WebKit browser for macOS, by Office Commun ☆3,013
  • achiya-automation/safari-mcp (⭐244) — Native Safari browser automation for AI agents. 98 tools ☆244
  • mstcvk/mc-download-manager (⭐189) — Open-source macOS download manager: parallel-connection ☆193
  • chentao1006/BrowSync (⭐112) — BrowSync is a cross-browser routing and sync hub for macOS. It ☆115
  • Alexays/Lilo (⭐35) — A Mac browser on WebKit, not another Chromium, that still runs Chrome ☆61
  • nicojan/Chorus (⭐36) — Native macOS app that unifies web services into a single window with ☆38
  • notnaki/vane (⭐21) — Open-source native macOS browser with sidebar tabs, Spaces, Split View ☆30
  • dortanes/openspatial (⭐27) — Spatial audio for any headphones on Mac: 7.1 surround with head ☆30

19. Awesome Gemini Cli

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • pando (⭐7) - Terminal workspace that runs Gemini CLI side by side with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and shells, each session in its own git worktree, under a daemon that keeps them running when the TUI closes. Marks a Gemini session running or waiting for approval, reviews and commits its diff in the TUI, and has a CLI that blocks on session status.

Commands & Extensions

  • Log10x (⭐2) - Gemini CLI extension that installs the log10x MCP server (MIT, local stdio). It ranks log patterns by volume and cost and plans an action for the excess over each cap: compact on Splunk and self-managed Elasticsearch, tier down or offload to S3 on other platforms. No log data reaches log10x. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/log-10x/log10x-plugin.

MCP Servers

  • Candor Finance - Personal finance for Gemini CLI from your own US bank, card, loan, and investment accounts: spending, cash flow, a budget, and goals with a target, a date, and a monthly amount, saved across sessions, plus a weekly review that tells Gemini what is worth talking through. Bank access is read-only and no tool moves money. Hosted MCP server with OAuth sign-in plus 10 agent skills; requires a Candor account. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/candorsystems/candor-finance, then /mcp auth candor.

20. Magictools

Graphics / Texture Tools

  • 💸 DDS Tools - Browser-based DDS texture toolkit with a free viewer for mipmaps, channels, cubemap faces and texture metadata. Converts images to DDS and DDS to PNG or JPG locally, with compression, mipmap and normal-map settings.
  • 💸 GameShipKit Sprite Normal Map - Generate normal maps from 2D sprites for lit 2D scenes.

Graphics / Character Generators

  • 💸 GameShipKit 2D Character Rigging - Rig a 2D character in the browser and export idle, walk and attack animations as sprite sheets.

Graphics / Tile/Level Editors

  • 💸 GameShipKit Autotile Generator - Make blob and RPG Maker style autotiles from two textures, with Godot 4 and Tiled tilesets.
  • 💸 GameShipKit Map Generator - Seeded dungeon, cave and island maps, exported as PNG, Tiled JSON and CSV.
  • 🆓 SimplePixelArt Tileset Editor - Draw auto-tile tilesets in the browser and export them as Godot TileSet (.tres) and Tiled (.tsx) files.

Graphics / Vector/Image Editor

  • 🆓 Pic2Vector - Free in-browser PNG/JPG/WebP to layered SVG tracer for game icons and UI art. Runs locally with WebAssembly (vtracer); no upload, no account, watermark-free export.
  • 🆓 SimplePixelArt - Free browser pixel art editor with layers, animation frames and palettes; exports PNG, GIF and sprite sheets with Aseprite-style frame tags for game engines.

AI / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 QuickMatch - Free comparison of AI tools for making games and AI agent skills for game dev. Prices, free tiers and commercial-use terms come from each vendor's own page with the date checked, plus a matcher that suggests tools from a few questions.
  • 💸 Ziva.sh - AI agent plugin inside the Godot editor that edits scenes and scripts, reads editor errors, playtests your game and generates game sound effects from a prompt. On its Pro and Ultra plans, Devlog records your game runs while you build and turns them into 10-15 second vertical devlog videos with captions.

21. Awesome Mac

Reading and Writing Tools / Writing

  • Drifting - Open-source, local-first novel writing app with chapters, outline, characters and storylines, and an AI agent that can read and edit the whole project.

Reading and Writing Tools / Others

  • Saywing - Open-source tool that reads selected screen regions aloud using local OCR and neural speech, with offline English and German dictation.

Design and Product / Other Tools

  • Flipic (⭐6) - Photo culling viewer: arrow-key paging through a folder, 100% focus check, XMP ratings that Lightroom and Capture One read, on-device cleanup mode.

Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

  • Radif - Unofficial open-source YouTube Music client built with Tauri, with synced lyrics and a video mode, that needs YouTube Music Premium.

Voice-to-Text / Audio Record and Process

  • Wavo (⭐10) - Dictation that doesn't slow your Mac down: it runs on the Neural Engine, keeps your voice off the cloud, and types what you say wherever you're typing.

22. Awesome Testing

Software / AI & LLM Testing

  • evalship - GitHub App that finds flaws in your LLM evals, says on every pull request which evals a change broke and why, and finds prompt and model changes that win beyond chance.

23. Awesome Rust

Applications / Database

  • xerj-org/xerj (⭐19k) - Search engine for AI agents in one binary: BM25, vector and hybrid search over an Elasticsearch-compatible API, with a built-in MCP server

Applications / Web Servers

  • inbjo/MirrorProxy (⭐310) - A self-hosted caching proxy for package registries, container images, and source downloads, with a web console and cross-platform CLI.

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 04, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Micropython

Communications / RFID

  • micropython-uhf-module (⭐0) - A MicroPython driver for the Tenhanyun TY928 UHF RFID embedded module.

Communications / Serialization

  • micropython-msgpackc (⭐2) - Fast MessagePack in C, a drop-in replacement for umsgpack.

Communications / Web

  • MicroPyServer (⭐156) - A simple HTTP server for MicroPython projects.

Display / HDMI

  • anx7625 (⭐9) - MicroPython porting of video primitives for Portenta H7 via USBC (to HDMI adapter).

Display / LCD Graphic

  • MicroPython-Sharp-Memory-Display (⭐0) - MicroPython driver for SHARP memory LCD displays.

Display / Printer

  • coffee-edition-kit (⭐0) - Pico W firmware that pulls print jobs from GitHub over HTTPS and streams them to a network printer over IPP, for a nightly newspaper.

Storage / Database

  • ownSQL (⭐2) - A MySQL database driver for MicroPython, supporting MySQL Server 8.x and 9.x.

Frameworks / SRAM

  • OreoOS (⭐9) - Operating system for an open-hardware ESP32-S3 conference badge, with an app SDK, on-device app store, OTA updates and native video playback.
  • openbricks (⭐7) - Pybricks-style robotics firmware for ESP32: 1 kHz native drivebase control, serial bus servos, IMU gyro heading, line sensors, plus a MuJoCo simulator.

Tools / On Host

  • thonny-ai (⭐0) - Thonny plugin and MCP server that lets AI assistants run code, monitor long-running programs and sync projects on MicroPython boards, visibly and with optional approval.

2. Tools

Response

  • AppShot - Free in-browser App Store & Google Play screenshot maker (device frames, captions, exact required store sizes). Nothing uploaded.

Favicon

  • Favikit - Private in-browser favicon & app-icon generator (real multi-size .ico, Apple touch, Android, web manifest). Nothing uploaded.

Tools collection

  • ogkit - Free in-browser Open Graph / social card generator (1200×630, meta-tag snippet). Nothing uploaded.
  • All Tools Verse - Free collection of browser-based utilities for formatting, encoding, conversion and API work. No sign-up.

3. Awesome Azure Openai Llm

2. Azure OpenAI & Copilot

  • Microsoft Ecosystem
    • Microsoft 365 Copilot
    • Power Platform & Copilot Studio
    • Copilot Products
  • Platform
    • AI Platform & Services
    • Models, Training & Inference
    • IQ, Data & Memory
    • Agents & Context Engineering
  • Operations & Design
    • Developer Tools, MCP & .NET
    • Safety, Security & LLMOps
    • Architecture & Reference Designs
    • Solution Accelerators & Samples
    • Use Cases & Customer Stories
  • Learning & Research
    • Learning Resources & Workshops
    • Microsoft Research

4. Awesome Connectivity Info

Global Indexes

  • cable.co.uk Worldwide Broadband Price Comparison - Index of broadband costs around the world based on fixed line and wireless access. (2023) (2022) (2019) (2018)

Global Indexes / Discontinued

  • A4AI Affordability Drivers Index - Index of internet affordability by the Alliance for Affordable Internet Access (last published 2021). (2021) (2020)
  • A4AI Mobile Broadband Data Costs - Price of broadband data (1GB mobile prepaid) as % of GNI per capita (last published 2020). (2020) (Q4 2018) (2017)

Connectivity Maps / Discontinued

  • Global CDN Infrastructure Map - Open data map of Content Distribution Networks around the world hosted by NSRC (May 2024).
  • TeleGeography Africa Telecoms Map - Map of African telecoms including undersea cables, international bandwidth, and cloud data centres. (2025) (2024)
  • TeleGeography Submarine Cable Map - Interactive submarine fibre optic cables.
  • TeleGeography Annual Submarine Cable Update - Annual print editions of the submarine cable map. (2026) (2025) (2024) (2023) (2022) · archive
  • TeleGeography Cloud Infrastructure Map - Map of cloud infrastructure providers around the world.
  • Hurricane Electric 3D Map - Interactive 3D map of undersea cables and Hurricane Electric Points of Presence (POPs) and routes.
  • nperf Mobile Coverage Maps - Mobile coverage based on data collected from the nperf app.

Periodic Global Reports / Discontinued

  • We Are Social / Meltwater Digital - Annual report on internet and social media adoption. (2026) (2025) (2024) (2023) (2022) · archive
  • GSMA Mobile Gender Gap Report - Gender gaps in mobile ownership and mobile internet use in low- and middle-income countries. (2026) (2025) (2024) (2023) (2022) · archive
  • Broadband Commission: The State of Broadband - Annual flagship report on broadband access, affordability, and use. (2025) (2024) (2023) (2022) (2021) · archive
  • GSMA State of Mobile Internet Connectivity - Trends in global mobile internet connectivity and barriers to adoption. (2026) (2025) (2024) (2023) (2022) · archive
  • ITU Global Connectivity Report - Detailed assessment of the current state of connectivity. (2025) (2022)
  • ITU Measuring Digital Development - Facts and Figures annual estimates of global connectivity. (2026) (2025) (LLDCs 2025) (2024) (2024 Small Island States) · archive
  • ITU Measuring Digital Development: ICT Price Trends - Analysis and comparison of price data for mobile-voice services, mobile data and fixed broadband. Replaces the Measuring the Information Society Report. (2024) (2019)
  • UN E-Government Survey - Global E-Government and E-Participation Development Index; underlying country data in the UN E-Government Knowledge Database. (2024) (2022) (2020) (2018) (2016)
  • Mozilla Internet Health Report - Annual look at the health of the internet (last published 2020). (2020) (2019) (2018)
  • ITU Measuring the Information Society - Earlier ITU series on ICT development, later replaced by Measuring Digital Development (discontinued). (2018) (2017)
  • Deloitte - Global Mobile Consumer Trends - Survey of mobile consumer behaviour across markets (discontinued).

Regional Reports and Data / Discontinued

  • GSMA Mobile Economy - Middle East & North Africa - Regional Mobile Economy report for MENA. (2025) (2024) (2023) (2022)
  • GSMA Mobile Economy - West Africa - Regional Mobile Economy report for West Africa. (2019) (2018)
  • GSMA Mobile Economy - Sub-Saharan Africa - Regional Mobile Economy report for Sub-Saharan Africa. (2024) (2023) (2022) (2021) (2020) · archive
  • GSMA Mobile Economy - Africa - Continent-wide Mobile Economy report for Africa. (2026) (2025) (2016)
  • GSMA Mobile Economy - Latin America - Regional Mobile Economy report for Latin America. (2026) (2024) (2022) (2021)
  • GSMA Mobile Economy - Asia Pacific - Regional Mobile Economy report for Asia Pacific. (2026) (2025) (2024) (2021) (2020)
  • Development and Access to Information (DA2i) Regional Reports - Dashboards profiling Connectivity, Freedom, and Gender Equity by the TASCHA group at the University of Washington, funded by IFLA.
  • African Telecommunications Infrastructure Development - Series on African telecom infrastructure at manypossibilities.net (2014–2023).
  • RIA Africa Mobile Pricing (RAMP) Indices Portal - Pricing information on Voice/SMS basket, 1GB data basket, and Value For Money bundles (Q3 2022).
  • Opera - State of the Mobile Web Africa - Opera reports on mobile web use in Africa (last published 2019). (2019) (2016)
  • Ericsson Mobility Report - Sub-Saharan Africa - Regional closer look from the Ericsson Mobility Report. (2024) (2015)
  • Opensignal - The State of Mobile Network Experience in Africa - Download speeds and network quality in 27 African countries (November 2024).
  • Lions go digital: The Internet's transformative potential in Africa - Report by McKinsey on the potential impact of the Internet in Africa (last published 2013).

Data and Measurement / Discontinued

  • Opensignal - State of Mobile Networks Reports - Country reports based on Opensignal data gathering.

5. ALL About RSS

Apps / Outline Processor Markup Language

  • Newsbin : a native RSS reader for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch with optional on-device AI, free to try
  • Feedler : a smart RSS reader with an in-house full-article parser and cross-source Trending Stories, free for five feeds then €9.99/year

Hosted Readers / Outline Processor Markup Language

  • Sublime Feed : an RSS reader without unread counts, free for five feeds then $4/month or $40/year

Self Hosted Readers / Outline Processor Markup Language

  • FeedThing (⭐5) : a Django reader with a two-pane catch-up model and river-of-news folders, self-hosted on gunicorn
  • Tuvix : an open-source RSS aggregator, self-host it or use the free hosted app
  • Simple Feed Reader (⭐8) : a self-hosted multi-user reader with full-text extraction, email digests and Bluesky/Mastodon timelines and lists as feeds, Docker Compose deploy

🧾Other Lists that Collect RSS Things / Outline Processor Markup Language

  • The RSS Universe : a living directory of 133 RSS apps, tools and standards, links checked live

specifically from (a certain platform) / Steam

  • Owned Steam Game RSS Feeds : generates an .opml of news feeds for the games you own, optionally including wishlisted, free and unplayed titles

specifically from (a certain platform) / TMDB

  • Magnanium : generates an RSS feed for the upcoming releases of any actor or director, filterable by role, release type and lead time

Toolbox / Webpage Monitor Services with capability of monitoring RSS Feed 1264

  • FeedCraft (⭐313): an RSS middleware in Go that translates, extracts full text, renders JS-heavy pages, and summarizes or filters items with an LLM

Feed item filtering / Webpage Monitor Services with capability of monitoring RSS Feed 1264

  • Feed Rinse: filter items out by keyword, author or category; the link goes to the pre-2.0 site, which is still the only working one

6. Awesome Developer First

AI Coding

  • Beacon.sh - Self‑improving memory for coding agents.

Browser Automation

  • Browserless - Browser automation deployed to the cloud.
  • Stagehand by Browserbase - Open-source SDK to make your browser agents resilient, readable, and production-ready.
  • Tabstack - Web data and automation API that delivers reliable structured output. Built at Mozilla.

7. Awesome Home Assistant

🔵 Bluetooth & BLE

  • PadSpan HA (⭐291) - Shows which room every phone, watch and tag is in, live, on a 3D floor plan, using the ESPHome Bluetooth proxies you already have (291★).

Tools & Utilities

  • HA Desktop Widget (⭐98) - Desktop app and widget for Windows, macOS and Linux to control entities, watch cameras, view sensors and pin tiles to the desktop (100★).

8. Awesome Cpp

Online Compiler

  • Devtoolry - An online C/C++ compiler that runs Clang in the browser via WebAssembly.

9. Free for Dev

Analytics, Events and Statistics

  • Pug - Open-source product analytics with autocapture, trends, funnels, retention, user flows and unified user profiles. Free plan includes 100,000 events per month and 1 year of data retention.

APIs, Data, and ML

  • TimeLogic API - World time and timezone API with cryptographically signed JSON responses, so you can verify the time wasn't tampered with. Get the current time by timezone, IP address or coordinates, convert between zones, check DST changes, and do business-day date math. WorldTimeAPI-compatible endpoints for apps that used worldtimeapi.org. Free plan includes 10,000 requests/month on all endpoints.

Security and PKI

  • CyberShield Studio - Security monitoring for e-commerce store operators and developers. Weekly scans for JavaScript changes or injection, tracking before consent, security header settings, and vulnerable client-side libraries and WordPress plugins. Free plan monitors 1 store (home page + checkout path) with 30 days of history. No credit card required.

Monitoring

  • Gairė - Web Change monitoring for research, price changes, out-of/in stock monitoring. Free plan up to 10 pages checked every hour, alerts by sms, email, Webhook, Slack/Discord/Telegram integrations. No card needed.
  • hypermonitors.com - Monitors your infrastructure from three different locations (ZH - NYC - SG) with every outage checked from a 2nd location before alerts go out. Free forever for 5 monitors and 5 minute checks.

Forms

  • whatayarn - Online form builder. Unlimited forms and responses on Free, subject to fair use.

Generative AI

  • evalship - find the flaws in your LLM evals. Reviews your evals suite for improvement opportunities, monitors your PRs for any eval regressions or unintended side effects and optimizes your prompts and models based on experiments in your product. Free for 1 private repo for 1 user, 100 PR analyses a month, 30 days of eval history. Free for public repos.

PaaS

  • EthioDeploy - Hosting and agentic coding platform containing Built-in Analytics, Database, GitHub CI/CD, free sub-domain, CLI, AI coding agent. Free tier allows one project 256 MB RAM / 0.5 CPU, sleeps after 30 min idle, 512 MB database and 100,000 tokens on the default model one time.

Issue Tracking and Project Management

  • Archboard - Architecture diagrams your team and AI agents edit live. Free plan: 1 seat, 3 diagrams, all built-in node packs and live editing with your AI agents (MCP).
  • UserJot - Live chat, feedback boards, a roadmap, and a changelog, so everything your customers say reaches the people and agents building your product. Free plan: Unlimited Posts, Unlimited Users, 3 Admin Roles, 2 Feedback Boards, Roadmap, Changelog.

Payment and Billing Integration

  • UsageRail - API keys, rate limits, quotas and usage-based billing for paid APIs, checked inside your own server with no gateway. Free up to $1,000/month billed and 1M requests/month.

10. Awesome Privacy

Video and Audio Conferencing / Desktop

  • WhatsApp: in 2021 Ireland fined it €225 million for not properly explaining what data it shares with Facebook. ToS;DR · Source
  • Zoom: paid $85 million in 2021 to settle claims it shared user data with Facebook, Google and LinkedIn. ToS;DR · Source
  • BigBlueButton - Self-hosted web conferencing built for online classes, with whiteboard, breakout rooms and recordings. ⚠️ website trackers self-host · LGPL-3.0
  • Briefing - Group video chat in the browser over direct WebRTC connections, with no account. self-host · AGPL-3.0
  • Chitchatter - Serverless, ephemeral peer-to-peer chat with audio, video, screen and file sharing. GPL-2.0
  • Jami - Peer-to-peer audio and video calls and chat with no central servers or account needed. GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • Jitsi Meet - Video conferencing you can self-host; the official instance requires you to log in. self-host · Apache-2.0 · F-Droid (Play Store version has trackers)
  • MiroTalk P2P - Browser-based peer-to-peer video calls up to 4K, with nothing to install. AGPL-3.0
  • Mumble - Low-latency voice chat with encrypted connections, on servers you can run yourself. self-host

Instant Messaging

  • Facebook Messenger: chats have been encrypted since 2023, but Meta still sees who you message, when, and who your contacts are. ToS;DR · Exodus · Source

Instagram / Desktop

  • Instagram: Ireland fined Meta €405 million in 2022 for exposing children's emails and phone numbers on Instagram. ToS;DR · Source
  • Pixelfed - Federated photo sharing with posts, stories and a chronological feed, without ads. ActivityPub · AGPL-3.0

Location Tracking / Apps and services

  • Google Find Hub (formerly Find My Device): reports your devices' locations to Google. ToS;DR

Teamworking Tools / Desktop

  • Wire - End-to-end encrypted messaging, calls and file sharing for teams, with public and audited code for both the apps and the server. ⚠️ website trackers AGPL-3.0 · F-Droid (Play Store version has trackers)
  • Discord: a 2025 breach at a support vendor exposed government ID photos of about 70,000 users. ToS;DR · Source
  • Slack: your messages feed its recommendation models unless a workspace owner emails Slack to opt out. ToS;DR · Source
  • Rocket.Chat - Self-hosted team chat with end-to-end encrypted rooms and federation. ⚠️ website trackers self-host
  • Twake Chat - Workplace chat built on Matrix, part of Linagora's Twake Workplace suite. AGPL-3.0

Maps and Navigation / Apps and services

  • Bing Maps: under Microsoft's very poorly rated privacy policy. ToS;DR
  • Yandex Maps: 11 trackers in its Android app, from a company bound by Russian surveillance law. Exodus
  • Sygic: 8 trackers in its Android app. Exodus
  • OpenStreetMap (OSM) - Collaborative world map built by volunteers, and the open data behind most apps in this section. GPL-2.0
    • OsmAnd - Offline maps and navigation built on OpenStreetMap, with a large set of features. ⚠️ telemetry opt-out Android · iOS · F-Droid
  • Pure Maps - Maps and navigation for Linux phones, Sailfish OS and desktop, fully offline with OSM Scout Server. Linux · GPL-3.0

Search Engines / Useful Tools

  • Yahoo!: a 2013 breach hit all 3 billion Yahoo accounts, which Yahoo admitted only in 2017. ToS;DR · Source
  • Yandex: in 2025 researchers found its Android apps, Yandex Search among them, secretly linked browsing to device IDs. ToS;DR · Source
  • Brave Search - Search engine with its own independent index, from the makers of Brave.
  • DuckDuckGo - Search engine that doesn't build a profile on you, with results drawn largely from Bing.
  • Marginalia - Independent search engine with its own crawler and index that favors text-heavy, non-commercial pages. self-host
  • Mojeek - UK search engine with its own crawler and index and a no-tracking policy.
  • Qwant - French search engine, hosted in the EU, that doesn't track your searches.
  • SearXNG - Metasearch engine that queries other search services for you; use a public instance or host your own. self-host · AGPL-3.0
  • YaCy - Peer-to-peer search engine where every user runs a node and shares the index.

Third-party

  • Proton Mail - Email from Switzerland, end-to-end encrypted between Proton users and with PGP, and stored encrypted otherwise, where a court order can still force it to log your IP (2021 case). GPL-3.0

Self-hosted

  • Docker Mailserver - Complete mail server (SMTP, IMAP, antispam, antivirus) in a single Docker container, configured with files. self-host · MIT
  • Mail-in-a-box - Turns a fresh Ubuntu server into a complete mail server with one setup script. self-host · CC0-1.0
  • Mailcow: dockerized - Docker-based mail server suite with a web admin panel, webmail and groupware. self-host · GPL-3.0
  • Mox - Self-contained mail server in a single binary, built to need little maintenance. self-host · MIT

Clients / Android / iOS

  • FairEmail - Full-featured email app that blocks tracking images and keeps everything on your device. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • Thunderbird for Android - Mozilla's email app for Android, built on K-9 Mail, which still ships from the same code. Android · Apache-2.0 · F-Droid

Clients / Desktop

  • NeoMutt - Terminal email client with built-in PGP/GPG support, a maintained fork of Mutt. Linux · macOS · CLI · GPL-2.0

Email Alias Services (Anonymous Forwarding) / Desktop

  • SimpleLogin - Email alias service you can host yourself, owned by Proton. self-host · AGPL-3.0

Alternative clients/modifications of Discord / Desktop

  • Aliucord (⭐4.9k) - Mod for the Android Discord app that disables Discord's tracking (⭐4.9k). Android · OSL-3.0
  • BetterDiscord - Discord client mod; add the DoNotTrack plugin to block trackers. Apache-2.0

Privacy vs Security vs Anonymity / Apps and services

  • Privacy is control over your personal information: knowing what is collected about you, and deciding who can access it and how.
  • Security is protection of your information from unauthorized access or theft, so attackers can't get at it.
  • Anonymity means your actions can't be traced back to you. Someone may see what is done, but not who did it.

Legend / Apps and services

  • 💀 inactive: development has stalled. It still works and has no maintained alternative, so check before relying on it.
  • ⚠️ closed source: the code isn't public. Listed only because of a long, trusted record.
  • ⚠️ source-available: the code is public, but the license isn't an open source one.
  • ⚠️ website trackers: the project's website loads third-party trackers. That says nothing about the app itself.
  • ⚠️ telemetry opt-out: the app sends usage data by default, but a setting turns it off.

Software / AI & LLM Testing

Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

  • GenClass (⭐7) - Open-source browser library that reports race conditions in a web app while they happen (stale responses written over newer data, duplicate submits, failure storms) with a small on-device model. Its local MCP server re-runs a page with responses delivered in different orders to find races and replays one order to prove a fix.
  • Replay QA - Autonomous QA agent for web apps built on Replay's time-travel runtime recording and analysis. It explores an app from its URL, writes and runs Playwright tests, and delivers a root-cause analysis for each failure, backed by evidence from the recorded execution. Free tier, no credit card.
